Limits (8 per application, 32 per process) count workers until their thread really ends, because cancellation is only a request.

items.title: Diagnostics
items.text: The SDK records redacted, allow-listed events into an in-memory ring (2048 records) according to NATIVEHTMLKIT_DIAGNOSTICS. A session ID shared through the environment correlates SDK records, host records and the backend. Export-NativeHTMLKitSupportBundle writes these records and counters to a ZIP only when called; nothing leaves the machine.

items.title: Boundaries
items.text:
• The SDK depends only on the public Core wire protocol v1; it does not use Core internals.
  • The NativeHTMLKit.UI module (declarative components, reactive state) builds on the public cmdlets of this SDK only.
  • Platforms: PowerShell 7.2+ on Linux x64 and Windows x64; Windows PowerShell 5.1 on Windows (the C# transport compiles against .NET Framework there). Native behaviour is qualified per platform; see the capability matrix.

Source: nativehtmlkit-powershell/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md · edit the page there.

items.title: Getting started with the PowerShell SDK
items.text:
The NativeHTMLKit module turns a PowerShell script into a desktop application: the window and its HTML/CSS page are drawn by a native host that ships inside the module, and your script reacts to clicks, typing and form submissions. There is no browser, no JavaScript and no local web server.

This page takes about ten minutes: install the module, write a first window, run it, and test it without a desktop.

items.title: Requirements
items.text:
• PowerShell 7.2 or later on Linux x64 or Windows x64, or Windows PowerShell 5.1 on Windows x64.
  • A desktop session to see windows (on Linux: KDE Plasma on Wayland is the qualified desktop). Automated tests run without one, see below.

items.title: Install
items.text:
Install-Module NativeHTMLKit -Scope CurrentUser
# or, with PSResourceGet:
Install-PSResource NativeHTMLKit -Scope CurrentUser

Check the installed version and the bundled host:

Import-Module NativeHTMLKit
(Get-Module NativeHTMLKit).Version          # 0.1.2
Get-NativeHTMLKitHostPath                     # path of the verified native host binary

items.title: Your first window
items.text:
Save this as hello.ps1:

hello.ps1
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module NativeHTMLKit

# The host runs this script a second time as its backend; everything below runs in that backend.
$app = Start-NativeHTMLKitScript -Name 'Hello'
try {
    $window = New-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Application $app -Title 'Hello' -Width 480 -Height 260
    $doc = Open-NativeHTMLKitHtml -Window $window -Html @'
<!doctype html>
<html><head><style>
  body { font-family: sans-serif; margin: 24px; }
  form { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
  #name { flex: 1; padding: 6px; }
</style></head>
<body>
  <h1>Hello</h1>
  <form id="greet"><input id="name" placeholder="Your name" required><button>Greet</button></form>
  <p id="message" role="status">Type your name and press Enter.</p>
</body></html>
'@
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type submit -Element greet -Callback {
        $name = (Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element name).Trim()
        # Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText never parses markup: any name is shown as plain text.
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element message -Text "Hello, $name!"
    }
    Set-NativeHTMLKitReady -Application $app
    Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -UntilShutdown
} finally {
    Close-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app
}

Real capture on KDE Plasma 6.6 Wayland with the released packages.

Run it:

pwsh -File ./hello.ps1                        # Windows PowerShell: powershell.exe -NoProfile -File .\hello.ps1

A native window opens. Type a name and press Enter (or click Greet); the greeting appears. Close the window to end the script.

items.title: What happened
items.text:
1. Start-NativeHTMLKitScript started the native host, and the host ran hello.ps1 again as its supervised backend. In the first run the call never returns (the launcher waits for the host and exits with its exit code); in the backend run it returns the connected application. Keep side effects such as writing files below this call.
  2. New-NativeHTMLKitWindow and Open-NativeHTMLKitHtml created the window and loaded the page.
  3. Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent subscribed a scriptblock to the form's submit event. Pressing Enter in the field submits the form; required stops an empty submission before your code sees it.
  4. Set-NativeHTMLKitReady told the host the first screen is ready.
  5. Wait-NativeHTMLKit -UntilShutdown is the event loop: callbacks run inside it, on this runspace. It returns when the last window closes.
  6. Close-NativeHTMLKit in finally releases everything, whatever happened.

The lifecycle guide explains each step and the mistakes that break it.

items.title: Test without a desktop
items.text:
The host has a headless mode for automated tests. It runs the whole protocol without windows (and without any user input), so your script can drive the page itself and read it back:

$env:NATIVEHTMLKIT_TEST_MODE = '1'
pwsh -File ./hello.ps1

The examples accept -SelfTest, which submits forms with Submit-NativeHTMLKitForm, reads the document with Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText, prints a PASS line and quits with Request-NativeHTMLKitQuit. Native dialogs, the clipboard and opening links need a real desktop; in headless mode they throw NativeHTMLKit.RpcException code -32001.

items.title: Where next
items.text:
• Learn step by step: the todo app tutorial (forms, lists, editing, saving), then the process dashboard tutorial (background refresh) and the bulk rename tutorial (a multi-file project).
  • Solve a task: the how-to guides.
  • Read and run complete apps: the examples (by task).
  • Look up a cmdlet: the cmdlet reference, or Get-Help <command> in PowerShell.
  • Start your own project: New-NativeHTMLKitProject -Path ./MyApp (project scaffolding).

Source: nativehtmlkit-powershell/docs/getting-started.md · edit the page there.

items.title: PowerShell examples
items.text:
Every example is a complete program, verified against the real NativeHTMLKit host. Open one to see a screenshot, how to run it and its full source.

Example What it does Hello The smallest complete app: a greeting form that writes untrusted text safely. Counter A counter with a step selector, limits and a bounded change history. Todo list Add, edit, complete, filter and delete tasks, saved to a JSON file. Sign-up form Sign-up form with native constraint validation, a password-match rule, an error summary and a result. Inventory data table Searchable, sortable, paged table rendered from data, with a details pane. Process viewer Sortable, filterable table of running processes. Log viewer Follows a growing log file with highlighting, pause, clear and auto-scroll. File viewer Text file viewer and editor with native Open, Save As and Choose Folder dialogs. Multiple windows Note windows managed from a main window, with a close veto for unsaved notes. Settings dialog Settings in a modal HTML dialog, saved to JSON: colour scheme, text size and reduced motion. Clipboard tool Text transforms, copy and paste, a documentation link and the desktop colour scheme. Checksums SHA-256 of every file in a folder, computed in the background with progress, cancel and a quit warning. Live chart A live line chart of memory use drawn into an RGBA bitmap. Snippet editor A snippet editor with keyboard shortcuts, Tab indentation and selection handling. About and support An About/Support window: capabilities, preferences, counters and a support bundle. DOM explorer Tree view of a live DOM with selecting, editing, moving and deleting nodes. Focus timer A countdown timer that asks before quitting while it runs. Background jobs Concurrent jobs with progress bars and cancel buttons. Bulk rename Rename many files with find/replace, a live preview, a confirmation dialog and undo. Process dashboard Live process monitor that refreshes in the background, with filter, sort, pause and copy.

items.title: Background jobs
items.text:
Concurrent jobs with progress bars and cancel buttons.

Same example in Python: Background jobs

Real capture on KDE Plasma 6.6 Wayland with the released packages.

What it teaches: Start-NativeHTMLKitTask chains; progress; Stop-NativeHTMLKitTask; the task limit and a queue.

items.title: Run it
items.text:
pwsh -File 18-background-jobs.ps1

Related guide: background work

items.title: Source: 18-background-jobs.ps1
items.text:
View on GitHub

# 18-background-jobs.ps1 - start, watch and cancel several background jobs from the UI.
#
# Teaches: concurrent work with Start-NativeHTMLKitTask (each job is a chain of short tasks, so
# every step can report progress from -OnCompleted on the UI runspace), per-job cancellation with
# Stop-NativeHTMLKitTask (-OnFailed receives an OperationCanceledException), the task limit (at
# most 8 unfinished tasks per application: further jobs wait in a queue), inserting rows with
# Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentHtml -Position beforeend, and finishing a row with one atomic batch.
# This is the PowerShell counterpart of the Python SDK's asyncio job runner.
#
# Run:  pwsh -File ./18-background-jobs.ps1      (or powershell.exe -NoProfile -File .\18-background-jobs.ps1)
# -SelfTest runs jobs to completion, cancels one, checks the queue and quits.
param([switch]$SelfTest)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module NativeHTMLKit

$app = Start-NativeHTMLKitScript -Name 'Background jobs'
try {
    $window = New-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Application $app -Title 'Background jobs' -Width 620 -Height 480
    $doc = Open-NativeHTMLKitHtml -Window $window -Html @'
<!doctype html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>
  body { margin:0; padding:18px 22px; font:14px sans-serif; background:#f3f5f9; color:#1f2430; }
  h1 { font-size:20px; margin:0 0 12px; }
  form { display:flex; gap:8px; margin-bottom:14px; }
  input { width:80px; padding:6px; }
  button { padding:6px 12px; border:1px solid #a9b2c3; border-radius:5px; background:#fff; cursor:pointer; }
  .job { background:#fff; border-radius:8px; padding:10px 12px; margin-bottom:8px; display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:center; }
  .job .name { width:70px; font-weight:bold; }
  .track { flex:1; height:8px; background:#e2e6ee; border-radius:4px; }
  .fill { height:8px; width:0%; background:#3b74e8; border-radius:4px; }
  .job.done .fill { background:#2f9e5b; } .job.cancelled .fill { background:#c4573a; }
  .state { width:90px; color:#5d6678; }
</style></head>
<body>
  <h1>Background jobs</h1>
  <form id="new-job"><label>Duration (s) <input id="seconds" type="number" min="1" max="30" value="4"></label>
    <button id="start" type="submit">Start job</button></form>
  <div id="jobs"></div>
  <p id="summary">No jobs yet.</p>
</body></html>
'@

    $steps = 20
    $maxRunning = 8                                  # the SDK allows 8 unfinished tasks per application
    # Job id -> @{ Id; Seconds; Step; State; Task }. Callbacks change entries, never script variables.
    $runner = @{ Jobs = [ordered]@{}; Queue = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.Queue[int]; NextId = 1; Random = (New-Object Random) }

    # Simulated work in an isolated runspace: plain data in, plain data out.
    $work = { param([int]$Milliseconds) Start-Sleep -Milliseconds $Milliseconds }

    function Get-RunningCount { return @($runner.Jobs.Values | Where-Object { $_.State -eq 'running' }).Count }

    function Update-Summary {
        $parts = foreach ($state in 'queued', 'running', 'done', 'cancelled') {
            $n = @($runner.Jobs.Values | Where-Object { $_.State -eq $state }).Count
            if ($state -ne 'queued' -or $n -gt 0) { "$n $state" }
        }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element summary -Text ($parts -join ', ')
    }

    function Add-Job([double]$Seconds) {
        $id = $runner.NextId; $runner.NextId++
        $runner.Jobs[[string]$id] = @{ Id = $id; Seconds = $Seconds; Step = 0; State = 'queued'; Task = $null }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentHtml -Document $doc -Element jobs -Position beforeend -Html (
            ('<div class="job" id="job-{0}"><span class="name">Job {0}</span>' -f $id) +
            ('<div class="track"><div class="fill" id="job-{0}-fill"></div></div>' -f $id) +
            ('<span class="state" id="job-{0}-state">queued</span><button id="job-{0}-cancel">Cancel</button></div>' -f $id))
        $runner.Queue.Enqueue($id)
        Start-QueuedJobs
        Update-Summary
        return $id
    }

    function Start-QueuedJobs {
        while ($runner.Queue.Count -gt 0 -and (Get-RunningCount) -lt $maxRunning) {
            $job = $runner.Jobs[[string]$runner.Queue.Dequeue()]
            if ($job.State -ne 'queued') { continue }      # cancelled while waiting
            $job.State = 'running'
            Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element "job-$($job.Id)-state" -Text 'running'
            Start-JobStep $job
        }
    }

    function Start-JobStep($Job) {
        $delay = [int]($Job.Seconds * 1000 / $steps * (0.6 + 0.8 * $runner.Random.NextDouble()))
        # .GetNewClosure() keeps this function's $Job for the callbacks, which run later.
        $Job.Task = Start-NativeHTMLKitTask -Application $app -ScriptBlock $work -ArgumentList @($delay) -OnCompleted {
            $Job.Step++
            Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentAttribute -Document $doc -Element "job-$($Job.Id)-fill" -Name style -Value ('width:{0}%' -f [int]($Job.Step * 100 / $steps))
            if ($Job.Step -lt $steps) { Start-JobStep $Job } else { Complete-Job $Job 'done' }
        }.GetNewClosure() -OnFailed {
            param($failure)
            if ($failure -is [OperationCanceledException]) { Complete-Job $Job 'cancelled' }
            else { Complete-Job $Job ('failed: ' + $failure.Message) }
        }.GetNewClosure()
    }

    function Complete-Job($Job, [string]$Outcome) {
        $Job.State = $Outcome; $Job.Task = $null
        Invoke-NativeHTMLKitBatch -Document $doc -Operations @(
            @{ op = 'add_class'; element = "job-$($Job.Id)"; name = $Outcome }
            @{ op = 'set_text'; element = "job-$($Job.Id)-state"; text = $Outcome }
            @{ op = 'remove_element'; element = "job-$($Job.Id)-cancel" })
        Start-QueuedJobs
        Update-Summary
    }

    function Stop-Job([int]$Id) {
        $job = $runner.Jobs[[string]$Id]
        if ($null -eq $job) { return }
        if ($job.State -eq 'queued') { Complete-Job $job 'cancelled' }
        elseif ($job.State -eq 'running' -and $null -ne $job.Task) { Stop-NativeHTMLKitTask -Task $job.Task }   # -OnFailed finishes it
    }

    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type submit -Element new-job -Callback {
        $value = Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element seconds
        $seconds = 4.0
        if ($value -match '^\d+(\.\d+)?$') { $seconds = [Math]::Min(30.0, [Math]::Max(1.0, [double]::Parse($value, [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture))) }
        $null = Add-Job $seconds
    }
    # One delegated handler for every Cancel button: job-<n>-cancel.
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element jobs -Callback {
        param($evt)
        if ($evt.element -match '^job-(\d+)-cancel$') { Stop-Job ([int]$Matches[1]) }
    }

    Set-NativeHTMLKitReady -Application $app

    if ($SelfTest) {
        function Wait-For([scriptblock]$Condition) {
            $clock = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
            while (-not (& $Condition)) {
                if ($clock.ElapsedMilliseconds -gt 60000) { throw "timed out waiting for: $Condition" }
                $null = Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -TimeoutMilliseconds 50
            }
        }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element seconds -Value '1'
        $null = Submit-NativeHTMLKitForm -Document $doc -Form new-job
        Wait-For { $runner.Jobs.Count -eq 1 }
        Wait-For { $runner.Jobs['1'].State -eq 'done' }
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element summary) -ne '0 running, 1 done, 0 cancelled') { throw 'summary after one job is wrong' }
        if ((Find-NativeHTMLKitElement -Document $doc -Selector '#job-1.done').matched_nodes -ne 1) { throw 'job 1 not marked done' }
        if ((Find-NativeHTMLKitElement -Document $doc -Selector '#job-1-cancel').matched_nodes -ne 0) { throw 'cancel button still there' }
        # Ten long jobs: eight run, two wait; cancelling frees slots.
        $ids = @(1..10 | ForEach-Object { Add-Job 20 })
        if ((Get-RunningCount) -ne 8) { throw "expected 8 running jobs, got $(Get-RunningCount)" }
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element summary) -ne '2 queued, 8 running, 1 done, 0 cancelled') { throw 'queue summary is wrong' }
        Stop-Job $ids[9]                                  # a queued job is cancelled at once
        Stop-Job $ids[0]                                  # a running job is cancelled through -OnFailed
        Wait-For { $runner.Jobs[[string]$ids[0]].State -eq 'cancelled' }
        Wait-For { $runner.Jobs[[string]$ids[8]].State -eq 'running' }
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element "job-$($ids[0])-state") -ne 'cancelled') { throw 'cancelled state not shown' }
        foreach ($id in $ids) { Stop-Job $id }
        Wait-For { (Get-RunningCount) -eq 0 }
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element summary) -ne '0 running, 1 done, 10 cancelled') { throw 'final summary is wrong' }
        [Console]::Out.WriteLine('SELFTEST PASS 18-background-jobs')
        $null = Request-NativeHTMLKitQuit -Application $app
    }

    Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -UntilShutdown
} finally {
    Close-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app
}

items.title: Bulk rename
items.text:
Rename many files with find/replace, a live preview, a confirmation dialog and undo.

Same example in Python: Bulk rename

Real capture on KDE Plasma 6.6 Wayland with the released packages.

What it teaches: Open-NativeHTMLKitFile with index.html and style.css; pure planning logic; live preview; folder dialog fallback; undo.

items.title: Run it
items.text:
pwsh -File bulk-rename/app.ps1

Related guide: project scaffolding

items.title: Source: bulk-rename/app.ps1
items.text:
View on GitHub

# bulk-rename/app.ps1 - rename many files with find/replace, a live preview and undo.
# This is the finished app of the tutorial docs/tutorials/bulk-rename.md.
#
# Teaches: an app split into index.html + style.css + app.ps1 (Open-NativeHTMLKitFile),
# a pure planning function that is easy to test, live preview on input events, the native
# folder picker with a capability fallback, a confirmation <dialog>, per-file error
# handling, and undo.
#
# Run:  pwsh -File ./app.ps1 [-Folder C:\Photos]
#       powershell.exe -NoProfile -File .\app.ps1
# -SelfTest renames files in a temporary folder, undoes it, and quits.
param([string]$Folder, [switch]$SelfTest)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module NativeHTMLKit

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- planning (no UI) --

function Get-RenamePlan {
    # Returns one row per file: Old, New, Status (unchanged | rename | conflict | invalid | error), Note.
    param([string[]]$Names, [string]$Find, [string]$Replace, [bool]$Regex, [bool]$MatchCase)
    $options = [Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions]::None
    if (-not $MatchCase) { $options = [Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions]::IgnoreCase }
    $pattern = $Find
    $replacement = $Replace
    if (-not $Regex) {
        $pattern = [regex]::Escape($Find)
        $replacement = $Replace.Replace('$', '$$')   # literal text, not $1 group references
    }
    $matcher = $null
    $patternError = $null
    if ($Find) {
        try { $matcher = New-Object Text.RegularExpressions.Regex($pattern, $options) }
        catch {
            $reason = $_.Exception
            if ($null -ne $reason.InnerException) { $reason = $reason.InnerException }
            $patternError = 'Invalid pattern: ' + $reason.Message
        }
    }
    $comparer = [StringComparer]::Ordinal
    if ([Environment]::OSVersion.Platform -eq [PlatformID]::Win32NT) { $comparer = [StringComparer]::OrdinalIgnoreCase }
    $existing = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]' -ArgumentList @(, $comparer)
    foreach ($name in $Names) { [void]$existing.Add($name) }
    $claimed = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]' -ArgumentList @(, $comparer)
    $invalid = [IO.Path]::GetInvalidFileNameChars()

    foreach ($name in $Names) {
        $row = [pscustomobject]@{ Old = $name; New = $name; Status = 'unchanged'; Note = '' }
        if ($patternError) { $row.Status = 'error'; $row.Note = $patternError }
        elseif ($null -ne $matcher) {
            $new = $matcher.Replace($name, $replacement)
            $row.New = $new
            if ($new -cne $name) {
                if (-not $new -or $new.IndexOfAny($invalid) -ge 0 -or $new -eq '.' -or $new -eq '..') { $row.Status = 'invalid'; $row.Note = 'Not a valid file name' }
                elseif (($existing.Contains($new) -and -not $comparer.Equals($new, $name)) -or -not $claimed.Add($new)) { $row.Status = 'conflict'; $row.Note = 'Name already used' }
                else { $row.Status = 'rename' }
            }
        }
        $row
    }
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------- the app --

$app = Start-NativeHTMLKitScript -Name 'Bulk rename'
$selfTestFolder = $null
try {
    if ($SelfTest) {
        $selfTestFolder = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('nhk-rename-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
        $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $selfTestFolder
        foreach ($n in 'IMG_0001.jpg', 'IMG_0002.jpg', 'img_0003.JPG', 'notes.txt', 'holiday_0001.jpg') { [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $selfTestFolder $n), $n) }
        $Folder = $selfTestFolder
    }

    $window = New-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Application $app -Title 'Bulk rename' -Width 900 -Height 620 -MinWidth 640 -MinHeight 400
    # Relative URLs in index.html (style.css) resolve against the file's folder.
    $doc = Open-NativeHTMLKitFile -Window $window -Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'index.html')

    $state = @{ Folder = $null; Names = @(); Plan = @(); Undo = @() }
    $caps = Get-NativeHTMLKitCapabilities -Application $app
    if (-not $caps.file_dialogs) { Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentAttribute -Document $doc -Element browse -Name disabled }

    function Read-Rule {
        return @{
            Find = Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element find
            Replace = Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element replace
            Regex = Get-NativeHTMLKitChecked -Document $doc -Element regex
            MatchCase = Get-NativeHTMLKitChecked -Document $doc -Element case
        }
    }

    function Update-Preview {
        $rule = Read-Rule
        $state.Plan = @(Get-RenamePlan -Names $state.Names -Find $rule.Find -Replace $rule.Replace -Regex $rule.Regex -MatchCase $rule.MatchCase)
        $html = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
        foreach ($row in $state.Plan) {
            $status = $row.Status
            if ($row.Note) { $status = $row.Note }
            [void]$html.Append("<tr class=`"$($row.Status)`"><td>" + [Net.WebUtility]::HtmlEncode($row.Old) + '</td><td>' +
                [Net.WebUtility]::HtmlEncode($row.New) + '</td><td>' + [Net.WebUtility]::HtmlEncode($status) + '</td></tr>')
        }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentHtml -Document $doc -Element preview -Html $html.ToString()
        $count = @($state.Plan | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq 'rename' }).Count
        $blocked = @($state.Plan | Where-Object { $_.Status -in 'conflict', 'invalid', 'error' }).Count
        $summary = "$($state.Names.Count) file(s), $count to rename"
        if ($blocked) { $summary += ", $blocked skipped" }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element summary -Text $summary
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element apply -Text "Rename $count"
        if ($count -gt 0) { Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentAttribute -Document $doc -Element apply -Name disabled -Remove }
        else { Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentAttribute -Document $doc -Element apply -Name disabled }
    }

    function Update-FileList {
        $state.Names = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $state.Folder -File | Sort-Object Name | ForEach-Object { $_.Name })
        Update-Preview
    }

    function Open-Folder([string]$Path) {
        if (-not $Path -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path -PathType Container)) {
            Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element summary -Text 'That folder does not exist.'
            return
        }
        $state.Folder = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $Path).ProviderPath
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element folder -Value $state.Folder
        Set-Undo @()
        Update-FileList
    }

    function Set-Undo($Steps) {
        $state.Undo = @($Steps)
        if ($state.Undo.Count -gt 0) { Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentAttribute -Document $doc -Element undo -Name disabled -Remove }
        else { Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentAttribute -Document $doc -Element undo -Name disabled }
    }

    function Invoke-Rename {
        $done = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
        $failed = 0
        foreach ($row in @($state.Plan | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq 'rename' })) {
            try {
                Rename-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $state.Folder $row.Old) -NewName $row.New
                [void]$done.Add(@{ From = $row.Old; To = $row.New })
            } catch { $failed++ }   # in use, permission denied, or changed since the preview
        }
        Set-Undo $done.ToArray()
        Update-FileList
        $message = "Renamed $($done.Count) file(s)."
        if ($failed) { $message += " $failed failed (in use, permission denied or changed)." }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element summary -Text $message
    }

    function Undo-Rename {
        if ($state.Undo.Count -eq 0) { return }
        $restored = 0
        # Reverse order, so chains such as a->b, b->c are undone correctly.
        foreach ($step in $state.Undo[($state.Undo.Count - 1)..0]) {
            try { Rename-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $state.Folder $step.To) -NewName $step.From; $restored++ } catch { $null = $_ }
        }
        Set-Undo @()
        Update-FileList
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element summary -Text "Restored $restored file name(s)."
    }

    function Confirm-Rename([bool]$Yes) {
        Show-NativeHTMLKitHtmlDialog -Document $doc -Element confirm -Close -ReturnValue ''
        if ($Yes) { Invoke-Rename }
    }

    # Live preview: every keystroke or checkbox change in the rule form.
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type input -Element rule -Callback { Update-Preview }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type change -Element rule -Callback { Update-Preview }
    # Enter in a rule field submits the form: treat it as "update preview", nothing else.
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type submit -Element rule -Callback { Update-Preview }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element load -Callback { Open-Folder (Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element folder) }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element browse -Callback {
        try { $picked = Show-NativeHTMLKitFileDialog -Window $window -Kind ChooseFolder -Title 'Folder with files to rename' }
        catch [NativeHTMLKit.RpcException] { Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element summary -Text $_.Exception.RpcMessage; return }
        if (-not $picked.cancelled) { Open-Folder @($picked.paths)[0] }
    }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element apply -Callback {
        $count = @($state.Plan | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq 'rename' }).Count
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element confirm-text -Text "Rename $count file(s) in $($state.Folder)?"
        Show-NativeHTMLKitHtmlDialog -Document $doc -Element confirm
    }
    # Decide in the button handlers, not in the dialog's close event: a <dialog> keeps its
    # previous return value when the user dismisses it with Escape.
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element confirm-no -Callback { Confirm-Rename $false }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element confirm-yes -Callback { Confirm-Rename $true }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element undo -Callback { Undo-Rename }

    if ($Folder) { Open-Folder $Folder }
    Set-NativeHTMLKitReady -Application $app

    if ($SelfTest) {
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element find -Value '^img_(\d+)'
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element replace -Value 'photo-$1'
        Set-NativeHTMLKitChecked -Document $doc -Element regex -Checked $true
        Update-Preview
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element summary) -ne '5 file(s), 3 to rename') { throw 'unexpected regex preview' }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitChecked -Document $doc -Element case -Checked $true
        Update-Preview
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element summary) -ne '5 file(s), 1 to rename') { throw 'match case not applied' }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element find -Value '('
        Update-Preview
        if ((Find-NativeHTMLKitElement -Document $doc -Selector '#preview tr.error').matched_nodes -ne 5) { throw 'invalid pattern not reported' }
        # Literal mode: '0001' -> 'notes' clashes with nothing, but two files would get the same name.
        Set-NativeHTMLKitChecked -Document $doc -Element regex -Checked $false
        Set-NativeHTMLKitChecked -Document $doc -Element case -Checked $false
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element find -Value 'holiday'
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element replace -Value 'IMG'
        Update-Preview
        if ((Find-NativeHTMLKitElement -Document $doc -Selector '#preview tr.conflict').matched_nodes -ne 1) { throw 'conflict not detected' }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element find -Value 'IMG_'
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element replace -Value '2026 $ '
        Update-Preview
        # The confirm path: the dialog opens, the user picks "Rename".
        Show-NativeHTMLKitHtmlDialog -Document $doc -Element confirm
        Confirm-Rename $true
        if ((Invoke-NativeHTMLKitDocumentCommand -Document $doc -Operation get_dialog -Parameters @{ element = 'confirm' }).open) { throw 'dialog still open' }
        $names = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $selfTestFolder -File | ForEach-Object { $_.Name } | Sort-Object)
        if (-not ($names -contains '2026 $ 0001.jpg') -or -not ($names -contains '2026 $ 0003.JPG')) { throw "rename failed: $($names -join ', ')" }
        Undo-Rename
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element summary) -ne 'Restored 3 file name(s).') { throw 'undo failed' }
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $selfTestFolder 'img_0003.JPG'))) { throw 'original name not restored' }
        [Console]::Out.WriteLine('SELFTEST PASS bulk-rename')
        $null = Request-NativeHTMLKitQuit -Application $app
    }

    Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -UntilShutdown
} finally {
    Close-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app
    if ($selfTestFolder) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $selfTestFolder -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
}

items.title: Checksums
items.text:
SHA-256 of every file in a folder, computed in the background with progress, cancel and a quit warning.

Same example in Python: Checksums

Real capture on KDE Plasma 6.6 Wayland with the released packages.

What it teaches: Start-NativeHTMLKitTask; throttled progress in batches; Stop-NativeHTMLKitTask; Set-NativeHTMLKitBeforeQuit.

items.title: Run it
items.text:
pwsh -File 11-background-checksums.ps1 [-Folder FOLDER]

Related guide: background work

items.title: Source: 11-background-checksums.ps1
items.text:
View on GitHub

# 11-background-checksums.ps1 - hash every file of a folder in background tasks, with
# progress and cancel.
#
# Teaches: keeping slow work OFF the event callback (callbacks run one at a time, so a long
# job there would delay every later event); Start-NativeHTMLKitTask (work in an isolated
# runspace, plain data in and out) split into batches of about 0.2 s, so each -OnCompleted
# updates the document a few times per second and starts the next batch; cancelling with
# Stop-NativeHTMLKitTask (-OnFailed receives an OperationCanceledException); one atomic
# Invoke-NativeHTMLKitBatch per progress update; Set-NativeHTMLKitBeforeQuit asking before
# quitting while a job is running; the native folder dialog; file names are untrusted text,
# encoded with [Net.WebUtility]::HtmlEncode.
#
# Run:  pwsh -File ./11-background-checksums.ps1 [[-Folder] C:\Tools]    (default: the current directory;
#       -Path is accepted as an alias, and the folder may also be given without a name)
#       powershell.exe -NoProfile -File .\11-background-checksums.ps1
# Type or browse to a folder, then press Start.
# -SelfTest hashes a scratch folder, checks hashes, rows, escaping, progress, a bad folder,
# cancel and the quit veto, and quits.
param([Alias('Path')][string]$Folder, [switch]$SelfTest)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module NativeHTMLKit

$app = Start-NativeHTMLKitScript -Name 'Checksums'
try {
    $window = New-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Application $app -Title 'Checksums' -Width 760 -Height 560
    $doc = Open-NativeHTMLKitHtml -Window $window -Html @'
<!doctype html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>
  body { margin:0; padding:16px 20px; font:14px sans-serif; background:#f5f6f9; color:#1d2230; }
  h1 { font-size:20px; margin:0 0 10px; }
  form { display:flex; gap:8px; }
  input[type=text] { flex:1; padding:7px; font-family:monospace; }
  button { padding:6px 12px; }
  .progress { height:8px; background:#e0e4ec; border-radius:4px; margin:12px 0 6px; }
  #bar { height:8px; width:0%; background:#3b74e8; border-radius:4px; }
  #warning { display:none; background:#fff0c9; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:6px; }
  #warning.shown { display:block; }
  table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; background:#fff; font-size:12px; }
  td { padding:4px 8px; border-bottom:1px solid #e6e8ee; font-family:monospace; }
  td.size { text-align:right; color:#5f6879; }
</style></head>
<body>
  <h1>Folder checksums (SHA-256)</h1>
  <form id="job"><input id="folder" type="text" placeholder="Folder path" required>
    <button id="browse" type="button">Browse…</button>
    <button id="start" type="submit">Start</button><button id="cancel" type="button">Cancel</button></form>
  <div class="progress"><div id="bar"></div></div>
  <p id="status">Idle.</p>
  <p id="warning">A job is still running. Cancel it, or quit again to stop it.</p>
  <table><tbody id="results"></tbody></table>
</body></html>
'@

    # ----- background work: isolated runspaces without this script's variables or modules -----
    # Lists the files below Root as relative '/' names, sorted like paths (part by part).
    $listFiles = {
        param([string]$Root)
        $comparer = [StringComparer]::Ordinal
        if ([IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar -eq '\') { $comparer = [StringComparer]::OrdinalIgnoreCase }
        [string[]]$names = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Root -File -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            ForEach-Object { $_.FullName.Substring($Root.Length).TrimStart('\', '/').Replace('\', '/') })
        [string[]]$keys = @($names | ForEach-Object { $_.Replace('/', [string][char]0) })   # '/' sorts before every character
        if ($names.Count -gt 1) { [Array]::Sort($keys, $names, $comparer) }
        $names
    }
    # Hashes files in order until about BudgetMilliseconds have passed (at least one file).
    # Reading 1 MB chunks in a PowerShell loop lets Stop-NativeHTMLKitTask stop it between chunks.
    $hashFiles = {
        param([string]$Root, [string[]]$Names, [int]$BudgetMilliseconds)
        $clock = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
        $buffer = New-Object byte[] (1024 * 1024)
        foreach ($name in $Names) {
            $path = [IO.Path]::Combine($Root, $name)
            $size = [long]0
            try {
                $size = (New-Object IO.FileInfo $path).Length
                $sha = [Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
                $stream = [IO.File]::OpenRead($path)
                try {
                    while (($read = $stream.Read($buffer, 0, $buffer.Length)) -gt 0) { [void]$sha.TransformBlock($buffer, 0, $read, $null, 0) }
                    [void]$sha.TransformFinalBlock($buffer, 0, 0)
                    $digest = ([BitConverter]::ToString($sha.Hash) -replace '-', '').ToLowerInvariant()
                } finally { $stream.Dispose(); $sha.Dispose() }
            } catch [Management.Automation.PipelineStoppedException] {
                throw                                        # Stop-NativeHTMLKitTask: end now
            } catch {
                $digest = 'unreadable (' + $_.Exception.Message + ')'
            }
            [pscustomobject]@{ Name = $name; Hash = $digest; Size = $size }
            if ($clock.ElapsedMilliseconds -gt $BudgetMilliseconds) { break }
        }
    }

    # ----- UI side: everything below runs on this runspace -----
    $job = @{ Task = $null; Running = $false; Cancel = $false; QuitWarned = $false; Root = ''; Files = @(); Next = 0; Results = [ordered]@{} }

    function Set-Status([string]$Text) { Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element status -Text $Text }

    function Send-Progress([string]$Rows, [int]$Done, [int]$Total) {
        $operations = @(
            @{ op = 'set_attribute'; element = 'bar'; name = 'style'; value = ('width:' + [Math]::Floor($Done * 100 / [Math]::Max($Total, 1)) + '%') }
            @{ op = 'set_text'; element = 'status'; text = "Hashing… $Done/$Total" })
        if ($Rows) { $operations = @(@{ op = 'insert_html'; element = 'results'; position = 'beforeend'; html = $Rows }) + $operations }
        Invoke-NativeHTMLKitBatch -Document $doc -Operations $operations
    }

    function Complete-Job {
        $job.Running = $false
        $job.Task = $null
        Send-Progress '' $job.Results.Count $job.Files.Count
        $word = 'Done:'
        if ($job.Cancel) { $word = 'Cancelled after' }
        Set-Status "$word $($job.Results.Count) of $($job.Files.Count) file(s)."
        Set-NativeHTMLKitClass -Document $doc -Element warning -Name shown -Remove
    }

    function Start-NextBatch {
        $names = @($job.Files[$job.Next..($job.Files.Count - 1)])
        # Inside @(...) the array stays ONE argument (the scriptblock's -Names parameter).
        $job.Task = Start-NativeHTMLKitTask -Application $app -ScriptBlock $hashFiles -ArgumentList @($job.Root, [string[]]$names, 200) -OnCompleted {
            param($items)
            $rows = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
            foreach ($item in @($items)) {
                $job.Results[$item.Name] = $item.Hash
                [void]$rows.Append('<tr><td>' + [Net.WebUtility]::HtmlEncode($item.Hash) + '</td><td>' + [Net.WebUtility]::HtmlEncode($item.Name) + '</td>' +
                    '<td class="size">' + ([long]$item.Size).ToString('N0', [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture) + '</td></tr>')
            }
            $job.Next += @($items).Count
            Send-Progress $rows.ToString() $job.Results.Count $job.Files.Count
            if ($job.Cancel -or $job.Next -ge $job.Files.Count) { Complete-Job } else { Start-NextBatch }
        } -OnFailed {
            param($failure)
            if ($failure -is [OperationCanceledException]) { Complete-Job; return }
            $job.Running = $false
            Set-Status ('Failed: ' + $failure.Message)
        }
    }

    function Start-Checksums([string]$Path) {
        if ($job.Running) { Set-Status 'A job is already running.'; return $null }
        if (-not $Path -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path -PathType Container)) { Set-Status "Not a folder: $Path"; return $null }
        $job.Root = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $Path).ProviderPath
        $job.Cancel = $false; $job.QuitWarned = $false; $job.Results = [ordered]@{}; $job.Files = @(); $job.Next = 0
        $job.Running = $true
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentHtml -Document $doc -Element results -Html ''
        $job.Task = Start-NativeHTMLKitTask -Application $app -ScriptBlock $listFiles -ArgumentList @($job.Root) -OnCompleted {
            param($names)
            $job.Files = @($names)
            if ($job.Cancel -or $job.Files.Count -eq 0) { Complete-Job } else { Start-NextBatch }
        } -OnFailed {
            param($failure)
            $job.Running = $false
            Set-Status ('Failed: ' + $failure.Message)
        }
        return $job.Task
    }

    function Stop-Checksums {
        if (-not $job.Running) { return }
        $job.Cancel = $true
        # Listing is left to finish so the total is known; a hashing batch is stopped.
        if ($job.Files.Count -gt 0 -and $null -ne $job.Task) { Stop-NativeHTMLKitTask -Task $job.Task }
    }

    function Select-Folder {
        try {
            # Waits (pumping events) until the user picks or cancels.
            $result = Show-NativeHTMLKitFileDialog -Window $window -Kind ChooseFolder -Title 'Choose a folder to hash'
        } catch [NativeHTMLKit.RpcException] {
            Set-Status "Folder dialog unavailable (code $($_.Exception.Code)); type a path instead."
            return
        }
        $paths = @($result.paths)
        if (-not $result.cancelled -and $paths.Count -gt 0) { Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element folder -Value ([string]$paths[0]) }
    }

    # The host's quit request: the first while busy is refused with a warning, a second is allowed.
    function Test-MayQuit {
        if ($job.Running -and -not $job.QuitWarned) {
            $job.QuitWarned = $true
            Set-NativeHTMLKitClass -Document $doc -Element warning -Name shown
            return $false
        }
        $job.Cancel = $true
        if ($null -ne $job.Task) { Stop-NativeHTMLKitTask -Task $job.Task }
        return $true
    }

    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type submit -Element job -Callback {
        $null = Start-Checksums (Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element folder).Trim()
    }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element cancel -Callback { Stop-Checksums }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element browse -Callback { Select-Folder }
    Set-NativeHTMLKitBeforeQuit -Application $app -Callback { Test-MayQuit }

    if (-not $Folder) { $Folder = (Get-Location).ProviderPath }
    Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element folder -Value $Folder
    Set-NativeHTMLKitReady -Application $app

    if ($SelfTest) {
        function Wait-For([scriptblock]$Condition, [int]$TimeoutMilliseconds = 30000) {
            $clock = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
            while (-not (& $Condition)) {
                if ($clock.ElapsedMilliseconds -gt $TimeoutMilliseconds) { return $false }
                $null = Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -TimeoutMilliseconds 50
            }
            return $true
        }
        function Assert-Check([string]$Name, [bool]$Ok, [string]$Detail = '') { if (-not $Ok) { throw "check failed: $Name $Detail" } }
        function Get-Sha256([byte[]]$Bytes) {
            $sha = [Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
            try { return ([BitConverter]::ToString($sha.ComputeHash($Bytes)) -replace '-', '').ToLowerInvariant() } finally { $sha.Dispose() }
        }
        function Test-WarningShown { return ([string](Invoke-NativeHTMLKitDocumentCommand -Document $doc -Operation get_attribute -Parameters @{ element = 'warning'; name = 'class' }).value) -match '\bshown\b' }

        $scratch = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('nhk-checksums-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
        $unsafe = 'sub/b & <x>.bin'
        if ([IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar -eq '\') { $unsafe = "sub/b & 'x' &.bin" }
        $big = New-Object byte[] (256 * 4000)
        for ($i = 0; $i -lt $big.Length; $i++) { $big[$i] = [byte]($i % 256) }
        $files = [ordered]@{ 'a.txt' = [Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetBytes('alpha'); $unsafe = $big; 'c.md' = (New-Object byte[] 0) }
        try {
            foreach ($name in $files.Keys) {
                $path = [IO.Path]::Combine($scratch, $name)
                $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path ([IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($path))
                [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($path, $files[$name])
            }
            $worker = Start-Checksums $scratch
            Assert-Check 'checksum.worker_started' ($null -ne $worker)
            Assert-Check 'checksum.finished' (Wait-For { -not $job.Running })
            $ok = $job.Results.Count -eq $files.Count
            foreach ($name in $files.Keys) { if (-not $job.Results.Contains($name) -or $job.Results[$name] -ne (Get-Sha256 $files[$name])) { $ok = $false } }
            Assert-Check 'checksum.hashes_correct' $ok
            Assert-Check 'checksum.rows_rendered' ((Find-NativeHTMLKitElement -Document $doc -Selector '#results tr').matched_nodes -eq 3)
            Assert-Check 'checksum.names_escaped' ((Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element results).Contains($unsafe))
            $status = Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element status
            Assert-Check 'checksum.status_done' ($status -eq 'Done: 3 of 3 file(s).') $status
            $style = (Invoke-NativeHTMLKitDocumentCommand -Document $doc -Operation get_attribute -Parameters @{ element = 'bar'; name = 'style' }).value
            Assert-Check 'checksum.progress_full' ($style -eq 'width:100%') $style
            Assert-Check 'checksum.bad_folder' ($null -eq (Start-Checksums (Join-Path $scratch 'missing')) -and (Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element status).StartsWith('Not a folder'))
            # Cancel during listing: the listing finishes, then nothing is hashed.
            $null = Start-Checksums $scratch
            Stop-Checksums
            Assert-Check 'checksum.cancel' ((Wait-For { -not $job.Running }) -and (Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element status) -eq 'Cancelled after 0 of 3 file(s).')
            Select-Folder   # headless: no folder dialog, the fallback message is shown
            $status = Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element status
            Assert-Check 'checksum.browse_handled' ($status -match '^Folder dialog unavailable \(code -?\d+\); type a path instead\.$' -or $status -eq 'Cancelled after 0 of 3 file(s).') $status
            # Quit while busy: simulate a running job; the first quit is refused, the second allowed.
            $job.Task = Start-NativeHTMLKitTask -Application $app -ScriptBlock { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 1500 } -OnFailed { param($failure) $null = $failure }
            $job.Running = $true; $job.QuitWarned = $false
            Assert-Check 'checksum.quit_vetoed_while_busy' (-not (Test-MayQuit) -and (Test-WarningShown))
            Assert-Check 'checksum.second_quit_allowed' (Test-MayQuit)
        } finally {
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $scratch -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        }
        [Console]::Out.WriteLine('SELFTEST PASS 11-background-checksums')
        $null = Request-NativeHTMLKitQuit -Application $app
    }

    Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -UntilShutdown
} finally {
    Close-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app
}

items.title: Clipboard tool
items.text:
Text transforms, copy and paste, a documentation link and the desktop colour scheme.

Same example in Python: Clipboard tool

Real capture on KDE Plasma 6.6 Wayland with the released packages.

What it teaches: Get-/Set-NativeHTMLKitClipboard; link_activated and Open-NativeHTMLKitExternal; desktop preferences and capabilities; -32001 fallback; delegated toolbar clicks; UTF-16 selection offsets.

items.title: Run it
items.text:
pwsh -File 10-clipboard-tool.ps1

Related guide: clipboard and desktop

items.title: Source: 10-clipboard-tool.ps1
items.text:
View on GitHub

# 10-clipboard-tool.ps1 - transform text and move it through the system clipboard.
#
# Teaches: Get-/Set-NativeHTMLKitClipboard (plain text only). The link_activated event and
# Open-NativeHTMLKitExternal to open a link in the browser. Get-NativeHTMLKitPreferences, the
# desktop.preferences_changed notification and Get-NativeHTMLKitCapabilities. Checking
# capabilities and handling NativeHTMLKit.RpcException -32001 ("unsupported here") gracefully.
# One delegated click handler for a toolbar of buttons. Get-/Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue and
# the UTF-16 based offsets of Get-NativeHTMLKitSelection.
#
# Run:  pwsh -File ./10-clipboard-tool.ps1     (or powershell.exe -NoProfile -File .\10-clipboard-tool.ps1)
# -SelfTest applies the transforms through the public API and quits. In the host's headless test
# mode the clipboard and external open are unavailable, so it checks those messages instead.
param([switch]$SelfTest)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module NativeHTMLKit

$docsUrl = 'https://github.com/nativehtmlkit/nativehtmlkit-powershell'

# ----- text transforms (plain PowerShell, no SDK calls) -----
function Split-Lines([string]$Text) {
    # Line breaks as in Python's str.splitlines: no empty item after a final line break.
    if ($Text.Length -eq 0) { return , @() }
    $lines = [regex]::Split($Text, '\r\n|[\n\r\v\f\x1c\x1d\x1e\x85  ]')
    if ($Text -match '(\r\n|[\n\r\v\f\x1c\x1d\x1e\x85  ])\z') { $lines = $lines[0..($lines.Count - 2)] }
    return , @($lines)
}

function ConvertTo-TitleCase([string]$Text) {
    # A letter after a cased letter becomes lower case, every other letter upper case.
    $builder = New-Object Text.StringBuilder($Text.Length)
    $previousCased = $false
    foreach ($c in $Text.ToCharArray()) {
        $upper = [char]::ToUpperInvariant($c); $lower = [char]::ToLowerInvariant($c)
        $cased = $upper -cne $lower
        if ($cased -and $previousCased) { [void]$builder.Append($lower) }
        elseif ($cased) { [void]$builder.Append($upper) }
        else { [void]$builder.Append($c) }
        $previousCased = $cased
    }
    return $builder.ToString()
}

function Get-SortedLines([string]$Text) {
    # Case-insensitive and stable: equal lines keep their order (the index breaks ties).
    $lines = Split-Lines $Text
    $keys = New-Object 'string[]' $lines.Count
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) { $keys[$i] = $lines[$i].ToLowerInvariant() + [char]0 + $i.ToString('D10') }
    $sorted = [string[]]$lines.Clone()
    [Array]::Sort($keys, $sorted, [StringComparer]::Ordinal)
    return ($sorted -join "`n")
}

function Get-UniqueLines([string]$Text) {
    $seen = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]' ([StringComparer]::Ordinal)
    $lines = Split-Lines $Text
    return (@($lines | Where-Object { $seen.Add($_) }) -join "`n")
}

function Format-Json([string]$Text) {
    # Re-indents JSON with two spaces, like Python's json.dumps(indent=2, ensure_ascii=False).
    # ConvertTo-Json is not used: its layout differs between PowerShell 5.1 and 7.
    $script:jsonText = $Text; $script:jsonAt = 0
    function Stop-Json([string]$Message, [int]$At) {
        $before = $script:jsonText.Substring(0, $At)
        $line = 1 + ([regex]::Matches($before, "`n")).Count
        $column = $At - $before.LastIndexOf([char]10)
        throw (New-Object FormatException("${Message}: line $line column $column (char $At)"))
    }
    function Skip-Space { while ($script:jsonAt -lt $script:jsonText.Length -and " `t`n`r".IndexOf($script:jsonText[$script:jsonAt]) -ge 0) { $script:jsonAt++ } }
    function Read-JsonString {
        $start = $script:jsonAt; $script:jsonAt++
        $out = New-Object Text.StringBuilder
        while ($true) {
            if ($script:jsonAt -ge $script:jsonText.Length) { Stop-Json 'Unterminated string starting at' $start }
            $c = $script:jsonText[$script:jsonAt]
            if ($c -eq '"') { $script:jsonAt++; return $out.ToString() }
            if ([int]$c -lt 0x20) { Stop-Json 'Invalid control character at' $script:jsonAt }
            if ($c -ne '\') { [void]$out.Append($c); $script:jsonAt++; continue }
            $escape = ''
            if ($script:jsonAt + 1 -lt $script:jsonText.Length) { $escape = [string]$script:jsonText[$script:jsonAt + 1] }
            $simple = @{ '"' = '"'; '\' = '\'; '/' = '/'; 'b' = "`b"; 'f' = "`f"; 'n' = "`n"; 'r' = "`r"; 't' = "`t" }
            if ($escape -and $simple.ContainsKey($escape) -and $escape -cmatch '^["\\/bfnrt]$') { [void]$out.Append($simple[$escape]); $script:jsonAt += 2; continue }
            if ($escape -ceq 'u' -and $script:jsonText.Length -ge $script:jsonAt + 6 -and $script:jsonText.Substring($script:jsonAt + 2, 4) -match '^[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}$') {
                [void]$out.Append([char][Convert]::ToInt32($script:jsonText.Substring($script:jsonAt + 2, 4), 16)); $script:jsonAt += 6; continue
            }
            Stop-Json 'Invalid \escape' $script:jsonAt
        }
    }
    function Read-JsonValue {
        Skip-Space
        if ($script:jsonAt -ge $script:jsonText.Length) { Stop-Json 'Expecting value' $script:jsonAt }
        $c = $script:jsonText[$script:jsonAt]
        if ($c -eq '{') {
            $script:jsonAt++
            $members = New-Object Collections.Specialized.OrderedDictionary   # a repeated key keeps its place, the last value wins
            Skip-Space
            if ($script:jsonAt -lt $script:jsonText.Length -and $script:jsonText[$script:jsonAt] -eq '}') { $script:jsonAt++; return , $members }
            while ($true) {
                Skip-Space
                if ($script:jsonAt -ge $script:jsonText.Length -or $script:jsonText[$script:jsonAt] -ne '"') { Stop-Json 'Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes' $script:jsonAt }
                $key = Read-JsonString
                Skip-Space
                if ($script:jsonAt -ge $script:jsonText.Length -or $script:jsonText[$script:jsonAt] -ne ':') { Stop-Json "Expecting ':' delimiter" $script:jsonAt }
                $script:jsonAt++
                $members[$key] = Read-JsonValue
                Skip-Space
                if ($script:jsonAt -lt $script:jsonText.Length -and $script:jsonText[$script:jsonAt] -eq '}') { $script:jsonAt++; return , $members }
                if ($script:jsonAt -ge $script:jsonText.Length -or $script:jsonText[$script:jsonAt] -ne ',') { Stop-Json "Expecting ',' delimiter" $script:jsonAt }
                $comma = $script:jsonAt; $script:jsonAt++; Skip-Space
                if ($script:jsonAt -lt $script:jsonText.Length -and $script:jsonText[$script:jsonAt] -eq '}') { Stop-Json 'Illegal trailing comma before end of object' $comma }
            }
        }
        if ($c -eq '[') {
            $script:jsonAt++
            $items = New-Object Collections.ArrayList
            Skip-Space
            if ($script:jsonAt -lt $script:jsonText.Length -and $script:jsonText[$script:jsonAt] -eq ']') { $script:jsonAt++; return , $items }
            while ($true) {
                [void]$items.Add((Read-JsonValue))
                Skip-Space
                if ($script:jsonAt -lt $script:jsonText.Length -and $script:jsonText[$script:jsonAt] -eq ']') { $script:jsonAt++; return , $items }
                if ($script:jsonAt -ge $script:jsonText.Length -or $script:jsonText[$script:jsonAt] -ne ',') { Stop-Json "Expecting ',' delimiter" $script:jsonAt }
                $comma = $script:jsonAt; $script:jsonAt++; Skip-Space
                if ($script:jsonAt -lt $script:jsonText.Length -and $script:jsonText[$script:jsonAt] -eq ']') { Stop-Json 'Illegal trailing comma before end of array' $comma }
            }
        }
        if ($c -eq '"') { return (ConvertTo-JsonString (Read-JsonString)) }
        $rest = $script:jsonText.Substring($script:jsonAt)
        foreach ($word in 'true', 'false', 'null', 'NaN', 'Infinity', '-Infinity') {
            if ($rest.StartsWith($word, [StringComparison]::Ordinal)) { $script:jsonAt += $word.Length; return $word }
        }
        $number = [regex]::Match($rest, '^-?(0|[1-9][0-9]*)(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?')
        if (-not $number.Success) { Stop-Json 'Expecting value' $script:jsonAt }
        $script:jsonAt += $number.Length
        if (-not $number.Groups[2].Success -and -not $number.Groups[3].Success) { return ($number.Value -replace '^-0$', '0') }
        try { $double = [double]::Parse($number.Value, [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture) }
        catch [OverflowException] { $double = [double]::PositiveInfinity; if ($number.Value.StartsWith('-')) { $double = [double]::NegativeInfinity } }   # .NET Framework
        return (ConvertTo-PythonFloat $double)
    }
    function ConvertTo-JsonString([string]$Value) {
        $out = New-Object Text.StringBuilder('"')
        foreach ($c in $Value.ToCharArray()) {
            # Compare code points: culture-aware string comparison ignores control characters.
            switch ([int]$c) {
                0x22 { [void]$out.Append('\"') } 0x5C { [void]$out.Append('\\') } 0x0A { [void]$out.Append('\n') }
                0x0D { [void]$out.Append('\r') } 0x09 { [void]$out.Append('\t') } 0x08 { [void]$out.Append('\b') } 0x0C { [void]$out.Append('\f') }
                default { if ([int]$c -lt 0x20) { [void]$out.Append(('\u{0:x4}' -f [int]$c)) } else { [void]$out.Append($c) } }
            }
        }
        return $out.Append('"').ToString()
    }
    function ConvertTo-PythonFloat([double]$Value) {
        # Shortest round-trip digits, laid out as Python's repr(float) does.
        if ([double]::IsPositiveInfinity($Value)) { return 'Infinity' }
        if ([double]::IsNegativeInfinity($Value)) { return '-Infinity' }
        $sign = ''
        if ($Value -lt 0 -or ($Value -eq 0 -and [BitConverter]::DoubleToInt64Bits($Value) -lt 0)) { $sign = '-'; $Value = -$Value }
        if ($Value -eq 0) { return $sign + '0.0' }
        $m = $null
        for ($precision = 1; $precision -le 17; $precision++) {
            $candidate = $Value.ToString('E' + ($precision - 1), [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
            if ([double]::Parse($candidate, [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture) -eq $Value) { $m = [regex]::Match($candidate, '^(\d)\.?(\d*)E([-+]\d+)$'); break }
        }
        $digits = ($m.Groups[1].Value + $m.Groups[2].Value).TrimEnd('0')
        if (-not $digits) { $digits = '0' }
        $point = [int]$m.Groups[3].Value + 1          # value = 0.<digits> x 10^point
        if ($point -gt 16 -or $point -lt -3) {
            $mantissa = $digits.Substring(0, 1)
            if ($digits.Length -gt 1) { $mantissa += '.' + $digits.Substring(1) }
            $exponent = $point - 1
            $expSign = '+'
            if ($exponent -lt 0) { $expSign = '-' }
            return $sign + $mantissa + 'e' + $expSign + ([Math]::Abs($exponent)).ToString('00')
        }
        if ($point -le 0) { return $sign + '0.' + ('0' * (-$point)) + $digits }
        if ($point -ge $digits.Length) { return $sign + $digits + ('0' * ($point - $digits.Length)) + '.0' }
        return $sign + $digits.Substring(0, $point) + '.' + $digits.Substring($point)
    }
    function Write-JsonValue($Node, [string]$Indent) {
        $inner = $Indent + '  '
        if ($Node -is [Collections.Specialized.OrderedDictionary]) {
            if ($Node.Count -eq 0) { return '{}' }
            $parts = foreach ($key in $Node.Keys) { $inner + (ConvertTo-JsonString $key) + ': ' + (Write-JsonValue $Node[$key] $inner) }
            return "{`n" + (@($parts) -join ",`n") + "`n$Indent}"
        }
        if ($Node -is [Collections.ArrayList]) {
            if ($Node.Count -eq 0) { return '[]' }
            $parts = foreach ($item in $Node) { $inner + (Write-JsonValue $item $inner) }
            return "[`n" + (@($parts) -join ",`n") + "`n$Indent]"
        }
        return [string]$Node
    }
    $tree = Read-JsonValue
    Skip-Space
    if ($script:jsonAt -lt $script:jsonText.Length) { Stop-Json 'Extra data' $script:jsonAt }
    return (Write-JsonValue $tree '')
}

$transforms = @{
    upper = { param($t) $t.ToUpperInvariant() }
    lower = { param($t) $t.ToLowerInvariant() }
    title = { param($t) ConvertTo-TitleCase $t }
    trim = { param($t) $lines = Split-Lines $t; (@($lines | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() }) -join "`n") }
    sort = { param($t) Get-SortedLines $t }
    unique = { param($t) Get-UniqueLines $t }
    json = { param($t) Format-Json $t }
}

$app = Start-NativeHTMLKitScript -Name 'Clipboard tool'
try {
    $window = New-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Application $app -Title 'Clipboard tool' -Width 720 -Height 560
    $doc = Open-NativeHTMLKitHtml -Window $window -Html @'
<!doctype html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>
  body { margin:0; padding:16px 20px; font:14px sans-serif; background:#f7f7fa; color:#22252d; }
  h1 { font-size:20px; margin:0 0 10px; }
  .toolbar { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px; margin-bottom:8px; }
  button { padding:6px 10px; border:1px solid #b9bfcc; border-radius:5px; background:#fff; cursor:pointer; }
  button.primary { background:#2d6be0; color:#fff; border-color:#2d6be0; }
  textarea { width:100%; height:260px; box-sizing:border-box; padding:10px; font:13px monospace; }
  footer { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; color:#61697a; margin-top:8px; }
  a { color:#2d6be0; }
</style></head>
<body>
  <h1>Clipboard tool</h1>
  <div class="toolbar" id="toolbar">
    <button id="t-upper">UPPER</button><button id="t-lower">lower</button><button id="t-title">Title</button>
    <button id="t-trim">Trim lines</button><button id="t-sort">Sort lines</button>
    <button id="t-unique">Unique lines</button><button id="t-json">Format JSON</button>
    <button id="paste" class="primary">Paste</button><button id="copy" class="primary">Copy</button>
  </div>
  <textarea id="text" spellcheck="false">  banana
Apple
cherry
apple
  {"name": "NativeHTMLKit", "native": true}</textarea>
  <footer><span id="stats"></span><span id="status"></span></footer>
  <p>Theme reported by the desktop: <b id="scheme">unknown</b> ·
     <a id="docs" href="https://github.com/nativehtmlkit/nativehtmlkit-powershell">Open the SDK documentation</a></p>
</body></html>
'@

    $features = (Get-NativeHTMLKitCapabilities -Application $app).features
    # 'available' is $true/$false once observed and $null when not known yet.
    $script:clipboardKnownUnavailable = $false
    if ($null -ne $features -and $null -ne $features.clipboard_text) { $script:clipboardKnownUnavailable = $features.clipboard_text.available -is [bool] -and -not $features.clipboard_text.available }

    function Set-Status([string]$Text) { Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element status -Text $Text }

    function Get-UnsupportedMessage([string]$What, [NativeHTMLKit.RpcException]$RpcError) {
        if ($RpcError.Code -eq -32001 -or $script:clipboardKnownUnavailable) { return "$What is not available in this session." }
        return "$What failed (code $($RpcError.Code))."
    }

    function Update-Stats {
        $text = Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element text
        $selection = Get-NativeHTMLKitSelection -Document $doc -Element text    # offsets are UTF-16 code units
        $characters = $text.Length - [regex]::Matches($text, '[\uDC00-\uDFFF]').Count   # code points
        $words = @($text -split '\s+' | Where-Object { $_ }).Count
        $lines = (Split-Lines $text).Count
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element stats -Text "$characters characters · $words words · $lines lines · cursor at $($selection.start)"
    }

    function Invoke-Transform([string]$Name) {
        $text = Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element text
        try {
            Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element text -Value ([string](& $transforms[$Name] $text))
            Set-Status ('Applied “' + $Name + '”.')   # PowerShell reads curly double quotes as string delimiters, so concatenate
        } catch [FormatException] {
            # Invalid JSON is a user error, not an application failure.
            Set-Status ('Cannot apply “' + $Name + '”: ' + $_.Exception.Message)
        }
        Update-Stats
    }

    function Invoke-Copy {
        try {
            Set-NativeHTMLKitClipboard -Application $app -Text (Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element text)
            Set-Status 'Copied to the clipboard.'
        } catch [NativeHTMLKit.RpcException] {
            Set-Status (Get-UnsupportedMessage 'Clipboard' $_.Exception)
        }
    }

    function Invoke-Paste {
        try {
            Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element text -Value (Get-NativeHTMLKitClipboard -Application $app)
            Set-Status 'Pasted from the clipboard.'
        } catch [NativeHTMLKit.RpcException] {
            Set-Status (Get-UnsupportedMessage 'Clipboard' $_.Exception)
        }
        Update-Stats
    }

    function Open-Link([string]$Url) {
        if (-not $Url.StartsWith('https://', [StringComparison]::Ordinal)) { Set-Status 'Only https links are opened.'; return }
        try {
            $result = Open-NativeHTMLKitExternal -Application $app -Target $Url -Window $window
            if ($result.accepted) { Set-Status 'Opened the documentation.' } else { Set-Status 'Opening was cancelled.' }
        } catch [NativeHTMLKit.RpcException] {
            Set-Status (Get-UnsupportedMessage 'Opening links' $_.Exception)
        }
    }

    function Show-Preferences($Preferences) {
        $scheme = [string]$Preferences.color_scheme
        if (-not $scheme) { $scheme = 'unknown' }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element scheme -Text $scheme
    }

    function Invoke-Toolbar($ClickEvent) {
        $element = [string]$ClickEvent.element
        if ($element.StartsWith('t-', [StringComparison]::Ordinal)) { Invoke-Transform $element.Substring(2) }
        elseif ($element -eq 'copy') { Invoke-Copy }
        elseif ($element -eq 'paste') { Invoke-Paste }
    }

    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element toolbar -Callback { param($evt) Invoke-Toolbar $evt }
    # Links never navigate the document: activating one sends a 'link_activated' event (with
    # 'href' and the resolved 'url') and the application decides what to do.
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type link_activated -Callback {
        param($evt)
        $url = [string]$evt.url
        if (-not $url) { $url = $docsUrl }
        Open-Link $url
    }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type input -Element text -Callback { Update-Stats }
    Show-Preferences (Get-NativeHTMLKitPreferences -Application $app)
    # Live updates when the desktop changes; the notification carries a preferences snapshot.
    Register-NativeHTMLKitNotification -Application $app -Method 'desktop.preferences_changed' -Callback { param($params) Show-Preferences $params }
    Update-Stats

    Set-NativeHTMLKitReady -Application $app

    if ($SelfTest) {
        function Assert-Value([string]$Expected, [string]$What) {
            $value = Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element text
            if ($value -cne $Expected) { throw "${What}: unexpected text '$value'" }
        }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element text -Value "b`na`nB`na"
        Invoke-Transform 'sort'; Assert-Value "a`na`nb`nB" 'sort'
        Invoke-Transform 'unique'; Assert-Value "a`nb`nB" 'unique'
        Invoke-Transform 'upper'; Assert-Value "A`nB`nB" 'upper'
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element text -Value '{"x": [1, 2]}'
        Invoke-Transform 'json'; Assert-Value "{`n  `"x`": [`n    1,`n    2`n  ]`n}" 'json'
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element text -Value '{not json'
        Invoke-Transform 'json'
        $status = Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element status
        if (-not $status.StartsWith('Cannot apply “json”')) { throw "bad JSON should be reported: $status" }
        $stats = Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element stats
        if (-not $stats.StartsWith('9 characters · 2 words · 1 lines')) { throw "unexpected stats: $stats" }
        Invoke-Toolbar ([pscustomobject]@{ element = 'copy' })
        $status = Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element status
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitCapabilities -Application $app).headless) {
            if ($status -ne 'Clipboard is not available in this session.') { throw "unexpected clipboard status: $status" }
            Open-Link $docsUrl
            $status = Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element status
            if ($status -ne 'Opening links is not available in this session.') { throw "unexpected open status: $status" }
        }
        Open-Link 'file:///etc/passwd'
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element status) -ne 'Only https links are opened.') { throw 'a non-https link must be refused' }
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element scheme) -eq '') { throw 'preferences not shown' }
        [Console]::Out.WriteLine('SELFTEST PASS 10-clipboard-tool')
        $null = Request-NativeHTMLKitQuit -Application $app
    }

    Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -UntilShutdown
} finally {
    Close-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app
}

items.title: Counter
items.text:
A counter with a step selector, limits and a bounded change history.

Same example in Python: Counter

Real capture on KDE Plasma 6.6 Wayland with the released packages.

What it teaches: shared state; event delegation; Invoke-NativeHTMLKitBatch; trim_children.

items.title: Run it
items.text:
pwsh -File 02-counter.ps1

Related guide: updating the page

items.title: Source: 02-counter.ps1
items.text:
View on GitHub

# 02-counter.ps1 - a counter with a step selector, limits and a change history.
#
# Teaches: script-scoped state shared by callbacks ($script:), one click handler for
# several buttons (event delegation through the event's element id), reading a <select>,
# and atomic multi-element updates with Invoke-NativeHTMLKitBatch.
#
# Run:  pwsh -File ./02-counter.ps1        (or powershell.exe -NoProfile -File .\02-counter.ps1)
# -SelfTest drives the app through the public API and quits.
param([switch]$SelfTest)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module NativeHTMLKit

$app = Start-NativeHTMLKitScript -Name 'Counter'
try {
    $window = New-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Application $app -Title 'Counter' -Width 460 -Height 420 -MinWidth 360 -MinHeight 320
    $doc = Open-NativeHTMLKitHtml -Window $window -Html @'
<!doctype html>
<html><head><style>
  body { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 28px; }
  #value { font-size: 56px; font-weight: 600; margin: 8px 0 16px; }
  #value.negative { color: #b3261e; }
  #value.at-limit { text-decoration: underline; }
  .row { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
  button { min-width: 44px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 16px; }
  #history { color: #555; font-size: 13px; }
</style></head>
<body>
  <div id="value" aria-live="polite">0</div>
  <div class="row" id="buttons">
    <button id="dec" aria-label="Decrease">-</button>
    <button id="inc" aria-label="Increase">+</button>
    <button id="reset">Reset</button>
    <label for="step">Step</label>
    <select id="step"><option>1</option><option>5</option><option>10</option></select>
  </div>
  <p id="limits">Range -50 to 50.</p>
  <ol id="history" reversed></ol>
</body></html>
'@

    $script:count = 0
    $script:minimum = -50
    $script:maximum = 50

    function Set-Count([int]$Value, [string]$Reason) {
        $Value = [Math]::Max($script:minimum, [Math]::Min($script:maximum, $Value))
        $script:count = $Value
        $negativeOp = 'remove_class'
        if ($Value -lt 0) { $negativeOp = 'add_class' }
        $limitOp = 'remove_class'
        if ($Value -eq $script:minimum -or $Value -eq $script:maximum) { $limitOp = 'add_class' }
        # One transaction: the value, its classes and the history entry change together.
        Invoke-NativeHTMLKitBatch -Document $doc -Operations @(
            @{ op = 'set_text'; element = 'value'; text = [string]$Value }
            @{ op = $negativeOp; element = 'value'; name = 'negative' }
            @{ op = $limitOp; element = 'value'; name = 'at-limit' }
            @{ op = 'insert_html'; element = 'history'; position = 'afterbegin'
               html = '<li>' + [Net.WebUtility]::HtmlEncode("$Reason -> $Value") + '</li>' }
            @{ op = 'trim_children'; element = 'history'; keep = 8; from = 'end' }
        )
    }

    # One handler on the button row: $evt.element is the id of the clicked element.
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element buttons -Callback {
        param($evt)
        $step = [int](Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element step)
        switch ($evt.element) {
            'inc'   { Set-Count ($script:count + $step) "+$step" }
            'dec'   { Set-Count ($script:count - $step) "-$step" }
            'reset' { Set-Count 0 'reset' }
        }
    }

    Set-NativeHTMLKitReady -Application $app

    if ($SelfTest) {
        Set-NativeHTMLKitSelectedValues -Document $doc -Element step -Values @('10')
        $step = [int](Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element step)
        for ($i = 0; $i -lt 7; $i++) { Set-Count ($script:count - $step) "-$step" }
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element value) -ne '-50') { throw 'value was not clamped to -50' }
        $classes = (Invoke-NativeHTMLKitDocumentCommand -Document $doc -Operation get_attribute -Parameters @{ element = 'value'; name = 'class' }).value
        if ($classes -notmatch 'negative' -or $classes -notmatch 'at-limit') { throw "unexpected classes: $classes" }
        $items = (Find-NativeHTMLKitElement -Document $doc -Selector '#history li').matched_nodes
        if ($items -ne 7) { throw "expected 7 history entries, found $items" }
        Set-Count 0 'reset'
        Set-Count 3 '+3'
        if ((Find-NativeHTMLKitElement -Document $doc -Selector '#history li').matched_nodes -ne 8) { throw 'history was not trimmed to 8' }
        $newest = Get-NativeHTMLKitNodes -Document $doc -Selector '#history li' -Limit 1
        $first = Invoke-NativeHTMLKitDocumentCommand -Document $doc -Operation get_html -Parameters @{ node = $newest.nodes[0].node }
        if ($first.html -ne '+3 -> 3') { throw "newest entry should be first: $($first.html)" }
        [Console]::Out.WriteLine('SELFTEST PASS 02-counter')
        $null = Request-NativeHTMLKitQuit -Application $app
    }

    Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -UntilShutdown
} finally {
    Close-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app
}

items.title: Inventory data table
items.text:
Searchable, sortable, paged table rendered from data, with a details pane.

Same example in Python: Inventory data table

Real capture on KDE Plasma 6.6 Wayland with the released packages.

What it teaches: input/change events; batch updates; rendering rows safely; Import-Csv (PowerShell extra).

items.title: Run it
items.text:
pwsh -File 15-data-table.ps1

Related guide: updating the page

items.title: Source: 15-data-table.ps1
items.text:
View on GitHub

# 15-data-table.ps1 - search, sort, page through and inspect a list of records.
#
# Teaches: re-rendering a table body from escaped data ([Net.WebUtility]::HtmlEncode), live
# search with the `input` event (the event carries the control's current `value`), a <select>
# `change` event, sortable column headers and pagination buttons through delegated click
# handlers, a details pane updated with Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText (always plain text), and one
# Invoke-NativeHTMLKitBatch per render (one round trip, one atomic document update).
# PowerShell extra: -Path loads the records from a CSV file with Import-Csv.
#
# Run:  pwsh -File ./15-data-table.ps1 [-Path inventory.csv]
#       powershell.exe -NoProfile -File .\15-data-table.ps1
# The CSV needs the columns sku, name, category, stock, price. Without -Path the app shows 240
# generated inventory records (the same ones on every start).
# -SelfTest (with or without -Path) drives search, filter, sort, paging and selection through the public API and quits.
param([string]$Path, [switch]$SelfTest)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module NativeHTMLKit

# Validate arguments before starting the host, so a wrong path is reported on the console.
if ($Path -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path -PathType Leaf)) { throw "CSV file not found: $Path" }

$app = Start-NativeHTMLKitScript -Name 'Inventory'
try {
    $columns = @(
        @{ Key = 'sku'; Label = 'SKU' }, @{ Key = 'name'; Label = 'Product' }, @{ Key = 'category'; Label = 'Category' },
        @{ Key = 'stock'; Label = 'Stock' }, @{ Key = 'price'; Label = 'Price' })
    $invariant = [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture

    function New-SampleInventory([int]$Count = 240, [int]$Seed = 7) {
        $random = New-Object Random $Seed          # deterministic: the same rows on every start
        $adjectives = 'Compact', 'Deluxe', 'Eco', 'Heavy-duty', 'Mini', 'Smart', 'Travel', 'Ultra'
        $things = [ordered]@{ Audio = 'speaker', 'headset', 'radio'; Garden = 'hose', 'rake', 'planter'
            Kitchen = 'kettle', 'blender', 'toaster'; Office = 'stapler', 'lamp', 'chair' }
        $categories = @($things.Keys)
        for ($n = 1; $n -le $Count; $n++) {
            $category = $categories[$random.Next($categories.Count)]
            $items = $things[$category]
            [pscustomobject]@{ sku = 'SKU-{0:D4}' -f $n
                name = $adjectives[$random.Next($adjectives.Count)] + ' ' + $items[$random.Next($items.Count)]
                category = $category; stock = $random.Next(0, 501); price = [Math]::Round(3 + $random.NextDouble() * 397, 2) }
        }
    }

    function Import-Inventory([string]$File) {
        Import-Csv -LiteralPath $File | ForEach-Object {
            [pscustomobject]@{ sku = [string]$_.sku; name = [string]$_.name; category = [string]$_.category
                stock = [int]$_.stock; price = [double]::Parse($_.price, $invariant) }
        }
    }

    $headers = ($columns | ForEach-Object { '<th id="col-{0}">{1}</th>' -f $_.Key, $_.Label }) -join ''
    $window = New-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Application $app -Title 'Inventory' -Width 980 -Height 640
    $doc = Open-NativeHTMLKitHtml -Window $window -Html (@'
<!doctype html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>
  body { margin:0; font:13px sans-serif; background:#f4f5f8; color:#1e2330; display:flex; height:100vh; }
  .main { flex:1; display:flex; flex-direction:column; padding:14px 16px; min-width:0; }
  .tools { display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center; margin-bottom:10px; }
  input[type=search] { flex:1; padding:7px; border:1px solid #c3c9d6; border-radius:5px; }
  .scroll { flex:1; overflow:auto; background:#fff; border-radius:6px; }
  table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; }
