  th { position:sticky; top:0; background:#e9ecf2; text-align:left; padding:7px 8px; cursor:pointer; }
  th.sorted-asc::after { content:" \25B2"; } th.sorted-desc::after { content:" \25BC"; }
  td { padding:6px 8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eceef3; }
  td.num { text-align:right; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
  tr.low td { color:#b03a2e; }
  tr.selected td { background:#dce7fd; }
  .pager { display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; margin-top:8px; }
  button { padding:4px 10px; }
  aside { width:240px; padding:16px; background:#fff; border-left:1px solid #dde1e8; }
  aside dt { color:#6a7284; margin-top:8px; } aside dd { margin:2px 0 0; font-weight:bold; }
</style></head>
<body>
  <div class="main">
    <div class="tools">
      <input id="search" type="search" placeholder="Search name, SKU or category">
      <label>Category <select id="category"><option value="">All</option></select></label>
    </div>
    <div class="scroll"><table>
      <thead><tr id="headers">%HEADERS%</tr></thead><tbody id="rows"></tbody></table></div>
    <div class="pager"><button id="prev">‹ Previous</button><span id="page">-</span>
      <button id="next">Next ›</button><span id="matches"></span></div>
  </div>
  <aside><h2>Details</h2><dl>
    <dt>SKU</dt><dd id="d-sku">-</dd><dt>Product</dt><dd id="d-name">-</dd>
    <dt>Category</dt><dd id="d-category">-</dd><dt>Stock</dt><dd id="d-stock">-</dd><dt>Price</dt><dd id="d-price">-</dd>
  </dl></aside>
</body></html>
'@).Replace('%HEADERS%', $headers)

    # All view state lives in one hashtable: callbacks change its entries, never script variables.
    $table = @{ Records = @(); Query = ''; Category = ''; SortKey = 'sku'; Descending = $false
        Page = 0; PageSize = 25; Selected = $null; Matches = 0 }
    if ($Path) { $table.Records = @(Import-Inventory $Path) } else { $table.Records = @(New-SampleInventory) }

    function ConvertTo-HtmlText([string]$Text) { return [Net.WebUtility]::HtmlEncode($Text) }

    function Get-VisibleRecords {
        $needle = $table.Query
        $rows = @($table.Records | Where-Object {
            ($table.Category -eq '' -or $_.category -eq $table.Category) -and
            ($needle -eq '' -or $_.sku.IndexOf($needle, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0 -or
                $_.name.IndexOf($needle, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0 -or
                $_.category.IndexOf($needle, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0) })
        # The SKU as second key keeps equal values in a stable order (Windows PowerShell 5.1 has no -Stable).
        return @($rows | Sort-Object -Property @{ Expression = $table.SortKey; Descending = $table.Descending }, @{ Expression = 'sku'; Descending = $false })
    }

    function Update-Table {
        $rows = Get-VisibleRecords
        $table.Matches = $rows.Count
        $pages = [Math]::Max(1, [int][Math]::Ceiling($rows.Count / $table.PageSize))
        $table.Page = [Math]::Max(0, [Math]::Min($table.Page, $pages - 1))
        $body = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
        $start = $table.Page * $table.PageSize
        foreach ($r in @($rows | Select-Object -Skip $start -First $table.PageSize)) {
            $classes = @()
            if ($r.stock -lt 20) { $classes += 'low' }
            if ($r.sku -eq $table.Selected) { $classes += 'selected' }
            $sku = ConvertTo-HtmlText $r.sku
            [void]$body.Append(('<tr id="row-{0}" class="{1}"><td>{0}</td><td>{2}</td><td>{3}</td><td class="num">{4}</td><td class="num">{5}</td></tr>' -f
                $sku, ($classes -join ' '), (ConvertTo-HtmlText $r.name), (ConvertTo-HtmlText $r.category), $r.stock, $r.price.ToString('F2', $invariant)))
        }
        $html = $body.ToString()
        if (-not $html) { $html = '<tr><td colspan="5">No matching records.</td></tr>' }
        # One batch = one round trip and one atomic document update (all or nothing).
        $ops = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
        $ops.Add(@{ op = 'replace_children_html'; element = 'rows'; html = $html })
        foreach ($column in $columns) {
            $ops.Add(@{ op = 'remove_class'; element = "col-$($column.Key)"; name = 'sorted-asc' })
            $ops.Add(@{ op = 'remove_class'; element = "col-$($column.Key)"; name = 'sorted-desc' })
        }
        $direction = 'sorted-asc'
        if ($table.Descending) { $direction = 'sorted-desc' }
        $ops.Add(@{ op = 'add_class'; element = "col-$($table.SortKey)"; name = $direction })
        $ops.Add(@{ op = 'set_text'; element = 'page'; text = "Page $($table.Page + 1) of $pages" })
        $ops.Add(@{ op = 'set_text'; element = 'matches'; text = "$($rows.Count) of $($table.Records.Count) records" })
        Invoke-NativeHTMLKitBatch -Document $doc -Operations $ops.ToArray()
    }

    function Set-Query([string]$Text) { $table.Query = $Text.Trim(); $table.Page = 0; Update-Table }
    function Set-Category([string]$Name) { $table.Category = $Name; $table.Page = 0; Update-Table }
    function Move-Page([int]$Delta) { $table.Page += $Delta; Update-Table }

    function Set-SortColumn([string]$Key) {
        if ($Key -eq $table.SortKey) { $table.Descending = -not $table.Descending } else { $table.Descending = $false }
        $table.SortKey = $Key; $table.Page = 0
        Update-Table
    }

    function Select-Record([string]$Sku) {
        $record = @($table.Records | Where-Object { $_.sku -eq $Sku })[0]
        if ($null -eq $record) { return }
        $table.Selected = $Sku
        foreach ($column in $columns) {
            $value = $record.($column.Key)
            if ($column.Key -eq 'price') { $value = $value.ToString('F2', $invariant) }
            Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element "d-$($column.Key)" -Text ([string]$value)
        }
        Update-Table
    }

    # The category list comes from the data (the CSV may have other categories).
    $options = @($table.Records | ForEach-Object { $_.category } | Sort-Object -Unique | ForEach-Object { '<option>' + (ConvertTo-HtmlText $_) + '</option>' })
    Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentHtml -Document $doc -Element category -Html ($options -join '') -Position beforeend

    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type input -Element search -Callback { param($evt) Set-Query ([string]$evt.value) }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type change -Element category -Callback { param($evt) Set-Category ([string]$evt.value) }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element headers -Callback {
        param($evt)
        if ($evt.element -like 'col-*') { Set-SortColumn $evt.element.Substring(4) }
    }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element prev -Callback { Move-Page -1 }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element next -Callback { Move-Page 1 }
    # A click on a <td> (no id) reports the nearest identified ancestor: the row.
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element rows -Callback {
        param($evt)
        if ($evt.element -like 'row-*') { Select-Record $evt.element.Substring(4) }
    }

    Update-Table
    Set-NativeHTMLKitReady -Application $app

    if ($SelfTest) {
        function Assert-Text([string]$Element, [string]$Expected) {
            $actual = Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element $Element
            if ($actual -ne $Expected) { throw "#$Element is '$actual', expected '$Expected'" }
        }
        function Get-RowCount { return (Find-NativeHTMLKitElement -Document $doc -Selector '#rows tr[id]').matched_nodes }
        if ($Path) {
            # With a CSV file: every record is loaded and the first one can be selected.
            $n = $table.Records.Count
            Assert-Text matches "$n of $n records"
            Select-Record $table.Records[0].sku
            Assert-Text d-name $table.Records[0].name
            [Console]::Out.WriteLine('SELFTEST PASS 15-data-table')
            $null = Request-NativeHTMLKitQuit -Application $app
            Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -UntilShutdown
            return
        }
        Assert-Text page 'Page 1 of 10'
        Assert-Text matches '240 of 240 records'
        if ((Get-RowCount) -ne 25) { throw 'expected 25 rows on the first page' }
        Move-Page 1; Move-Page 1
        Assert-Text page 'Page 3 of 10'
        Move-Page 99
        Assert-Text page 'Page 10 of 10'
        Set-Category 'Garden'
        $garden = @($table.Records | Where-Object { $_.category -eq 'Garden' }).Count
        Assert-Text matches "$garden of 240 records"
        if ((Find-NativeHTMLKitElement -Document $doc -Selector '#category option').matched_nodes -ne 5) { throw 'expected 5 category options' }
        Set-Category ''
        Set-Query 'sku-000'
        Assert-Text matches '9 of 240 records'
        Set-Query 'no such product <b>'
        Assert-Text matches '0 of 240 records'
        if ((Find-NativeHTMLKitElement -Document $doc -Selector '#rows td[colspan]').matched_nodes -ne 1) { throw 'empty state missing' }
        Set-Query ''
        Set-SortColumn 'price'; Set-SortColumn 'price'
        if ((Find-NativeHTMLKitElement -Document $doc -Selector '#col-price.sorted-desc').matched_nodes -ne 1) { throw 'sort indicator missing' }
        $top = @($table.Records | Sort-Object price -Descending)[0]
        $first = (Get-NativeHTMLKitNodes -Document $doc -Selector '#rows tr' -Limit 1).nodes[0].element
        if ($first -ne "row-$($top.sku)") { throw "most expensive record should be first, got $first" }
        Select-Record $top.sku
        Assert-Text d-sku $top.sku
        Assert-Text d-price $top.price.ToString('F2', $invariant)
        if ((Find-NativeHTMLKitElement -Document $doc -Selector '#rows tr.selected').matched_nodes -ne 1) { throw 'selection not shown' }
        [Console]::Out.WriteLine('SELFTEST PASS 15-data-table')
        $null = Request-NativeHTMLKitQuit -Application $app
    }

    Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -UntilShutdown
} finally {
    Close-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app
}

items.title: About and support
items.text:
An About/Support window: capabilities, preferences, counters and a support bundle.

Same example in Python: About and support

Real capture on KDE Plasma 6.6 Wayland with the released packages.

What it teaches: Get-NativeHTMLKitCapabilities; Get-NativeHTMLKitPreferences; Get-NativeHTMLKitDiagnostics; Export-NativeHTMLKitSupportBundle.

items.title: Run it
items.text:
pwsh -File 14-diagnostics.ps1

Related guide: diagnostics and troubleshooting

items.title: Source: 14-diagnostics.ps1
items.text:
View on GitHub

# 14-diagnostics.ps1 - an "About / Support" window: capabilities, counters, support bundle.
#
# Teaches: Get-NativeHTMLKitCapabilities (feature detection), Get-NativeHTMLKitPreferences,
# Get-NativeHTMLKitDiagnosticReport -Application (loss and failure counters),
# Get-NativeHTMLKitDiagnostics (document CSS/resource notes), and
# Export-NativeHTMLKitSupportBundle (a local, redacted ZIP - nothing is uploaded).
#
# Run:  pwsh -File ./14-diagnostics.ps1 [-OutputFolder C:\Temp]
#       powershell.exe -NoProfile -File .\14-diagnostics.ps1
# Tip: start with -Diagnostics Trace on Start-NativeHTMLKitScript (or set
# NATIVEHTMLKIT_DIAGNOSTICS=trace) to record callback and request timing in the bundle.
# -SelfTest exports a bundle to a temporary folder, inspects it, and quits.
param([string]$OutputFolder, [switch]$SelfTest)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module NativeHTMLKit

$app = Start-NativeHTMLKitScript -Name 'Diagnostics'
try {
    if ($SelfTest) {
        $OutputFolder = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('nhk-diag-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
        $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $OutputFolder
    }
    if (-not $OutputFolder) { $OutputFolder = [IO.Path]::GetTempPath() }

    $window = New-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Application $app -Title 'About and support' -Width 760 -Height 640
    $doc = Open-NativeHTMLKitHtml -Window $window -Html @'
<!doctype html>
<html><head><style>
  body { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 18px; font-size: 14px; }
  h2 { font-size: 16px; margin: 18px 0 6px; }
  table { border-collapse: collapse; }
  td, th { text-align: left; padding: 2px 12px 2px 0; vertical-align: top; }
  td.yes { color: #2e7d32; } td.no { color: #8a1c1c; }
  #bundle { font-family: monospace; font-size: 12px; }
</style></head>
<body>
  <h2>Host</h2><table id="host"></table>
  <h2>Features</h2><table id="features"></table>
  <h2>Desktop preferences</h2><table id="prefs"></table>
  <h2>Connection counters</h2><table id="counters"></table>
  <h2>Support</h2>
  <p><button id="refresh">Refresh</button> <button id="export">Save support bundle</button></p>
  <p id="bundle" role="status"></p>
</body></html>
'@

    # Top-level capability flag -> its entry in $caps.features (the host names drops differently).
    $script:featureKeys = [ordered]@{ clipboard_text = 'clipboard_text'; file_dialogs = 'file_dialogs'; external_open = 'external_open'
        drag_drop = 'incoming_drop'; ime = 'ime'; accessibility = 'accessibility' }

    function Get-FeatureState($Caps, [string]$Flag) {
        # The top-level flag says whether the host offers the API in this session. The feature
        # entry's 'available' is $true/$false when the host has observed the native service and
        # $null ("not observed") otherwise; on a native desktop Core 1.0.3 reports $null here.
        # $null is not $false.
        if (-not $Caps.$Flag) { return @{ Text = 'not available'; Usable = $false } }
        $entry = $null
        if ($null -ne $Caps.features) { $entry = $Caps.features.($script:featureKeys[$Flag]) }
        $available = $null
        if ($null -ne $entry) { $available = $entry.available }
        if ($null -eq $available) { return @{ Text = 'enabled (not observed)'; Usable = $true } }
        if ($available) { return @{ Text = 'available'; Usable = $true } }
        return @{ Text = 'unavailable'; Usable = $false }
    }

    function ConvertTo-Rows($Pairs) {
        # Values from the host are data: always encoded, never trusted as markup.
        $html = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
        foreach ($pair in $Pairs) {
            $value = $pair.Value
            $class = ''
            if ($value -is [bool]) { $class = ' class="no"'; if ($value) { $class = ' class="yes"' } }
            if ($null -eq $value) { $value = 'unknown' }
            [void]$html.Append('<tr><th>' + [Net.WebUtility]::HtmlEncode([string]$pair.Name) + "</th><td$class>" + [Net.WebUtility]::HtmlEncode([string]$value) + '</td></tr>')
        }
        return $html.ToString()
    }

    function Update-Diagnostics {
        $caps = Get-NativeHTMLKitCapabilities -Application $app
        $hostInfo = @(
            @{ Name = 'Platform'; Value = $caps.platform }, @{ Name = 'Native session'; Value = $caps.native },
            @{ Name = 'Headless'; Value = $caps.headless }, @{ Name = 'Renderer'; Value = $caps.renderer },
            @{ Name = 'CSS profile'; Value = $caps.css_profile }, @{ Name = 'Max windows'; Value = $caps.max_windows },
            @{ Name = 'PowerShell'; Value = "$($PSVersionTable.PSEdition) $($PSVersionTable.PSVersion)" },
            @{ Name = 'Module'; Value = [string](Get-Module NativeHTMLKit).Version })
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentHtml -Document $doc -Element host -Html (ConvertTo-Rows $hostInfo)
        $featureHtml = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
        foreach ($flag in $script:featureKeys.Keys) {
            $state = Get-FeatureState $caps $flag
            $class = 'no'
            if ($state.Usable) { $class = 'yes' }
            [void]$featureHtml.Append('<tr><th>' + [Net.WebUtility]::HtmlEncode($flag) + "</th><td class=`"$class`">" + [Net.WebUtility]::HtmlEncode($state.Text) + '</td></tr>')
        }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentHtml -Document $doc -Element features -Html $featureHtml.ToString()

        $prefs = Get-NativeHTMLKitPreferences -Application $app
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentHtml -Document $doc -Element prefs -Html (ConvertTo-Rows @(
            @{ Name = 'Source'; Value = $prefs.source }, @{ Name = 'Colour scheme'; Value = $prefs.color_scheme },
            @{ Name = 'Reduced motion'; Value = $prefs.reduced_motion }, @{ Name = 'High contrast'; Value = $prefs.high_contrast }))

        $report = Get-NativeHTMLKitDiagnosticReport -Application $app
        $counters = @(foreach ($p in $report.Connection.GetEnumerator()) { @{ Name = $p.Key; Value = $p.Value } })
        $counters += @{ Name = 'SDK records (dropped)'; Value = "$($report.RecordCount) ($($report.DroppedRecords))" }
        $notes = @((Get-NativeHTMLKitDiagnostics -Document $doc).diagnostics).Count
        $counters += @{ Name = 'Document diagnostics'; Value = $notes }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentHtml -Document $doc -Element counters -Html (ConvertTo-Rows $counters)
        return $report
    }

    function Export-Bundle {
        $file = Join-Path $OutputFolder ('nativehtmlkit-support-' + (Get-Date).ToString('yyyyMMdd-HHmmss') + '.zip')
        try {
            $item = Export-NativeHTMLKitSupportBundle -Path $file -Application $app
            Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element bundle -Text ('Saved ' + $item.FullName + ' (' + $item.Length + ' bytes). Attach it to a bug report.')
            return $item
        } catch {
            Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element bundle -Text ('Could not save the bundle: ' + $_.Exception.Message)
        }
    }

    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element refresh -Callback { $null = Update-Diagnostics }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element export -Callback { $null = Export-Bundle }

    $null = Update-Diagnostics
    Set-NativeHTMLKitReady -Application $app

    if ($SelfTest) {
        $report = Update-Diagnostics
        if ($report.Connection.CallbackFailures -ne 0) { throw 'no callback should have failed' }
        if ((Find-NativeHTMLKitElement -Document $doc -Selector '#features tr').matched_nodes -ne 6) { throw 'feature table incomplete' }
        # The shape a native desktop reports (Core 1.0.3): top-level flags true, availability null.
        $native = [pscustomobject]@{ clipboard_text = $true; file_dialogs = $true; external_open = $true; drag_drop = $true; ime = $true; accessibility = $true
            features = [pscustomobject]@{ clipboard_text = [pscustomobject]@{ available = $null }; file_dialogs = [pscustomobject]@{ available = $null }
                external_open = [pscustomobject]@{ available = $null }; incoming_drop = [pscustomobject]@{ available = $false }
                ime = [pscustomobject]@{ available = $null }; accessibility = [pscustomobject]@{ available = $null } } }
        if ((Get-FeatureState $native 'file_dialogs').Text -ne 'enabled (not observed)') { throw 'null availability must not be reported as unavailable' }
        if ((Get-FeatureState $native 'drag_drop').Text -ne 'unavailable') { throw 'drag_drop must read features.incoming_drop' }
        $caps = Get-NativeHTMLKitCapabilities -Application $app
        $expected = (@($script:featureKeys.Keys | ForEach-Object { $_ + (Get-FeatureState $caps $_).Text }) -join '')
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element features) -ne $expected) { throw 'feature rows do not match the capabilities' }
        $item = Export-Bundle
        if ($null -eq $item -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $item.FullName)) { throw 'bundle not written' }
        Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem
        $zip = [IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead($item.FullName)
        try { $names = @($zip.Entries | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName } | Sort-Object) } finally { $zip.Dispose() }
        if (($names -join ',') -ne 'manifest.json,timeline.jsonl') { throw "unexpected bundle entries: $($names -join ',')" }
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $OutputFolder -Recurse -Force
        [Console]::Out.WriteLine('SELFTEST PASS 14-diagnostics')
        $null = Request-NativeHTMLKitQuit -Application $app
    }

    Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -UntilShutdown
} finally {
    Close-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app
}

items.title: DOM explorer
items.text:
Tree view of a live DOM with selecting, editing, moving and deleting nodes.

Same example in Python: DOM explorer

Real capture on KDE Plasma 6.6 Wayland with the released packages.

What it teaches: node references; Get-NativeHTMLKitNodeChildren; Get-NativeHTMLKitNodeInfo; Invoke-NativeHTMLKitNodeOperation; stale nodes.

items.title: Run it
items.text:
pwsh -File 16-dom-explorer.ps1

Related guide: updating the page

items.title: Source: 16-dom-explorer.ps1
items.text:
View on GitHub

# 16-dom-explorer.ps1 - browse the live element tree and edit nodes that have no HTML id.
#
# Teaches: node references for elements without an id (Get-NativeHTMLKitNode -Element and
# -Reference, Get-NativeHTMLKitNodes), walking the tree with Get-NativeHTMLKitNodeInfo and the
# paginated Get-NativeHTMLKitNodeChildren, node mutations with Invoke-NativeHTMLKitNodeOperation
# (add_class, remove_class, set_text, move_element, remove_element), and the rule that node
# references belong to ONE document generation: after the element is removed or replaced they are
# stale.
#
# Run:  pwsh -File ./16-dom-explorer.ps1      (or powershell.exe -NoProfile -File .\16-dom-explorer.ps1)
# Click a node in the tree on the left; the matching element in the sample is highlighted.
# -SelfTest selects, moves, edits and deletes nodes through the public API and quits.
param([switch]$SelfTest)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module NativeHTMLKit

$app = Start-NativeHTMLKitScript -Name 'DOM explorer'
try {
    $window = New-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Application $app -Title 'DOM explorer' -Width 900 -Height 560
    $doc = Open-NativeHTMLKitHtml -Window $window -Html @'
<!doctype html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>
  body { margin:0; font:13px sans-serif; display:flex; height:100vh; color:#1d2230; }
  #tree { width:320px; overflow:auto; background:#f3f4f8; border-right:1px solid #d9dde6; padding:8px 0; font-family:monospace; }
  .item { padding:2px 8px; cursor:pointer; white-space:nowrap; }
  .item:hover { background:#e1e8fa; } .item.current { background:#c9d8fb; }
  .tag { color:#7c3aa8; } .attr { color:#9a6a00; } .text { color:#4a7a2a; }
  .right { flex:1; display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
  .tools { padding:8px 12px; display:flex; gap:6px; border-bottom:1px solid #d9dde6; align-items:center; }
  #info { color:#5c6577; margin-left:8px; font-family:monospace; }
  #sample { padding:16px 20px; overflow:auto; }
  .highlight { outline:2px solid #e8590c; background:#fff4e6; }
</style></head>
<body>
  <div id="tree"></div>
  <div class="right">
    <div class="tools"><button id="up">Move up</button><button id="shout">UPPERCASE text</button>
      <button id="delete">Delete</button><button id="reset">Reset sample</button><span id="info">Nothing selected</span></div>
    <div id="sample"></div>
  </div>
</body></html>
'@

    $sample = @'
<article><h2>Release notes</h2>
<p>Elements in this sample have <em>no</em> id attributes.</p>
<ul><li>Faster layout</li><li>Smaller binaries</li><li>Better <code>dialog</code> support</li></ul>
<blockquote>Node references work without ids.</blockquote></article>
'@

    # Tree row index -> node reference; the current node. Callbacks change these entries.
    $explorer = @{ Items = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]; Current = $null }

    function ConvertTo-HtmlText([string]$Text) { return [Net.WebUtility]::HtmlEncode($Text) }
    function Get-Info($Node) { return Get-NativeHTMLKitNodeInfo -Node $Node }
    function Get-Ref([string]$Reference) { return Get-NativeHTMLKitNode -Document $doc -Reference $Reference }

    function Reset-Sample {
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentHtml -Document $doc -Element sample -Html $sample
        $explorer.Current = $null
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element info -Text 'Nothing selected'
        Update-Tree
    }

    # Walk the sample subtree with Get-NativeHTMLKitNodeChildren and render one row per node.
    function Add-TreeRows($Node, [int]$Depth, [Text.StringBuilder]$Rows) {
        $listing = Get-NativeHTMLKitNodeChildren -Node $Node -Limit 256
        foreach ($child in @($listing.children)) {
            $ref = Get-Ref $child.node
            $info = Get-Info $ref
            if ($info.type -eq 'text') {
                $text = ([string]$info.text).Trim()            # text nodes report their text
                if (-not $text) { continue }                   # skip whitespace between tags
                if ($text.Length -gt 40) { $text = $text.Substring(0, 40) }
                $label = '<span class="text">"' + (ConvertTo-HtmlText $text) + '"</span>'
            } elseif ($info.type -eq 'element') {
                $attrs = ''
                if ($info.attributes) {
                    # Host replies are objects: attributes are its properties.
                    foreach ($p in $info.attributes.PSObject.Properties) {
                        $attrs += ' <span class="attr">' + (ConvertTo-HtmlText $p.Name) + '="' + (ConvertTo-HtmlText ([string]$p.Value)) + '"</span>'
                    }
                }
                $label = '<span class="tag"><' + (ConvertTo-HtmlText $info.name) + '></span>' + $attrs
            } else {
                continue
            }
            $current = ''
            if ($null -ne $explorer.Current -and $explorer.Current.Id -eq $ref.Id) { $current = ' current' }
            [void]$Rows.Append(('<div id="item-{0}" class="item{1}" style="padding-left:{2}px">{3}</div>' -f $explorer.Items.Count, $current, (8 + $Depth * 14), $label))
            $explorer.Items.Add($ref)
            if ($info.type -eq 'element') { Add-TreeRows $ref ($Depth + 1) $Rows }
        }
    }

    function Update-Tree {
        $explorer.Items.Clear()
        $rows = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
        Add-TreeRows (Get-NativeHTMLKitNode -Document $doc -Element sample) 0 $rows
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentHtml -Document $doc -Element tree -Html $rows.ToString()
    }

    function Select-TreeItem([int]$Index) {
        if ($null -ne $explorer.Current) {
            try { Invoke-NativeHTMLKitNodeOperation -Node $explorer.Current -Operation remove_class -Parameters @{ name = 'highlight' } }
            catch { $null = $_ }                     # the previous node may have been deleted
        }
        $explorer.Current = $explorer.Items[$Index]
        $info = Get-Info $explorer.Current
        if ($info.type -eq 'element') { Invoke-NativeHTMLKitNodeOperation -Node $explorer.Current -Operation add_class -Parameters @{ name = 'highlight' } }
        $name = $info.name
        if (-not $name) { $name = $info.type }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element info -Text ('{0} {1} {2}' -f $name, [char]0x00B7, $info.node)
        Update-Tree
    }

    function Move-CurrentUp {
        if ($null -eq $explorer.Current) { return }
        $previous = (Get-Info $explorer.Current).previous
        # Skip whitespace text nodes; move before the previous ELEMENT sibling.
        while ($previous -and (Get-Info (Get-Ref $previous)).type -ne 'element') { $previous = (Get-Info (Get-Ref $previous)).previous }
        if ($previous) {
            Invoke-NativeHTMLKitNodeOperation -Node $explorer.Current -Operation move_element -Parameters @{ target_node = (Get-Ref $previous); position = 'beforebegin' }
            Update-Tree
        }
    }

    # Uppercase an element whose only child is text (set_text replaces ALL children).
    function Set-CurrentUppercase {
        if ($null -eq $explorer.Current -or (Get-Info $explorer.Current).type -ne 'element') { return }
        $children = @((Get-NativeHTMLKitNodeChildren -Node $explorer.Current).children)
        if ($children.Count -eq 1 -and $children[0].type -eq 'text') {
            $text = (Get-Info (Get-Ref $children[0].node)).text
            Invoke-NativeHTMLKitNodeOperation -Node $explorer.Current -Operation set_text -Parameters @{ text = ([string]$text).ToUpperInvariant() }
            Update-Tree
        }
    }

    function Remove-Current {
        if ($null -eq $explorer.Current) { return }
        Invoke-NativeHTMLKitNodeOperation -Node $explorer.Current -Operation remove_element
        $explorer.Current = $null
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element info -Text 'Deleted'
        Update-Tree
    }

    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element tree -Callback {
        param($evt)
        if ($evt.element -match '^item-(\d+)$') { Select-TreeItem ([int]$Matches[1]) }
    }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element up -Callback { Move-CurrentUp }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element shout -Callback { Set-CurrentUppercase }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element delete -Callback { Remove-Current }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element reset -Callback { Reset-Sample }

    Reset-Sample
    Set-NativeHTMLKitReady -Application $app

    if ($SelfTest) {
        function Find-Item([string]$Tag, [string]$Text) {
            for ($i = 0; $i -lt $explorer.Items.Count; $i++) {
                $info = Get-Info $explorer.Items[$i]
                if ($info.name -eq $Tag -and (Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element "item-$i") -eq "<$Tag>") {
                    if (-not $Text) { return $i }
                    $first = @((Get-NativeHTMLKitNodeChildren -Node $explorer.Items[$i]).children)[0]
                    if ($first -and (Get-Info (Get-Ref $first.node)).text -eq $Text) { return $i }
                }
            }
            throw "no tree item <$Tag> $Text"
        }
        # The text of every <li>: get_html accepts a node reference; strip the tags.
        function Get-ListText { return @((Get-NativeHTMLKitNodes -Document $doc -Selector '#sample li').nodes | ForEach-Object {
            (Invoke-NativeHTMLKitDocumentCommand -Document $doc -Operation get_html -Parameters @{ node = $_.node }).html -replace '<[^>]*>', '' }) -join '|' }
        # article, h2, "Release notes", p, "Elements...", em, "no", "id attributes.", ul, 3 x (li + text) + code + "dialog" + " support", blockquote, text
        if ($explorer.Items.Count -lt 18) { throw "tree has only $($explorer.Items.Count) rows" }
        Select-TreeItem (Find-Item 'li' 'Smaller binaries')
        if ((Find-NativeHTMLKitElement -Document $doc -Selector '#sample .highlight').matched_nodes -ne 1) { throw 'highlight missing' }
        if ((Find-NativeHTMLKitElement -Document $doc -Selector '#tree .current').matched_nodes -ne 1) { throw 'current tree row missing' }
        Move-CurrentUp
        if ((Get-ListText) -ne 'Smaller binaries|Faster layout|Better dialog support') { throw "move failed: $(Get-ListText)" }
        Set-CurrentUppercase
        if ((Get-ListText) -ne 'SMALLER BINARIES|Faster layout|Better dialog support') { throw "uppercase failed: $(Get-ListText)" }
        $removed = $explorer.Current
        Remove-Current
        if ((Get-ListText) -ne 'Faster layout|Better dialog support') { throw "delete failed: $(Get-ListText)" }
        $stale = $false
        try { $null = Get-Info $removed } catch { $stale = $true }
        if (-not $stale) { throw 'a removed node should be stale' }
        Reset-Sample
        if ((Get-ListText) -ne 'Faster layout|Smaller binaries|Better dialog support') { throw 'reset failed' }
        [Console]::Out.WriteLine('SELFTEST PASS 16-dom-explorer')
        $null = Request-NativeHTMLKitQuit -Application $app
    }

    Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -UntilShutdown
} finally {
    Close-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app
}

items.title: File viewer
items.text:
Text file viewer and editor with native Open, Save As and Choose Folder dialogs.

Same example in Python: File viewer

Real capture on KDE Plasma 6.6 Wayland with the released packages.

What it teaches: Show-NativeHTMLKitFileDialog (open, save, folder); file filters and start directory; dialog result; -32001 fallback; file content as a textarea value.

items.title: Run it
items.text:
pwsh -File 07-file-preview.ps1 [-Path FILE]

Related guide: file dialogs

items.title: Source: 07-file-preview.ps1
items.text:
View on GitHub

# 07-file-preview.ps1 - a text file viewer and editor with native Open, Save As and Choose Folder dialogs.
#
# Teaches: Show-NativeHTMLKitFileDialog -Kind OpenFiles / SaveFile / ChooseFolder with filters and
# a start directory. The call waits without a deadline and keeps pumping events, so the window
# stays responsive while the dialog is open. The dialog result shape (cancelled, paths). Graceful
# degradation: without a desktop session (headless/CI) dialogs throw NativeHTMLKit.RpcException
# code -32001. Showing file content safely as a textarea value (plain text) and encoding file names.
#
# Run:  pwsh -File ./07-file-preview.ps1 [-Path notes.txt]
#       powershell.exe -NoProfile -File .\07-file-preview.ps1
# -Path opens a text file at start. -SelfTest lists, opens and saves files in a temporary folder
# through the public API, checks the dialog fallback and quits.
param([string]$Path, [switch]$SelfTest)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module NativeHTMLKit

$app = Start-NativeHTMLKitScript -Name 'File viewer'
try {
    $window = New-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Application $app -Title 'File viewer' -Width 900 -Height 600
    $doc = Open-NativeHTMLKitHtml -Window $window -Html @'
<!doctype html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>
  body { margin:0; font:14px sans-serif; background:#f3f4f7; color:#20242c; display:flex; flex-direction:column; height:100vh; }
  header { display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; padding:10px 12px; background:#fff; border-bottom:1px solid #d9dce3; }
  button { padding:6px 12px; border:1px solid #b8bfcc; border-radius:5px; background:#fff; cursor:pointer; }
  #path { margin-left:12px; color:#5b6474; font-family:monospace; }
  .body { flex:1; display:flex; min-height:0; }
  aside { width:220px; overflow:auto; background:#fbfbfd; border-right:1px solid #d9dce3; }
  aside ul { list-style:none; margin:0; padding:6px 0; }
  aside li { padding:4px 12px; cursor:pointer; font-family:monospace; }
  aside li:hover { background:#e8eefc; }
  textarea { flex:1; border:0; padding:12px; font:13px monospace; resize:none; }
  footer { padding:6px 12px; background:#fff; border-top:1px solid #d9dce3; color:#5b6474; }
</style></head>
<body>
  <header>
    <button id="open">Open…</button><button id="save-as">Save As…</button><button id="folder">Folder…</button>
    <span id="path">No file</span>
  </header>
  <div class="body">
    <aside><ul id="files"></ul></aside>
    <textarea id="editor" spellcheck="false" placeholder="Open a text file"></textarea>
  </div>
  <footer id="status">Ready.</footer>
</body></html>
'@

    $script:maxBytes = 512KB
    $script:textSuffixes = @('txt', 'md', 'py', 'json', 'csv', 'log', 'toml')
    $script:textFilters = @(@{ name = 'Text files'; extensions = $script:textSuffixes })   # extensions without the dot
    $script:current = $null          # full path of the open file
    $script:folderFiles = @()
    $script:utf8 = New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false, $true)   # no BOM; throws on invalid bytes

    function Set-Status([string]$Text) { Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element status -Text $Text }

    function Get-Reason($ErrorRecord) {
        # The .NET exception behind a failed method call, without PowerShell's wrapper.
        $e = $ErrorRecord.Exception
        while ($null -ne $e.InnerException) { $e = $e.InnerException }
        return $e.Message
    }

    function Get-Suffix([string]$Name) {
        # '.bashrc' has no suffix; 'notes.MD' has '.md'.
        $i = $Name.LastIndexOf([char]'.')
        if ($i -le 0 -or $i -eq $Name.Length - 1) { return '' }
        return $Name.Substring($i).ToLowerInvariant()
    }

    # ----- native dialogs -----
    function Invoke-FileDialog([hashtable]$Arguments, [scriptblock]$Action) {
        try {
            # Waits (pumping events) until the user picks or cancels.
            $result = Show-NativeHTMLKitFileDialog -Window $window @Arguments
        } catch [NativeHTMLKit.RpcException] {
            if ($_.Exception.Code -eq -32001) { Set-Status 'Native file dialogs are not available in this session.' }   # e.g. headless
            else { Set-Status "Dialog failed (code $($_.Exception.Code))." }
            return
        }
        $paths = @($result.paths)
        if ($result.cancelled -or $paths.Count -eq 0) { Set-Status 'Cancelled.'; return }
        & $Action ([string]$paths[0])
    }

    function Request-Open {
        $start = [Environment]::GetFolderPath('UserProfile')
        if ($script:current) { $start = [IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($script:current) }
        Invoke-FileDialog @{ Kind = 'OpenFiles'; Title = 'Open a text file'; Directory = $start; Filters = $script:textFilters; Multiple = $false } { param($p) Import-TextFile $p }
    }

    function Request-SaveAs {
        $name = 'untitled.txt'
        if ($script:current) { $name = [IO.Path]::GetFileName($script:current) }
        Invoke-FileDialog @{ Kind = 'SaveFile'; Title = 'Save as'; FileName = $name; Filters = $script:textFilters } { param($p) Export-TextFile $p }
    }

    function Request-Folder {
        Invoke-FileDialog @{ Kind = 'ChooseFolder'; Title = 'Show the text files of a folder' } { param($p) Show-Folder $p }
    }

    # ----- file operations (also used directly by the self-test) -----
    function Import-TextFile([string]$File) {
        $name = [IO.Path]::GetFileName($File)
        try {
            if ((New-Object IO.FileInfo($File)).Length -gt $script:maxBytes) {
                Set-Status "$name is larger than $($script:maxBytes / 1KB) KiB."
                return
            }
            $text = $script:utf8.GetString([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($File))
        } catch [Text.DecoderFallbackException] {
            Set-Status "$name is not UTF-8 text."
            return
        } catch {
            Set-Status "Cannot read ${name}: $(Get-Reason $_)"
            return
        }
        # Text-mode reading: CRLF and CR line ends become LF.
        $text = $text.Replace("`r`n", "`n").Replace("`r", "`n")
        $script:current = $File
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element editor -Value $text   # plain text: never parsed as HTML
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element path -Text $File
        $null = Set-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Window $window -Title "$name — File viewer"
        # Characters are Unicode code points: a surrogate pair counts once.
        $characters = $text.Length - [regex]::Matches($text, '[\uDC00-\uDFFF]').Count
        Set-Status "Opened $name ($characters characters)."
    }

    function Export-TextFile([string]$File) {
        $name = [IO.Path]::GetFileName($File)
        # Text-mode writing: LF becomes the platform's line end.
        $text = (Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element editor).Replace("`n", [Environment]::NewLine)
        try { [IO.File]::WriteAllText($File, $text, (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false))) }
        catch {
            Set-Status "Cannot save ${name}: $(Get-Reason $_)"
            return
        }
        $script:current = $File
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element path -Text $File
        Set-Status "Saved $name."
    }

    function Show-Folder([string]$Folder) {
        $comparer = [StringComparer]::Ordinal
        if ([IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar -eq '\') { $comparer = [StringComparer]::OrdinalIgnoreCase }   # Windows names ignore case
        $found = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
        foreach ($item in Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Folder -File -Force) {
            if ($script:textSuffixes -contains (Get-Suffix $item.Name).TrimStart('.')) { $found.Add($item.FullName) }
        }
        $found.Sort($comparer)
        $script:folderFiles = @($found | Select-Object -First 200)
        $items = for ($i = 0; $i -lt $script:folderFiles.Count; $i++) {
            '<li id="file-' + $i + '">' + [Net.WebUtility]::HtmlEncode([IO.Path]::GetFileName($script:folderFiles[$i])) + '</li>'
        }
        $html = @($items) -join ''
        if (-not $html) { $html = '<li>(no text files)</li>' }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentHtml -Document $doc -Element files -Html $html
        Set-Status "$($script:folderFiles.Count) text file(s) in $((New-Object IO.DirectoryInfo($Folder)).Name)."
    }

    function Invoke-FileClick($ClickEvent) {
        if ([string]$ClickEvent.element -match '^file-(\d+)$') { Import-TextFile $script:folderFiles[[int]$Matches[1]] }
    }

    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element open -Callback { Request-Open }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element save-as -Callback { Request-SaveAs }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element folder -Callback { Request-Folder }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element files -Callback { param($evt) Invoke-FileClick $evt }

    if ($Path) { Import-TextFile $ExecutionContext.SessionState.Path.GetUnresolvedProviderPathFromPSPath($Path) }
    Set-NativeHTMLKitReady -Application $app

    if ($SelfTest) {
        $folder = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('nhk-example-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0, 8))
        $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $folder
        $noBom = New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
        [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $folder 'notes.md'), "# Notes`n<script>alert(1)</script>`n", $noBom)
        [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $folder 'data.json'), '{"a": 1}', $noBom)
        [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes((Join-Path $folder 'image.png'), [byte[]](0x89, 0x50, 0x4E, 0x47))
        [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes((Join-Path $folder 'latin1.txt'), [byte[]](0x63, 0x61, 0x66, 0xE9))   # 'cafe' with a Latin-1 e acute
        Show-Folder $folder
        $listed = Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element files
        if ((Find-NativeHTMLKitElement -Document $doc -Selector '#files li').matched_nodes -ne 3 -or $listed -ne 'data.jsonlatin1.txtnotes.md') { throw "unexpected folder list: $listed" }
        Invoke-FileClick ([pscustomobject]@{ element = 'file-2' })
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element editor) -ne "# Notes`n<script>alert(1)</script>`n") { throw 'file content not loaded verbatim' }
        if (-not (Get-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Window $window).title.StartsWith('notes.md')) { throw 'window title not updated' }
        Import-TextFile (Join-Path $folder 'latin1.txt')
        $status = Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element status
        if ($status -ne 'latin1.txt is not UTF-8 text.') { throw "unexpected status: $status" }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element editor -Value "edited`n"
        Export-TextFile (Join-Path $folder 'out.txt')
        if ([IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $folder 'out.txt')).Replace("`r`n", "`n") -ne "edited`n") { throw 'save failed' }
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitCapabilities -Application $app).headless) {
            Request-Open
            $status = Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element status
            if ($status -ne 'Native file dialogs are not available in this session.') { throw "unexpected dialog status: $status" }
        }
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $folder -Recurse -Force
        [Console]::Out.WriteLine('SELFTEST PASS 07-file-preview')
        $null = Request-NativeHTMLKitQuit -Application $app
    }

    Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -UntilShutdown
} finally {
    Close-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app
}

items.title: Focus timer
items.text:
A countdown timer that asks before quitting while it runs.

Same example in Python: Focus timer

Real capture on KDE Plasma 6.6 Wayland with the released packages.

What it teaches: Set-NativeHTMLKitBeforeQuit; saving after shutdown; desktop.paths; Request-NativeHTMLKitAttention.

items.title: Run it
items.text:
pwsh -File 17-focus-timer.ps1

Related guide: lifecycle

items.title: Source: 17-focus-timer.ps1
items.text:
View on GitHub

# 17-focus-timer.ps1 - application lifecycle, quit confirmation and saving state on shutdown.
#
# Teaches: a quit policy (Set-NativeHTMLKitBeforeQuit) that vetoes a quit while the timer runs
# and asks with an HTML <dialog>; saving statistics after Wait-NativeHTMLKit -UntilShutdown
# returns (the host has shut down, so no more cmdlet calls that talk to it); per-application
# folders from the host (Invoke-NativeHTMLKitRpc desktop.paths); Request-NativeHTMLKitAttention
# where the platform supports it and Set-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Title; a ticking timer built from a
# background task that stops with the application.
#
# Run:  pwsh -File ./17-focus-timer.ps1 [-StatsPath stats.json]
#       powershell.exe -NoProfile -File .\17-focus-timer.ps1
# Default statistics file: <per-application state folder>/focus-timer.json.
# -SelfTest runs a one-second session, checks the quit veto and the saved file, and quits.
param([string]$StatsPath, [switch]$SelfTest)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module NativeHTMLKit

$app = Start-NativeHTMLKitScript -Name 'Focus timer' -AppId 'org.nativehtmlkit.examples.powershell.focus_timer'
try {
    if ($SelfTest -and -not $StatsPath) { $StatsPath = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('nhk-focus-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N') + '.json') }
    if (-not $StatsPath) {
        # desktop.paths: XDG folders on Linux, AppData folders on Windows. The host does not create them.
        $StatsPath = Join-Path (Invoke-NativeHTMLKitRpc -Application $app -Method 'desktop.paths').state 'focus-timer.json'
    }
    $window = New-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Application $app -Title 'Focus timer' -Width 420 -Height 360
    $doc = Open-NativeHTMLKitHtml -Window $window -Html @'
<!doctype html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>
  body { margin:0; font:15px sans-serif; background:#1e2233; color:#eef0f7; text-align:center; }
  main { padding:28px 20px; }
  #clock { font-size:64px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; margin:12px 0; }
  form { display:flex; gap:8px; justify-content:center; align-items:center; }
  input { width:60px; padding:6px; }
  button { padding:7px 14px; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:#5b7cfa; color:#fff; cursor:pointer; }
  button.secondary { background:#3a4058; }
  #sessions { color:#a8afc6; margin-top:14px; }
  dialog { border:0; border-radius:10px; padding:20px; background:#2b3047; color:#eef0f7; }
  .running #clock { color:#8ef0b6; }
</style></head>
<body id="body"><main>
  <h1>Focus timer</h1>
  <div id="clock">25:00</div>
  <form id="controls">
    <label>Minutes <input id="minutes" type="number" min="1" max="120" value="25"></label>
    <button id="start" type="submit">Start</button>
    <button id="pause" type="button" class="secondary">Pause</button>
    <button id="reset" type="button" class="secondary">Reset</button>
  </form>
  <p id="sessions">Completed sessions: 0</p>
  <dialog id="confirm-quit"><p>The timer is still running. Quit anyway?</p>
    <button id="quit-anyway">Quit</button> <button id="keep" class="secondary">Keep running</button></dialog>
</main></body></html>
'@

    function Read-Stats {
        try { return @{ completed = [int](Get-Content -LiteralPath $StatsPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).completed } }
        catch { return @{ completed = 0 } }                # missing or unreadable file
    }

    # Everything the callbacks change lives in this hashtable.
    $timer = @{ Stats = (Read-Stats); Saved = 0; Remaining = 25 * 60.0; Deadline = $null; AllowQuit = $false; Stopped = $false }
    $timer.Saved = $timer.Stats.completed

    function Get-Minutes {
        $value = Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element minutes
        if ($value -match '^\d+$') { return [Math]::Min(120, [Math]::Max(1, [int]$value)) }
        return 25
    }

    function Show-Clock {
        $left = $timer.Remaining
        if ($null -ne $timer.Deadline) { $left = [Math]::Max(0.0, ($timer.Deadline - [DateTime]::UtcNow).TotalSeconds) }
        $total = [int][Math]::Round($left)
        $text = '{0:D2}:{1:D2}' -f [int][Math]::Floor($total / 60), ($total % 60)
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element clock -Text $text
        $title = 'Focus timer'
        if ($null -ne $timer.Deadline) { $title = '{0} {1} Focus timer' -f $text, [char]0x2014 }
        $null = Set-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Window $window -Title $title
    }

    function Start-Timer([double]$Seconds) {
        $timer.Remaining = $Seconds
        $timer.Deadline = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds($Seconds)
        Set-NativeHTMLKitClass -Document $doc -Element body -Name running
        Show-Clock
    }

    function Suspend-Timer {
        if ($null -eq $timer.Deadline) { return }
        $timer.Remaining = [Math]::Max(0.0, ($timer.Deadline - [DateTime]::UtcNow).TotalSeconds)
        $timer.Deadline = $null
        Set-NativeHTMLKitClass -Document $doc -Element body -Name running -Remove
    }

    function Reset-Timer {
        $timer.Deadline = $null
        $timer.Remaining = (Get-Minutes) * 60.0
        Set-NativeHTMLKitClass -Document $doc -Element body -Name running -Remove
        Show-Clock
    }

    function Complete-Session {
        $timer.Deadline = $null; $timer.Remaining = 0.0
        $timer.Stats.completed++
        Set-NativeHTMLKitClass -Document $doc -Element body -Name running -Remove
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element sessions -Text "Completed sessions: $($timer.Stats.completed)"
        Show-Clock
        try { Request-NativeHTMLKitAttention -Window $window -Kind informational }
        catch [NativeHTMLKit.RpcException] { $null = $_ }   # not available (headless, some compositors)
    }

    # A periodic tick: a background task that only sleeps; its completion callback runs on this
    # runspace, updates the clock and schedules the next tick. Close-NativeHTMLKit stops it.
    function Start-Tick {
        $null = Start-NativeHTMLKitTask -Application $app -ScriptBlock { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250 } -OnCompleted {
            if ($timer.Stopped) { return }
            if ($null -ne $timer.Deadline) {
                if ([DateTime]::UtcNow -ge $timer.Deadline) { Complete-Session } else { Show-Clock }
            }
            Start-Tick
        }
    }

    # The host asks before quitting (last window closed, or Request-NativeHTMLKitQuit).
    Set-NativeHTMLKitBeforeQuit -Application $app -Callback {
        if ($null -ne $timer.Deadline -and -not $timer.AllowQuit) {
            Show-NativeHTMLKitHtmlDialog -Document $doc -Element confirm-quit
            $false
            return
        }
        $true
    }

    function Confirm-Quit {
        $timer.AllowQuit = $true
        Show-NativeHTMLKitHtmlDialog -Document $doc -Element confirm-quit -Close -ReturnValue quit
        $null = Request-NativeHTMLKitQuit -Application $app     # asks the policy again, which now allows it
    }

    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type submit -Element controls -Callback { Start-Timer ((Get-Minutes) * 60) }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element pause -Callback { Suspend-Timer }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element reset -Callback { Reset-Timer }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element quit-anyway -Callback { Confirm-Quit }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element keep -Callback {
        Show-NativeHTMLKitHtmlDialog -Document $doc -Element confirm-quit -Close -ReturnValue keep
    }

    Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element sessions -Text "Completed sessions: $($timer.Stats.completed)"
    Show-Clock
    Start-Tick
    Set-NativeHTMLKitReady -Application $app

    if ($SelfTest) {
        function Wait-For([scriptblock]$Condition) {
            $clock = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
            while (-not (& $Condition)) {
                if ($clock.ElapsedMilliseconds -gt 20000) { throw "timed out waiting for: $Condition" }
                $null = Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -TimeoutMilliseconds 50
            }
        }
        function Test-DialogOpen { return [bool](Invoke-NativeHTMLKitDocumentCommand -Document $doc -Operation get_dialog -Parameters @{ element = 'confirm-quit' }).open }
        # The form's submit starts the timer with the minutes field.
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element minutes -Value '3'
        $null = Submit-NativeHTMLKitForm -Document $doc -Form controls
        Wait-For { $null -ne $timer.Deadline }
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Window $window).title -notmatch '^0[23]:\d\d .+ Focus timer$') { throw 'the title does not show the time' }
        Suspend-Timer
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element clock) -notmatch '^0[23]:\d\d$') { throw 'pause lost the time' }
        Reset-Timer
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element clock) -ne '03:00') { throw 'reset failed' }
        # A one-second session completes through the tick.
        Start-Timer 1
        Wait-For { $timer.Stats.completed -eq 1 }
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element sessions) -ne 'Completed sessions: 1') { throw 'session not counted' }
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Window $window).title -ne 'Focus timer') { throw 'title not restored' }
        # While the timer runs, a quit is vetoed and the dialog asks.
        Start-Timer 600
        $null = Request-NativeHTMLKitQuit -Application $app
        Wait-For { Test-DialogOpen }
        if ($app.ShutdownRequested) { throw 'the quit was not vetoed' }
        Show-NativeHTMLKitHtmlDialog -Document $doc -Element confirm-quit -Close -ReturnValue keep
        Confirm-Quit
    }

    Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -UntilShutdown

    # The host has shut down: plain PowerShell only from here on.
    $timer.Stopped = $true
    if ($timer.Stats.completed -ne $timer.Saved) {
        $folder = Split-Path -Parent $StatsPath
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $folder)) { $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $folder }
        Set-Content -LiteralPath $StatsPath -Value (ConvertTo-Json @{ completed = $timer.Stats.completed } -Compress) -Encoding UTF8
    }
    if ($SelfTest) {
        if ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $StatsPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).completed -ne 1) { throw 'statistics were not saved' }
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $StatsPath
        [Console]::Out.WriteLine('SELFTEST PASS 17-focus-timer')
    }
} finally {
    Close-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app
}

items.title: Hello
items.text:
The smallest complete app: a greeting form that writes untrusted text safely.

Same example in Python: Hello

Real capture on KDE Plasma 6.6 Wayland with the released packages.

What it teaches: application lifecycle; Get-NativeHTMLKitValue; Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText.

items.title: Run it
items.text:
pwsh -File 01-hello.ps1

Related guide: lifecycle

items.title: Source: 01-hello.ps1
items.text:
View on GitHub

# 01-hello.ps1 - the smallest complete NativeHTMLKit app: a greeting form.
#
# Teaches: the script lifecycle (Start-NativeHTMLKitScript -> window -> document ->
# events -> Set-NativeHTMLKitReady -> Wait-NativeHTMLKit -> Close-NativeHTMLKit), reading
# an input value and writing untrusted text safely with Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText.
#
# Run:  pwsh -File ./01-hello.ps1
#       powershell.exe -NoProfile -File .\01-hello.ps1     (Windows PowerShell 5.1)
# -SelfTest drives the app through the public API and quits (used by tests/Examples.Tests.ps1).
param([switch]$SelfTest)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module NativeHTMLKit

# Start-NativeHTMLKitScript runs this script a second time as the host's backend.
# Everything above this line runs twice; keep side effects below it.
$app = Start-NativeHTMLKitScript -Name 'Hello NativeHTMLKit'
try {
    $window = New-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Application $app -Title 'Hello' -Width 520 -Height 300
    $doc = Open-NativeHTMLKitHtml -Window $window -Html @'
<!doctype html>
<html><head><style>
  body { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 32px; }
  input { padding: 6px 8px; font-size: 15px; }
  button { padding: 6px 14px; font-size: 15px; }
  #greeting { margin-top: 18px; font-size: 20px; }
</style></head>
<body>
  <label for="name">Your name</label>
  <input id="name" autofocus>
  <button id="greet">Greet</button>
  <p id="greeting">Type a name and press Greet.</p>
</body></html>
'@

    function Update-Greeting {
        $name = (Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element name).Trim()
        if (-not $name) { $name = 'world' }
        # Text is never parsed as HTML: '<b>' typed by the user stays visible as '<b>'.
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element greeting -Text "Hello, $name!"
    }

    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element greet -Callback { Update-Greeting }

    Set-NativeHTMLKitReady -Application $app

    if ($SelfTest) {
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element name -Value '  <b>Ada</b> '
        Update-Greeting
        $shown = Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element greeting
        if ($shown -ne 'Hello, <b>Ada</b>!') { throw "unexpected greeting: $shown" }
        [Console]::Out.WriteLine('SELFTEST PASS 01-hello')
        $null = Request-NativeHTMLKitQuit -Application $app
    }

    # Runs callbacks on this runspace until the user closes the last window.
    Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -UntilShutdown
} finally {
    Close-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app
}

items.title: Snippet editor
items.text:
A snippet editor with keyboard shortcuts, Tab indentation and selection handling.

Same example in Python: Snippet editor

Real capture on KDE Plasma 6.6 Wayland with the released packages.

What it teaches: keydown chords; Set-NativeHTMLKitPreventDefault; inserting at the caret; selection.

items.title: Run it
items.text:
pwsh -File 13-keyboard-shortcuts.ps1

Related guide: keyboard and focus

items.title: Source: 13-keyboard-shortcuts.ps1
items.text:
View on GitHub

# 13-keyboard-shortcuts.ps1 - a snippet editor with keyboard shortcuts.
#
# Teaches: keydown events (key, ctrl, shift, alt, meta), a shortcut table that maps chords
# such as 'ctrl+s' to actions, Set-NativeHTMLKitPreventDefault (registered BEFORE the key
# is pressed, because callbacks run after native dispatch) so Tab indents instead of moving
# focus, inserting text at the caret with the replace_control_range document command, and
# Get-/Set-NativeHTMLKitSelection.
#
# Shortcuts: Tab indent, Ctrl+S save, Ctrl+L insert timestamp, Ctrl+Shift+U upper-case the
# selection, F1 show/hide help, Escape hide help.
#
# Run:  pwsh -File ./13-keyboard-shortcuts.ps1 [-Path snippet.txt]
#       powershell.exe -NoProfile -File .\13-keyboard-shortcuts.ps1
# Default file: <Documents>/nativehtmlkit-snippet.txt.
# -SelfTest runs the shortcut actions through the public API (no real key presses) and quits.
param([string]$Path, [switch]$SelfTest)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module NativeHTMLKit

$app = Start-NativeHTMLKitScript -Name 'Snippet editor'
try {
    if ($SelfTest) { $Path = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('nhk-snippet-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N') + '.txt') }
    if (-not $Path) { $Path = Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath([Environment+SpecialFolder]::MyDocuments, [Environment+SpecialFolderOption]::Create)) 'nativehtmlkit-snippet.txt' }

    $window = New-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Application $app -Title 'Snippet editor' -Width 720 -Height 500
    $doc = Open-NativeHTMLKitHtml -Window $window -Html @'
<!doctype html>
<html><head><style>
  body { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100vh; }
  #editor { flex: 1; margin: 10px; font: 14px/1.45 monospace; padding: 8px; tab-size: 4; }
  footer { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 4px 10px 8px; font-size: 12px; color: #555; }
  #help { padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 13px; }
  #help kbd { border: 1px solid #aaa; border-radius: 3px; padding: 0 4px; font-family: monospace; }
</style></head>
<body>
  <textarea id="editor" aria-label="Snippet" autofocus></textarea>
  <footer><span id="status" role="status">Press F1 for shortcuts.</span><span id="file"></span></footer>
  <div id="help" popover>
    <strong>Shortcuts</strong><br>
    <kbd>Tab</kbd> indent - <kbd>Ctrl+S</kbd> save - <kbd>Ctrl+L</kbd> timestamp<br>
    <kbd>Ctrl+Shift+U</kbd> upper-case selection - <kbd>F1</kbd>/<kbd>Esc</kbd> help
  </div>
</body></html>
'@
    Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element file -Text $Path
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path) { Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element editor -Value ([IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path)) }

    # Default actions must be cancelled before the key arrives: callbacks only run after
    # native dispatch. Tab (without Shift) in the editor no longer moves focus.
    Set-NativeHTMLKitPreventDefault -Document $doc -Element editor -EventType keydown -Key Tab -Shift $false

    function Set-Status([string]$Text) { Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element status -Text $Text }
    function Add-TextAtCaret([string]$Text) {
        # Without start/end, replace_control_range replaces the current selection (or inserts at the caret).
        $null = Invoke-NativeHTMLKitDocumentCommand -Document $doc -Operation replace_control_range -Parameters @{ element = 'editor'; replacement = $Text; selection_mode = 'end' }
    }

    $shortcuts = @{
        'tab' = { Add-TextAtCaret '    ' }
        'ctrl+s' = {
            [IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, (Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element editor), (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
            Set-Status ('Saved ' + (Get-Date).ToString('T'))
        }
        'ctrl+l' = { Add-TextAtCaret ((Get-Date).ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm')) }
        'ctrl+shift+u' = {
            # start/end are UTF-16 offsets; 'length' is the length of the whole value.
            $selection = Get-NativeHTMLKitSelection -Document $doc -Element editor
            $count = $selection.end - $selection.start
            if ($count -le 0) { Set-Status 'Select some text first.'; return }
            $text = Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element editor
            Add-TextAtCaret $text.Substring($selection.start, $count).ToUpperInvariant()
        }
        'f1' = { $null = Show-NativeHTMLKitPopover -Document $doc -Element help -Action toggle }
        'escape' = { $null = Show-NativeHTMLKitPopover -Document $doc -Element help -Action hide }
    }

    function ConvertTo-Chord($KeyEvent) {
        $parts = @()
        if ($KeyEvent.ctrl) { $parts += 'ctrl' }
        if ($KeyEvent.alt) { $parts += 'alt' }
        if ($KeyEvent.shift) { $parts += 'shift' }
        if ($KeyEvent.meta) { $parts += 'meta' }
        $parts += ([string]$KeyEvent.key).ToLowerInvariant()
        return ($parts -join '+')
    }

    # Without -Element the handler receives every keydown in the document.
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type keydown -Callback {
        param($evt)
        $chord = ConvertTo-Chord $evt
        if ($shortcuts.ContainsKey($chord)) { & $shortcuts[$chord] }
    }

    Set-NativeHTMLKitReady -Application $app

    if ($SelfTest) {
        function Send-Chord([string]$Key, [switch]$Ctrl, [switch]$Shift) {
            # The same object shape a real keydown event has (only the fields used here).
            $fake = [pscustomobject]@{ type = 'keydown'; key = $Key; ctrl = [bool]$Ctrl; shift = [bool]$Shift; alt = $false; meta = $false }
            & $shortcuts[(ConvertTo-Chord $fake)]
        }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element editor -Value 'ab'
        $null = Set-NativeHTMLKitSelection -Document $doc -Element editor -Start 1 -End 1
        Send-Chord 'Tab'
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element editor) -ne 'a    b') { throw 'Tab did not indent at the caret' }
        $null = Set-NativeHTMLKitSelection -Document $doc -Element editor -Start 0 -End 1
        Send-Chord 'U' -Ctrl -Shift
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element editor) -ne 'A    b') { throw 'upper-case failed' }
        Send-Chord 's' -Ctrl
        if ([IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path) -ne 'A    b') { throw 'save failed' }
        Send-Chord 'F1'
        if (-not (Invoke-NativeHTMLKitDocumentCommand -Document $doc -Operation get_popover -Parameters @{ element = 'help' }).open) { throw 'help did not open' }
        Send-Chord 'Escape'
        if ((Invoke-NativeHTMLKitDocumentCommand -Document $doc -Operation get_popover -Parameters @{ element = 'help' }).open) { throw 'help did not close' }
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $Path -Force
        [Console]::Out.WriteLine('SELFTEST PASS 13-keyboard-shortcuts')
        $null = Request-NativeHTMLKitQuit -Application $app
    }

    Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -UntilShutdown
} finally {
    Close-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app
}

items.title: Live chart
items.text:
A live line chart of memory use drawn into an RGBA bitmap.

Same example in Python: Live chart

Real capture on KDE Plasma 6.6 Wayland with the released packages.

What it teaches: New-NativeHTMLKitLiveBitmap; RGBA frames; a timer from background tasks.

items.title: Run it
items.text:
pwsh -File 12-live-chart.ps1

Related guide: live bitmaps

items.title: Source: 12-live-chart.ps1
items.text:
View on GitHub

# 12-live-chart.ps1 - a live line chart drawn into an RGBA bitmap.
#
# Teaches: New-NativeHTMLKitLiveBitmap + <img src="nativehtmlkit-bitmap://ID">, drawing
# straight-alpha RGBA8 pixels into a byte[] quickly from PowerShell (copy a prepared
# background, then draw short vertical spans), presenting frames with
# Send-NativeHTMLKitLiveBitmap, a periodic tick built from a background task, and
# Remove-NativeHTMLKitLiveBitmap.
#
# The chart shows this PowerShell process's working set, sampled twice per second.
#
# Run:  pwsh -File ./12-live-chart.ps1     (or powershell.exe -NoProfile -File .\12-live-chart.ps1)
# -SelfTest presents a few frames, checks the host accepted them, and quits.
param([switch]$SelfTest)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module NativeHTMLKit

$app = Start-NativeHTMLKitScript -Name 'Live chart'
try {
    $width = 360; $height = 120
    $window = New-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Application $app -Title 'Live chart' -Width 440 -Height 300
    $doc = Open-NativeHTMLKitHtml -Window $window -Html @"
<!doctype html>
<html><head><style>
  body { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 20px; }
  img { width: ${width}px; height: ${height}px; border: 1px solid #ccc; display: block; }
  #legend { font-size: 13px; color: #444; margin-top: 8px; }
</style></head>
<body>
  <h3>Working set of this backend process</h3>
  <img id="chart" src="nativehtmlkit-bitmap://memory" alt="Memory use over time">
  <p id="legend" role="status">Starting...</p>
  <button id="pause">Pause</button>
</body></html>
"@

    # The bitmap belongs to this document; it is released with the document or explicitly.
    $bitmap = New-NativeHTMLKitLiveBitmap -Document $doc -Id memory -Width $width -Height $height

    # Prepare the background once (white with grid lines); each frame starts as a copy of it.
    $background = New-Object byte[] ($width * $height * 4)
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $background.Length; $i++) { $background[$i] = 255 }
    foreach ($y in 30, 60, 90) {
        for ($x = 0; $x -lt $width; $x++) {
            $o = ($y * $width + $x) * 4
            $background[$o] = 225; $background[$o + 1] = 229; $background[$o + 2] = 236
        }
    }
    $frame = New-Object byte[] $background.Length
    $samples = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[double]
    $chart = @{ Paused = $false; Frames = 0 }

    function Write-Frame {
        [Buffer]::BlockCopy($background, 0, $frame, 0, $background.Length)
        if ($samples.Count -gt 0) {
            $stats = $samples | Measure-Object -Minimum -Maximum
            $low = $stats.Minimum; $high = $stats.Maximum
            $range = [Math]::Max(1.0, $high - $low)
            $previous = -1
            for ($i = 0; $i -lt $samples.Count; $i++) {
                $x = $width - $samples.Count + $i
                $y = [int](($height - 6) - (($samples[$i] - $low) / $range) * ($height - 12))
                if ($previous -lt 0) { $previous = $y }
                # A vertical span from the previous point keeps the line connected.
                $top = [Math]::Min($previous, $y); $bottom = [Math]::Max($previous, $y)
                for ($row = $top; $row -le $bottom; $row++) {
                    $o = ($row * $width + $x) * 4
                    $frame[$o] = 50; $frame[$o + 1] = 104; $frame[$o + 2] = 216; $frame[$o + 3] = 255
                }
                $previous = $y
            }
        }
        $result = Send-NativeHTMLKitLiveBitmap -Bitmap $bitmap -Pixels $frame
        $chart.Frames++
        return $result
    }

    function Add-Sample {
        $process = [Diagnostics.Process]::GetCurrentProcess()
        $mb = $process.WorkingSet64 / 1MB
        $samples.Add($mb)
        while ($samples.Count -gt $width) { $samples.RemoveAt(0) }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element legend -Text ('{0:N1} MB now, {1} samples' -f $mb, $samples.Count)
    }

    # A periodic tick: a tiny background task that only sleeps; its completion callback
    # runs on this runspace, does the UI work and schedules the next tick.
    function Start-Tick {
        $null = Start-NativeHTMLKitTask -Application $app -ScriptBlock { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 } -OnCompleted {
            if (-not $chart.Paused) { Add-Sample; $null = Write-Frame }
            Start-Tick
        }
    }

    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element pause -Callback {
        $chart.Paused = -not $chart.Paused
        $label = 'Pause'
        if ($chart.Paused) { $label = 'Resume' }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element pause -Text $label
    }

    Add-Sample
    $null = Write-Frame
    Start-Tick
    Set-NativeHTMLKitReady -Application $app

    if ($SelfTest) {
        $clock = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
        while ($chart.Frames -lt 4) {
            if ($clock.ElapsedMilliseconds -gt 20000) { throw 'ticks did not arrive' }
            $null = Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -TimeoutMilliseconds 100
        }
        $presented = Write-Frame
        if (-not $presented.presented_to_engine) { throw 'the host did not accept the frame' }
        if ($samples.Count -lt 4) { throw 'samples missing' }
        Remove-NativeHTMLKitLiveBitmap -Bitmap $bitmap
        Remove-NativeHTMLKitLiveBitmap -Bitmap $bitmap   # idempotent
        $chart.Paused = $true
        [Console]::Out.WriteLine('SELFTEST PASS 12-live-chart')
        $null = Request-NativeHTMLKitQuit -Application $app
    }

    Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -UntilShutdown
} finally {
    Close-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app
}

items.title: Log viewer
items.text:
Follows a growing log file with highlighting, pause, clear and auto-scroll.

Same example in Python: Log viewer

Real capture on KDE Plasma 6.6 Wayland with the released packages.

What it teaches: polling with background tasks; appending lines; trim_children; set_scroll_follow.

items.title: Run it
items.text:
pwsh -File 06-log-tail.ps1 -Path FILE

Related guide: background work

items.title: Source: 06-log-tail.ps1
items.text:
View on GitHub

# 06-log-tail.ps1 - follow a growing log file, highlight warnings and errors.
#
# Teaches: polling without blocking the window - a background task reads new bytes from
# the file (plain data in, plain data out) and its -OnCompleted callback appends lines and
# schedules the next poll; appending with -Position beforeend; bounding the view with
# trim_children; keeping the view scrolled to the end with set_scroll_follow.
#
# Run:  pwsh -File ./06-log-tail.ps1 -Path /var/log/syslog
#       powershell.exe -NoProfile -File .\06-log-tail.ps1 -Path C:\Logs\app.log
# -SelfTest writes a temporary log, checks that new lines appear, and quits.
param([string]$Path, [switch]$SelfTest)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module NativeHTMLKit
# Validate arguments before starting the host, so a usage error is a plain console error
# rather than a host "application failed" window.
if (-not $Path -and -not $SelfTest) { throw 'Pass the log file to follow: -Path <file>' }

$app = Start-NativeHTMLKitScript -Name 'Log tail'
$selfTestLog = $null
try {
    if ($SelfTest) {
        $selfTestLog = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('nhk-log-tail-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N') + '.log')
        [IO.File]::WriteAllText($selfTestLog, "INFO service started`nINFO listening on port 8080`n<script>not markup</script>`n")
        $Path = $selfTestLog
    }
    if (-not $Path) { throw 'Pass the log file to follow: -Path <file>' }
    $Path = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $Path).ProviderPath

    $window = New-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Application $app -Title ('Log - ' + [IO.Path]::GetFileName($Path)) -Width 900 -Height 560
    $doc = Open-NativeHTMLKitHtml -Window $window -Html @'
<!doctype html>
<html><head><style>
  body { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100vh; }
  header { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; padding: 8px 12px; background: #eef1f6; }
  #file { flex: 1; font-size: 13px; color: #444; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  #log { flex: 1; overflow: auto; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; list-style: none; font: 12px/1.45 monospace; }
  #log li { white-space: pre-wrap; }
  #log li.warn { background: #fff4ce; }
  #log li.error { background: #fde7e9; color: #8a1c1c; }
  footer { padding: 4px 12px; font-size: 12px; color: #555; }
</style></head>
<body>
  <header><span id="file"></span><label><input type="checkbox" id="paused"> Pause</label><button id="clear">Clear</button></header>
  <ul id="log"></ul>
  <footer id="status">Waiting for data...</footer>
</body></html>
'@
    Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element file -Text $Path
    # Keep the list pinned to its end while new lines arrive (unless the user scrolls up).
    $null = Invoke-NativeHTMLKitDocumentCommand -Document $doc -Operation set_scroll_follow -Parameters @{ element = 'log'; follow = $true }

    $script:offset = [long]0
    $script:lineCount = 0
    $script:maxLines = 500

    # Runs in a separate runspace: no access to $doc or any variable of this script.
    $readNewText = {
        param([string]$File, [long]$Offset, [int]$DelayMilliseconds)
        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds $DelayMilliseconds
        $stream = New-Object IO.FileStream($File, [IO.FileMode]::Open, [IO.FileAccess]::Read, [IO.FileShare]'ReadWrite, Delete')
        try {
            if ($stream.Length -lt $Offset) { $Offset = 0 }          # file was truncated or rotated
            [void]$stream.Seek($Offset, [IO.SeekOrigin]::Begin)
            $reader = New-Object IO.StreamReader($stream, [Text.Encoding]::UTF8)
            $text = $reader.ReadToEnd()
            # Only complete lines; a partial last line is read again next time.
            $end = $text.LastIndexOf("`n")
            if ($end -lt 0) { $text = '' } else { $text = $text.Substring(0, $end + 1) }
            @{ Offset = $Offset + [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetByteCount($text); Text = $text }
        } finally { $stream.Dispose() }
    }

    function Add-LogLines([string]$Text) {
        $html = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
        $added = 0
        foreach ($line in ($Text -split "\r?\n")) {
            if (-not $line) { continue }
            $class = ''
            if ($line -match '\b(ERROR|FATAL|FAIL(ED)?)\b') { $class = ' class="error"' }
            elseif ($line -match '\bWARN(ING)?\b') { $class = ' class="warn"' }
            [void]$html.Append("<li$class>" + [Net.WebUtility]::HtmlEncode($line) + '</li>')
            $added++
        }
        if ($added -eq 0) { return }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentHtml -Document $doc -Element log -Html $html.ToString() -Position beforeend
        $script:lineCount += $added
        if ($script:lineCount -gt $script:maxLines) {
            # Drop the oldest lines (from the start) and keep the newest.
            Invoke-NativeHTMLKitBatch -Document $doc -Operations @(@{ op = 'trim_children'; element = 'log'; keep = $script:maxLines; from = 'start' })
            $script:lineCount = $script:maxLines
        }
    }

    function Start-Poll([int]$DelayMilliseconds = 500) {
        $null = Start-NativeHTMLKitTask -Application $app -ScriptBlock $readNewText -ArgumentList @($Path, $script:offset, $DelayMilliseconds) -OnCompleted {
            param($result)
            $chunk = $result[0]
            if (-not (Get-NativeHTMLKitChecked -Document $doc -Element paused)) {
                Add-LogLines $chunk.Text
                $script:offset = $chunk.Offset
            }
            Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element status -Text ("$script:lineCount lines shown. Last check " + (Get-Date).ToString('T') + '.')
            Start-Poll
        } -OnFailed {
            param($failure)
            Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element status -Text ('Cannot read the file: ' + $failure.Message + ' Retrying...')
            Start-Poll 2000
        }
    }

    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element clear -Callback {
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentHtml -Document $doc -Element log -Html ''
        $script:lineCount = 0
    }

    Start-Poll 0
    Set-NativeHTMLKitReady -Application $app

    if ($SelfTest) {
        function Wait-For([scriptblock]$Condition) {
            $clock = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
            while (-not (& $Condition)) {
                if ($clock.ElapsedMilliseconds -gt 15000) { throw "timed out waiting for: $Condition" }
                $null = Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -TimeoutMilliseconds 100
            }
        }
        Wait-For { $script:lineCount -eq 3 }
        [IO.File]::AppendAllText($selfTestLog, "WARN disk 91% full`nERROR backup job failed`n")
        Wait-For { $script:lineCount -eq 5 }
        if ((Find-NativeHTMLKitElement -Document $doc -Selector '#log li.error').matched_nodes -ne 1) { throw 'error line not highlighted' }
        if ((Find-NativeHTMLKitElement -Document $doc -Selector '#log li.warn').matched_nodes -ne 1) { throw 'warning line not highlighted' }
        $third = Get-NativeHTMLKitNodes -Document $doc -Selector '#log li' -Offset 2 -Limit 1
        $html = (Invoke-NativeHTMLKitDocumentCommand -Document $doc -Operation get_html -Parameters @{ node = $third.nodes[0].node }).html
        if ($html -ne '<script>not markup</script>') { throw "log text was not encoded: $html" }
        [Console]::Out.WriteLine('SELFTEST PASS 06-log-tail')
        $null = Request-NativeHTMLKitQuit -Application $app
    }
