    Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -UntilShutdown
} finally {
    Close-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app
    if ($selfTestLog) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $selfTestLog -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
}

items.title: Multiple windows
items.text:
Note windows managed from a main window, with a close veto for unsaved notes.

Same example in Python: Multiple windows

Real capture on KDE Plasma 6.6 Wayland with the released packages.

What it teaches: several windows; Get-/Set-NativeHTMLKitWindow; window.event; close policies.

items.title: Run it
items.text:
pwsh -File 08-multi-window.ps1

Related guide: windows

items.title: Source: 08-multi-window.ps1
items.text:
View on GitHub

# 08-multi-window.ps1 - a window manager: open note windows and inspect, rename, resize and
# close them from a main window.
#
# Teaches: several windows in one application, each with its own document and handlers;
# Get-NativeHTMLKitWindow / Set-NativeHTMLKitWindow and the live window list; the
# window.event notification (close_requested, closed, resized, focused, ...); per-window
# state in a hashtable with callbacks created inside a function by .GetNewClosure() (and why
# $script: must not be used inside such closures); Set-NativeHTMLKitBeforeClose vetoing the
# close of a note with unsaved changes; "closing the main window quits the app" even while
# other windows are open; NativeHTMLKit.RpcException from window operations.
#
# Run:  pwsh -File ./08-multi-window.ps1     (or powershell.exe -NoProfile -File .\08-multi-window.ps1)
# Platform note: Wayland compositors own window placement and focus, so position/focus requests
# are refused there (RpcException code -32001); size, title, maximize and close work everywhere.
# -SelfTest opens, renames, resizes and closes note windows through the public API, checks the
# close vetoes, closes the main window and expects the application to quit.
param([switch]$SelfTest)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module NativeHTMLKit

$inspectorHtml = @'
<!doctype html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>
  body { margin:0; padding:18px 22px; font:14px sans-serif; background:#f4f5f8; color:#1e2430; }
  h1 { font-size:20px; margin:0 0 12px; }
  .bar { display:flex; gap:8px; margin-bottom:12px; }
  input { padding:6px; border:1px solid #c2c8d4; border-radius:5px; }
  button { padding:6px 10px; border:1px solid #aab3c3; border-radius:5px; background:#fff; cursor:pointer; }
  table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; background:#fff; }
  th, td { text-align:left; padding:6px 8px; border-bottom:1px solid #e1e4ea; }
  td.actions button { padding:3px 7px; font-size:12px; }
  #events { font:12px monospace; color:#596273; max-height:120px; overflow:auto; }
</style></head>
<body>
  <h1>Windows</h1>
  <div class="bar">
    <button id="new-note">New note window</button>
    <input id="rename-to" type="text" placeholder="New title for Rename">
  </div>
  <table><thead><tr><th>ID</th><th>Title</th><th>Size</th><th>State</th><th></th></tr></thead>
    <tbody id="rows"></tbody></table>
  <h2>Window events</h2>
  <div id="events"></div>
  <p id="status"></p>
</body></html>
'@

$noteHtml = @'
<!doctype html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>
  body { margin:0; font:14px sans-serif; display:flex; flex-direction:column; height:100vh; background:#fffbea; }
  #warning { display:none; padding:8px 12px; background:#ffe2b8; }
  #warning.shown { display:block; }
  textarea { flex:1; border:0; padding:12px; background:transparent; font:14px sans-serif; resize:none; }
  footer { padding:6px 12px; display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; color:#6f6440; }
  button { padding:4px 10px; }
</style></head>
<body>
  <div id="warning">Unsaved changes. <button id="discard">Discard and close</button></div>
  <textarea id="text" placeholder="Type a note…"></textarea>
  <footer><button id="save">Save</button><span id="note-status">Saved</span></footer>
</body></html>
'@

$app = Start-NativeHTMLKitScript -Name 'Window manager'
try {
    $main = New-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Application $app -Title 'Window manager' -Width 760 -Height 520
    $mainDoc = Open-NativeHTMLKitHtml -Window $main -Html $inspectorHtml

    # One shared, mutable state object. Closures capture the reference, so every window's
    # callbacks see the same notes; $script: variables would NOT work inside .GetNewClosure().
    # Notes keeps insertion order, so the table lists windows in the order they were opened.
    $state = @{ App = $app; Main = $main; MainDoc = $mainDoc; Notes = [ordered]@{}; Next = 1; NoteHtml = $noteHtml }

    function Set-NoteDirty {
        param($Note)
        $Note.Dirty = $true
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $Note.Document -Element note-status -Text 'Edited'
    }

    function Save-Note {
        param($Note)
        $Note.SavedText = Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $Note.Document -Element text
        $Note.Dirty = $false
        Set-NativeHTMLKitClass -Document $Note.Document -Element warning -Name shown -Remove
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $Note.Document -Element note-status -Text 'Saved'
    }

    function Close-NoteDiscarding {
        param($Note)
        $Note.Dirty = $false
        Close-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Window $Note.Window
    }

    function Update-WindowTable {
        param($State)
        $rows = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
        $windows = @($State.Main) + @($State.Notes.Values | ForEach-Object { $_.Window })
        foreach ($window in $windows) {
            try { $info = Get-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Window $window }
            catch [NativeHTMLKit.StaleObjectException], [NativeHTMLKit.RpcException] { continue }   # closed meanwhile
            $flags = @()
            if ($null -ne $info.observed) {
                foreach ($name in 'maximized', 'minimized', 'fullscreen', 'focused') {
                    $property = $info.observed.PSObject.Properties[$name]
                    if ($null -ne $property -and $property.Value) { $flags += $name }
                }
            }
            if ($info.closing) { $flags += 'closing' }
            $flagText = '-'
            if ($flags.Count -gt 0) { $flagText = $flags -join ', ' }
            $wid = [Net.WebUtility]::HtmlEncode($window.Id)
            $actions = ''
            if (-not [object]::ReferenceEquals($window, $State.Main)) {
                $actions = "<button id=`"row-$wid-rename`">Rename</button>" +
                    "<button id=`"row-$wid-grow`">640×480</button>" +
                    "<button id=`"row-$wid-max`">Maximize</button>" +
                    "<button id=`"row-$wid-close`">Close</button>"
            }
            [void]$rows.Append("<tr><td>$wid</td><td>" + [Net.WebUtility]::HtmlEncode([string]$info.title) + '</td>' +
                "<td>$($info.width)×$($info.height)</td><td>$flagText</td>" +
                "<td class=`"actions`">$actions</td></tr>")
        }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentHtml -Document $State.MainDoc -Element rows -Html $rows.ToString()
    }

    function New-NoteWindow {
        param($State)
        $number = $State.Next
        $State.Next++
        $window = New-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Application $State.App -Title "Note $number" -Width 360 -Height 300
        $document = Open-NativeHTMLKitHtml -Window $window -Html $State.NoteHtml
        $note = @{ Window = $window; Document = $document; Dirty = $false; SavedText = '' }
        $State.Notes[$window.Id] = $note

        # $note is a local of this function: without .GetNewClosure() it would be gone (or
        # point at another note) when the callback runs later.
        $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $document -Type input -Element text -Callback { Set-NoteDirty $note }.GetNewClosure()
        $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $document -Type click -Element save -Callback { Save-Note $note }.GetNewClosure()
        $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $document -Type click -Element discard -Callback { Close-NoteDiscarding $note }.GetNewClosure()

        # Asked by the host before the window closes. The last output decides: $true closes,
        # $false keeps the window open.
        Set-NativeHTMLKitBeforeClose -Window $window -Callback {
            if ($note.Dirty) {
                Set-NativeHTMLKitClass -Document $note.Document -Element warning -Name shown
                $false
                return
            }
            $true
        }.GetNewClosure()
        Update-WindowTable $State
        return $note
    }

    function Invoke-RowAction {
        param($State, [string]$Element)
        $parts = $Element.Split('-')
        if ($parts.Count -ne 3 -or -not $State.Notes.Contains($parts[1])) { return }
        $window = $State.Notes[$parts[1]].Window
        $action = $parts[2]
        try {
            switch ($action) {
                'rename' {
                    $title = (Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $State.MainDoc -Element rename-to).Trim()
                    if ($title) { $null = Set-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Window $window -Title $title }
                }
                'grow' { $null = Set-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Window $window -Width 640 -Height 480 }
                'max' {
                    $observed = (Get-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Window $window).observed
                    $maximized = $false
                    if ($null -ne $observed -and $null -ne $observed.PSObject.Properties['maximized']) { $maximized = [bool]$observed.maximized }
                    $null = Set-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Window $window -Maximized (-not $maximized)
                }
                'close' { Close-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Window $window }   # the note may veto (unsaved changes)
            }
        } catch [NativeHTMLKit.RpcException] {
            Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $State.MainDoc -Element status -Text "$action refused by the platform (code $($_.Exception.Code))."
        }
        Update-WindowTable $State
    }

    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $mainDoc -Type click -Element new-note -Callback { $null = New-NoteWindow $state }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $mainDoc -Type click -Element rows -Callback {
        param($evt)
        Invoke-RowAction $state ([string]$evt.element)
    }

    Set-NativeHTMLKitBeforeClose -Window $main -Callback {
        $dirty = @($state.Notes.Values | Where-Object { $_.Dirty }).Count
        if ($dirty -gt 0) {
            Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $mainDoc -Element status -Text "$dirty note(s) have unsaved changes; save or close them first."
            $false
            return
        }
        $true
    }

    Register-NativeHTMLKitNotification -Application $app -Method 'window.event' -Callback {
        param($params)
        $kind = [string]$params.type
        $wid = [string]$params.window_id
        if ($kind -eq 'closed' -and $wid -eq $main.Id) {
            # The SDK has already retired the main window's handles; just quit, which closes
            # the remaining note windows too.
            $null = Request-NativeHTMLKitQuit -Application $app
            return
        }
        if ($kind -eq 'closed' -and $state.Notes.Contains($wid)) { $state.Notes.Remove($wid) }
        try {
            Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentHtml -Document $mainDoc -Element events -Position beforeend -Html ('<div>' + [Net.WebUtility]::HtmlEncode($wid) + ': ' + [Net.WebUtility]::HtmlEncode($kind) + '</div>')
            $null = Invoke-NativeHTMLKitDocumentCommand -Document $mainDoc -Operation trim_children -Parameters @{ element = 'events'; keep = 30 }   # keep the 30 newest entries
            if ($kind -in @('closed', 'resized', 'close_requested', 'focused')) { Update-WindowTable $state }
        } catch [NativeHTMLKit.StaleObjectException], [NativeHTMLKit.DisconnectedException], [NativeHTMLKit.RpcException] {
            $null = $_                                       # the application is shutting down
        }
    }

    Update-WindowTable $state
    Set-NativeHTMLKitReady -Application $app

    if ($SelfTest) {
        # Window operations run after Set-NativeHTMLKitReady: before it, closing the LAST usable
        # window cancels start-up.
        function Wait-For([scriptblock]$Condition, [int]$TimeoutMilliseconds = 5000) {
            $clock = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
            while (-not (& $Condition)) {
                if ($clock.ElapsedMilliseconds -gt $TimeoutMilliseconds) { return $false }
                $null = Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -TimeoutMilliseconds 50
            }
            return $true
        }
        function Assert-Check([string]$Name, [bool]$Ok) { if (-not $Ok) { throw "check failed: $Name" } }
        function Get-RowCount { return (Find-NativeHTMLKitElement -Document $mainDoc -Selector '#rows tr').matched_nodes }
        function Test-ShutdownRequested { return [bool](Get-NativeHTMLKitDiagnosticReport -Application $app).Connection.ShutdownRequested }

        $first = New-NoteWindow $state
        $second = New-NoteWindow $state
        Assert-Check 'windows.three_listed' ((Get-RowCount) -eq 3)
        $list = Get-NativeHTMLKitWindowList -Application $app   # one array object
        Assert-Check 'windows.host_window_list' ($list.Count -eq 3)
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $mainDoc -Element rename-to -Value 'Shopping <list>'
        Invoke-RowAction $state "row-$($first.Window.Id)-rename"
        Assert-Check 'windows.rename_sets_title' ((Get-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Window $first.Window).title -eq 'Shopping <list>')
        Assert-Check 'windows.title_escaped_in_table' ((Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $mainDoc -Element rows).Contains('Shopping <list>'))
        Invoke-RowAction $state "row-$($first.Window.Id)-grow"
        $info = Get-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Window $first.Window
        Assert-Check 'windows.resize' ($info.width -eq 640 -and $info.height -eq 480)
        Invoke-RowAction $state "row-$($first.Window.Id)-max"   # granted, or reported in #status
        $status = Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $mainDoc -Element status
        Assert-Check 'windows.maximize_handled' ($status -eq '' -or $status -match '^max refused by the platform \(code -?\d+\)\.$')
        Set-NoteDirty $second
        Invoke-RowAction $state "row-$($second.Window.Id)-close"
        Assert-Check 'windows.dirty_note_vetoes_close' (Wait-For { [string](Invoke-NativeHTMLKitDocumentCommand -Document $second.Document -Operation get_attribute -Parameters @{ element = 'warning'; name = 'class' }).value -match '\bshown\b' })
        Assert-Check 'windows.dirty_note_still_open' (-not $second.Window.Closed)
        Close-NoteDiscarding $second
        Assert-Check 'windows.discard_closes' (Wait-For { $second.Window.Closed })
        Assert-Check 'windows.table_updated_on_closed' (Wait-For { (Get-RowCount) -eq 2 })
        Assert-Check 'windows.events_logged' ((Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $mainDoc -Element events).Contains('close_requested'))
        Set-NoteDirty $first
        Close-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Window $main
        Assert-Check 'windows.main_close_blocked_by_dirty_note' ((Wait-For { (Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $mainDoc -Element status).Contains('unsaved changes') }) -and -not $main.Closed)
        Save-Note $first
        Close-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Window $main   # main closed with a note open -> Request-NativeHTMLKitQuit
        Assert-Check 'windows.main_close_quits_app' (Wait-For { Test-ShutdownRequested } 10000)
        [Console]::Out.WriteLine('SELFTEST PASS 08-multi-window')
    }

    Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -UntilShutdown
} finally {
    Close-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app
}

items.title: Process dashboard
items.text:
Live process monitor that refreshes in the background, with filter, sort, pause and copy.

Same example in Python: Process dashboard

Real capture on KDE Plasma 6.6 Wayland with the released packages.

What it teaches: Start-NativeHTMLKitTask; updating the page in -OnCompleted; pause/resume; clipboard.

items.title: Run it
items.text:
pwsh -File process-dashboard/app.ps1

Related guide: background work

items.title: Source: process-dashboard/app.ps1
items.text:
View on GitHub

# Process dashboard: a live process monitor built with the NativeHTMLKit PowerShell SDK (tutorial final code).
#
# Teaches: collecting data in the background with Start-NativeHTMLKitTask (an isolated runspace that
#          gets plain data in and returns plain objects), updating the page in -OnCompleted on the
#          owning runspace, scheduling the next refresh, pausing with a checkbox, filtering a cached
#          snapshot, and copying the table to the clipboard with Set-NativeHTMLKitClipboard.
# Run:     pwsh -File app.ps1 [-RefreshSeconds 3]
#          (Windows PowerShell 5.1: powershell.exe -File app.ps1)
# Guide:   docs/tutorials/process-dashboard.md (step 3 of 3)
# -SelfTest waits for two refreshes, filters, sorts, pauses, copies and quits.
param([ValidateRange(1, 3600)][int]$RefreshSeconds = 3, [switch]$SelfTest)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module NativeHTMLKit -ErrorAction Stop
$app = Start-NativeHTMLKitScript -Name 'Process Dashboard'

$page = @'
<!doctype html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>
  body { font: 14px sans-serif; margin: 0; background: #11161f; color: #e6ebf3; }
  main { padding: 18px 22px; }
  header { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; }
  h1 { font-size: 20px; margin: 0 0 12px; }
  #status { color: #9fb0c8; }
  form { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 10px; }
  input, select { background: #1b2331; color: #e6ebf3; border: 1px solid #3a475c; border-radius: 5px; padding: 6px; }
  #filter { flex: 1; }
  button { background: #3574c6; color: white; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; padding: 6px 12px; }
  table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; }
  th, td { text-align: left; padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #2a3445; }
  th { color: #9fb0c8; font-weight: 600; }
  td.num, th.num { text-align: right; }
  #summary { color: #9fb0c8; }
</style></head>
<body><main>
  <header><h1>Processes</h1><span id="status" role="status">Collecting...</span></header>
  <form id="view-form">
    <input id="filter" type="search" placeholder="Filter by name" aria-label="Filter by name">
    <select id="sort" aria-label="Sort by">
      <option value="memory">Memory</option><option value="cpu">CPU time</option><option value="name">Name</option>
    </select>
    <label><input type="checkbox" id="paused"> Pause</label>
    <button id="copy" type="button">Copy table</button>
  </form>
  <p id="summary"></p>
  <table>
    <thead><tr><th>Name</th><th class="num">Id</th><th class="num">Memory (MB)</th><th class="num">CPU (s)</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody id="rows"></tbody>
  </table>
</main></body></html>
'@

# Runs in a separate runspace: no access to $app, $doc or this script's variables and functions.
$collect = {
    param([int]$DelayMilliseconds)
    if ($DelayMilliseconds -gt 0) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds $DelayMilliseconds }
    Get-Process | ForEach-Object {
        [pscustomobject]@{ Name = $_.ProcessName; Id = $_.Id
            MemoryMB = [Math]::Round($_.WorkingSet64 / 1MB, 1); Cpu = [Math]::Round([double]$_.CPU, 1) }
    }
}

# Everything the callbacks change lives in one object, so they never need to assign script variables.
$view = [pscustomobject]@{ Rows = @(); Refreshes = 0; Task = $null; Shown = @() }

function ConvertTo-HtmlText([string]$Text) { return [System.Net.WebUtility]::HtmlEncode($Text) }

function Update-View {
    $filter = (Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element filter).Trim()
    $shown = @($view.Rows | Where-Object { $filter -eq '' -or $_.Name.IndexOf($filter, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0 })
    $sorted = switch (Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element sort) {
        'cpu'  { $shown | Sort-Object Cpu -Descending }
        'name' { $shown | Sort-Object Name }
        default { $shown | Sort-Object MemoryMB -Descending }
    }
    $view.Shown = @($sorted | Select-Object -First 25)
    $html = @($view.Shown | ForEach-Object {
        '<tr><td>{0}</td><td class="num">{1}</td><td class="num">{2:N1}</td><td class="num">{3:N1}</td></tr>' -f `
            (ConvertTo-HtmlText $_.Name), $_.Id, $_.MemoryMB, $_.Cpu
    }) -join ''
    $total = ($view.Rows | Measure-Object MemoryMB -Sum).Sum
    Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentHtml -Document $doc -Element rows -Html $html
    Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element summary -Text ("Showing {0} of {1} processes, {2:N0} MB in total" -f $view.Shown.Count, $view.Rows.Count, $total)
}

function Start-Refresh([int]$DelayMilliseconds) {
    $view.Task = Start-NativeHTMLKitTask -Application $app -ScriptBlock $collect -ArgumentList @($DelayMilliseconds) -OnCompleted {
        param($rows)
        $view.Task = $null
        $view.Rows = @($rows)
        $view.Refreshes++
        Update-View
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element status -Text ("Updated {0:HH:mm:ss} (refresh #{1})" -f (Get-Date), $view.Refreshes)
        if (-not (Get-NativeHTMLKitChecked -Document $doc -Element paused)) { Start-Refresh ($RefreshSeconds * 1000) }
    } -OnFailed {
        param($failure)
        $view.Task = $null
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element status -Text ('Refresh failed: ' + $failure.Message)
    }
}

function Copy-Table {
    $lines = @("Name`tId`tMemoryMB`tCpu") + @($view.Shown | ForEach-Object { "$($_.Name)`t$($_.Id)`t$($_.MemoryMB)`t$($_.Cpu)" })
    try {
        Set-NativeHTMLKitClipboard -Application $app -Text ($lines -join [Environment]::NewLine)
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element status -Text "Copied $($view.Shown.Count) rows"
    } catch {
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element status -Text 'The clipboard is not available in this session'
    }
}

try {
    $window = New-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Application $app -Title 'Process Dashboard' -Width 760 -Height 640
    $doc = Open-NativeHTMLKitHtml -Window $window -Html $page
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type input -Element filter -Callback { param($eventObject) Update-View }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type change -Element sort -Callback { param($eventObject) Update-View }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type submit -Element 'view-form' -Callback { param($eventObject) Update-View }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type change -Element paused -Callback {
        param($eventObject)
        if ([bool]$eventObject.checked) {
            Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element status -Text 'Paused'
        } elseif ($null -eq $view.Task) {
            Start-Refresh 0
        }
    }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element copy -Callback { param($eventObject) Copy-Table }
    Start-Refresh 0
    Set-NativeHTMLKitReady -Application $app

    if ($SelfTest) {
        function Wait-For([scriptblock]$Condition) {
            $clock = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
            while (-not (& $Condition)) {
                if ($clock.ElapsedMilliseconds -gt 30000) { throw "timed out waiting for: $Condition" }
                $null = Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -TimeoutMilliseconds 50
            }
        }
        Wait-For { $view.Refreshes -ge 2 }
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element status) -notmatch '^Updated \d\d:\d\d:\d\d \(refresh #\d+\)$') { throw 'status not updated' }
        if ((Find-NativeHTMLKitElement -Document $doc -Selector '#rows tr').matched_nodes -lt 1) { throw 'no rows' }
        # Filter on this backend's own process name; the filter is a substring, never a wildcard.
        $me = (Get-Process -Id $PID).ProcessName
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element filter -Value $me
        Update-View
        if (@($view.Shown | Where-Object { $_.Id -eq $PID }).Count -ne 1) { throw 'own process not shown by the filter' }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element filter -Value '[*'
        Update-View
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element summary) -notmatch '^Showing 0 of \d+ processes') { throw 'wildcard characters matched' }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element filter -Value ''
        Set-NativeHTMLKitSelectedValues -Document $doc -Element sort -Values @('name')
        Update-View
        $names = @($view.Shown | ForEach-Object { $_.Name })
        if (($names -join '|') -ne (@($names | Sort-Object) -join '|')) { throw 'not sorted by name' }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitChecked -Document $doc -Element paused -Checked $true
        Copy-Table
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element status) -notmatch '^(Copied \d+ rows|The clipboard is not available in this session)$') { throw 'copy status missing' }
        [Console]::Out.WriteLine('SELFTEST PASS process-dashboard')
        $null = Request-NativeHTMLKitQuit -Application $app
    }

    Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -UntilShutdown
} finally {
    Close-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app
}

items.title: Process viewer
items.text:
Sortable, filterable table of running processes.

Same example in Python: Process viewer

Real capture on KDE Plasma 6.6 Wayland with the released packages.

What it teaches: rendering data as a table; input event value; sortable headers with aria-sort.

items.title: Run it
items.text:
pwsh -File 05-process-viewer.ps1

Related guide: updating the page

items.title: Source: 05-process-viewer.ps1
items.text:
View on GitHub

# 05-process-viewer.ps1 - a sortable, filterable table of running processes.
#
# Teaches: rendering PowerShell objects (Get-Process) as an HTML table with encoded
# cells, the input event's value field (no extra round trip while typing), sorting by
# clicking column headers (aria-sort), and a status line with counts.
#
# Run:  pwsh -File ./05-process-viewer.ps1     (or powershell.exe -NoProfile -File .\05-process-viewer.ps1)
# -SelfTest drives the app through the public API and quits.
param([switch]$SelfTest)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module NativeHTMLKit

$app = Start-NativeHTMLKitScript -Name 'Process viewer'
try {
    $window = New-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Application $app -Title 'Processes' -Width 760 -Height 620
    $doc = Open-NativeHTMLKitHtml -Window $window -Html @'
<!doctype html>
<html><head><style>
  body { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 16px; }
  .bar { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 10px; }
  #filter { flex: 1; padding: 6px 8px; font-size: 14px; }
  table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 13px; }
  th, td { text-align: left; padding: 4px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd; }
  th { background: #eef1f6; }
  th button { all: unset; cursor: default; font-weight: 700; }
  td.num, th.num { text-align: right; }
  #status { color: #555; font-size: 13px; margin-top: 8px; }
</style></head>
<body>
  <div class="bar">
    <input id="filter" placeholder="Filter by name or id" aria-label="Filter">
    <button id="refresh">Refresh</button>
  </div>
  <table>
    <thead><tr id="headers">
      <th aria-sort="none" id="col-Name"><button id="sort-Name">Name</button></th>
      <th class="num" aria-sort="none" id="col-Id"><button id="sort-Id">PID</button></th>
      <th class="num" aria-sort="descending" id="col-MemoryMB"><button id="sort-MemoryMB">Memory (MB)</button></th>
      <th class="num" aria-sort="none" id="col-CpuSeconds"><button id="sort-CpuSeconds">CPU (s)</button></th>
    </tr></thead>
    <tbody id="rows"></tbody>
  </table>
  <p id="status"></p>
</body></html>
'@

    $script:snapshot = @()
    $script:filterText = ''
    $script:sortBy = 'MemoryMB'
    $script:descending = $true
    $script:columns = @('Name', 'Id', 'MemoryMB', 'CpuSeconds')

    function Update-Snapshot {
        # Plain data only: the view never holds live Process objects.
        $script:snapshot = @(Get-Process | ForEach-Object {
            $cpu = $null
            try { $cpu = $_.CPU } catch { $cpu = $null }   # access can be denied for other users' processes
            if ($null -eq $cpu) { $cpu = 0 }
            [pscustomobject]@{ Name = $_.ProcessName; Id = $_.Id
                MemoryMB = [Math]::Round($_.WorkingSet64 / 1MB, 1); CpuSeconds = [Math]::Round([double]$cpu, 1) }
        })
    }

    function Update-Table {
        $rows = @($script:snapshot)
        if ($script:filterText) {
            $needle = $script:filterText
            $rows = @($rows | Where-Object { $_.Name -like "*$needle*" -or [string]$_.Id -eq $needle })
        }
        $rows = @($rows | Sort-Object -Property $script:sortBy -Descending:$script:descending | Select-Object -First 200)
        $html = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
        foreach ($p in $rows) {
            [void]$html.Append('<tr><td>' + [Net.WebUtility]::HtmlEncode($p.Name) + '</td><td class="num">' + $p.Id +
                '</td><td class="num">' + $p.MemoryMB.ToString('N1') + '</td><td class="num">' + $p.CpuSeconds.ToString('N1') + '</td></tr>')
        }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentHtml -Document $doc -Element rows -Html $html.ToString()
        foreach ($column in $script:columns) {
            $sort = 'none'
            if ($column -eq $script:sortBy) { $sort = 'ascending'; if ($script:descending) { $sort = 'descending' } }
            Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentAttribute -Document $doc -Element "col-$column" -Name 'aria-sort' -Value $sort
        }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element status -Text ("Showing $($rows.Count) of $($script:snapshot.Count) processes. Updated " + (Get-Date).ToString('T') + '.')
    }

    # The input event carries the control's current value; no Get-NativeHTMLKitValue needed.
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type input -Element filter -Callback {
        param($evt)
        $script:filterText = ([string]$evt.value).Trim()
        Update-Table
    }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element headers -Callback {
        param($evt)
        if ($evt.element -notmatch '^sort-(\w+)$') { return }
        if ($script:sortBy -eq $Matches[1]) { $script:descending = -not $script:descending }
        else { $script:sortBy = $Matches[1]; $script:descending = $Matches[1] -ne 'Name' }
        Update-Table
    }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element refresh -Callback { Update-Snapshot; Update-Table }

    Update-Snapshot
    Update-Table
    Set-NativeHTMLKitReady -Application $app

    if ($SelfTest) {
        $total = (Find-NativeHTMLKitElement -Document $doc -Selector '#rows tr').matched_nodes
        if ($total -lt 2) { throw "expected several processes, found $total" }
        $script:filterText = [string]$PID   # this backend's own process id
        Update-Table
        if ((Find-NativeHTMLKitElement -Document $doc -Selector '#rows tr').matched_nodes -ne 1) { throw 'PID filter should match one row' }
        $script:filterText = ''; $script:sortBy = 'Name'; $script:descending = $false
        Update-Table
        if ((Invoke-NativeHTMLKitDocumentCommand -Document $doc -Operation get_attribute -Parameters @{ element = 'col-Name'; name = 'aria-sort' }).value -ne 'ascending') { throw 'aria-sort not updated' }
        [Console]::Out.WriteLine('SELFTEST PASS 05-process-viewer')
        $null = Request-NativeHTMLKitQuit -Application $app
    }

    Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -UntilShutdown
} finally {
    Close-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app
}

items.title: Settings dialog
items.text:
Settings in a modal HTML dialog, saved to JSON: colour scheme, text size and reduced motion.

Same example in Python: Settings dialog

Real capture on KDE Plasma 6.6 Wayland with the released packages.

What it teaches: Show-NativeHTMLKitHtmlDialog; popovers; Set-NativeHTMLKitEnvironment; replaceable stylesheet.

items.title: Run it
items.text:
pwsh -File 09-settings-dialog.ps1 [-SettingsPath FILE]

Related guide: dialogs and popovers

items.title: Source: 09-settings-dialog.ps1
items.text:
View on GitHub

# 09-settings-dialog.ps1 - a settings dialog that applies and remembers preferences.
#
# Teaches: an HTML <dialog> opened modally with Show-NativeHTMLKitHtmlDialog and closed with
# a return value, a popover help tip
# (Show-NativeHTMLKitPopover), reading a form inside the dialog, applying a colour scheme
# with Set-NativeHTMLKitEnvironment, replacing one stylesheet in place
# (Add-/Set-NativeHTMLKitStylesheet), and saving settings as JSON.
#
# Run:  pwsh -File ./09-settings-dialog.ps1 [-SettingsPath settings.json]
#       powershell.exe -NoProfile -File .\09-settings-dialog.ps1
# Default settings file: <ApplicationData>/NativeHTMLKit-Examples/settings.json.
# -SelfTest uses a temporary settings file, changes settings and quits.
param([string]$SettingsPath, [switch]$SelfTest)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module NativeHTMLKit

$app = Start-NativeHTMLKitScript -Name 'Settings dialog'
try {
    if ($SelfTest) { $SettingsPath = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('nhk-settings-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N') + '.json') }
    if (-not $SettingsPath) {
        $SettingsPath = Join-Path (Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath([Environment+SpecialFolder]::ApplicationData, [Environment+SpecialFolderOption]::Create)) 'NativeHTMLKit-Examples') 'settings.json'
    }

    $window = New-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Application $app -Title 'Settings dialog' -Width 640 -Height 480
    $doc = Open-NativeHTMLKitHtml -Window $window -Html @'
<!doctype html>
<html><head><style>
  :root { color-scheme: light dark; }
  body { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 24px; background: Canvas; color: CanvasText; }
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { body { background: #1d222b; color: #e7ebf3; } }
  dialog { padding: 20px 24px; border-radius: 10px; min-width: 320px; }
  dialog label { display: block; margin: 10px 0 4px; }
  .actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; margin-top: 18px; }
  #help-tip { max-width: 260px; padding: 10px; font-size: 13px; }
  #saved { color: #2e7d32; }
</style></head>
<body>
  <h1>Report viewer</h1>
  <p id="sample">This paragraph follows the chosen text size.</p>
  <p><button id="open-settings">Settings...</button> <span id="saved" role="status"></span></p>

  <dialog id="settings" aria-labelledby="settings-title">
    <h2 id="settings-title">Settings</h2>
    <form id="settings-form">
      <label for="theme">Colour scheme <button type="button" id="help" aria-label="Help">?</button></label>
      <select id="theme" name="theme"><option value="system">Follow the system</option><option value="light">Light</option><option value="dark">Dark</option></select>
      <label for="size">Text size (px)</label>
      <input id="size" name="size" type="number" min="11" max="24" required>
      <label><input type="checkbox" id="motion" name="motion" value="reduce"> Reduce motion</label>
      <div class="actions"><button type="button" id="cancel">Cancel</button><button type="submit" id="apply">Save</button></div>
    </form>
  </dialog>
  <div id="help-tip" popover>"Follow the system" uses the desktop colour preference when the host can observe it.</div>
</body></html>
'@

    $defaults = @{ theme = 'system'; size = 15; motion = $false }
    function Read-Settings {
        $settings = $defaults.Clone()
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $SettingsPath) {
            try {
                $saved = Get-Content -LiteralPath $SettingsPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
                foreach ($name in @('theme', 'size', 'motion')) {
                    if ($null -ne $saved.PSObject.Properties[$name]) { $settings[$name] = $saved.$name }
                }
            } catch { Write-Verbose "Ignoring unreadable settings: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
        }
        return $settings
    }

    $script:settings = Read-Settings
    $script:sizeSheet = (Add-NativeHTMLKitStylesheet -Document $doc -Css '').sheet

    function Set-Appearance([hashtable]$Settings) {
        # 'system' removes the app override so the observed desktop preference applies again.
        $motion = 'system'
        if ($Settings.motion) { $motion = 'reduce' }
        $null = Set-NativeHTMLKitEnvironment -Document $doc -ColorScheme $Settings.theme -ReducedMotion $motion
        # Replace one app stylesheet in place instead of adding a new one each time.
        $null = Set-NativeHTMLKitStylesheet -Document $doc -Sheet $script:sizeSheet -Css ('body { font-size: ' + [int]$Settings.size + 'px; }')
    }

    function Show-Settings {
        Set-NativeHTMLKitSelectedValues -Document $doc -Element theme -Values @([string]$script:settings.theme)
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element size -Value ([string]$script:settings.size)
        Set-NativeHTMLKitChecked -Document $doc -Element motion -Checked ([bool]$script:settings.motion)
        Show-NativeHTMLKitHtmlDialog -Document $doc -Element settings      # modal by default
    }

    function Save-Settings {
        $entries = @{}
        foreach ($entry in (Get-NativeHTMLKitFormData -Document $doc -Form settings-form).entries) { $entries[$entry.name] = $entry.value }
        $script:settings = @{ theme = [string]$entries['theme']; size = [int]$entries['size']; motion = $entries.ContainsKey('motion') }
        $folder = Split-Path -Parent $SettingsPath
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $folder)) { $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $folder }
        [IO.File]::WriteAllText($SettingsPath, (ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $script:settings), (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
        Set-Appearance $script:settings
        Show-NativeHTMLKitHtmlDialog -Document $doc -Element settings -Close -ReturnValue 'saved'
        # Report here, not in the dialog's close event: a <dialog> keeps its previous return
        # value when the user dismisses it with Escape, so 'saved' would be reported again.
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element saved -Text ('Settings saved to ' + $SettingsPath)
    }

    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element open-settings -Callback { Show-Settings }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element cancel -Callback {
        Show-NativeHTMLKitHtmlDialog -Document $doc -Element settings -Close -ReturnValue 'cancelled'
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element saved -Text 'Settings unchanged.'
    }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element help -Callback { $null = Show-NativeHTMLKitPopover -Document $doc -Element help-tip -Action toggle }
    # Native validation (min/max/required) runs before this submit event is dispatched.
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type submit -Element settings-form -Callback { Save-Settings }
    Set-Appearance $script:settings
    Set-NativeHTMLKitReady -Application $app

    if ($SelfTest) {
        function Wait-Events { for ($i = 0; $i -lt 10; $i++) { $null = Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -TimeoutMilliseconds 30 } }
        Show-Settings
        if (-not (Invoke-NativeHTMLKitDocumentCommand -Document $doc -Operation get_dialog -Parameters @{ element = 'settings' }).open) { throw 'dialog did not open' }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitSelectedValues -Document $doc -Element theme -Values @('dark')
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element size -Value '40'
        if ((Submit-NativeHTMLKitForm -Document $doc -Form settings-form).submitted) { throw 'size 40 is above max=24 and must not submit' }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element size -Value '18'
        Set-NativeHTMLKitChecked -Document $doc -Element motion -Checked $true
        $null = Submit-NativeHTMLKitForm -Document $doc -Form settings-form
        Wait-Events
        $environment = Get-NativeHTMLKitEnvironment -Document $doc
        if ($environment.color_scheme -ne 'dark' -or $environment.reduced_motion -ne 'reduce') { throw "environment not applied: $($environment.color_scheme) $($environment.reduced_motion)" }
        $size = (Get-NativeHTMLKitComputedStyle -Document $doc -Element sample -Properties @('font-size')).properties.'font-size'.value
        if ($size -ne '18px') { throw "font size not applied: $size" }
        if ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $SettingsPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).size -ne 18) { throw 'settings not saved' }
        if (-not (Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element saved).StartsWith('Settings saved')) { throw 'save not reported' }
        $dialog = Invoke-NativeHTMLKitDocumentCommand -Document $doc -Operation get_dialog -Parameters @{ element = 'settings' }
        if ($dialog.open -or $dialog.return_value -ne 'saved') { throw 'dialog not closed with its return value' }
        if (-not (Show-NativeHTMLKitPopover -Document $doc -Element help-tip -Action toggle)) { throw 'popover did not open' }
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $SettingsPath -Force
        [Console]::Out.WriteLine('SELFTEST PASS 09-settings-dialog')
        $null = Request-NativeHTMLKitQuit -Application $app
    }

    Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -UntilShutdown
} finally {
    Close-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app
}

items.title: Sign-up form
items.text:
Sign-up form with native constraint validation, a password-match rule, an error summary and a result.

Same example in Python: Sign-up form

Real capture on KDE Plasma 6.6 Wayland with the released packages.

What it teaches: constraint validation; invalid events; set_custom_validity; Get-NativeHTMLKitFormData with repeated names; escaping user text; Reset-NativeHTMLKitForm.

items.title: Run it
items.text:
pwsh -File 03-form-validation.ps1

Related guide: forms and validation

items.title: Source: 03-form-validation.ps1
items.text:
View on GitHub

# 03-form-validation.ps1 - a sign-up form: native HTML constraint validation plus a cross-field rule.
#
# Teaches: built-in validation (required, minlength, type=email, min/max) runs on submit; an
# invalid form fires one 'invalid' event per failing control and no 'submit'. The
# set_custom_validity document command for a rule HTML cannot express (passwords must match).
# Reading the submitted values with Get-NativeHTMLKitFormData (ordered entries, repeated names
# kept), showing an error summary and a result with encoded user text, Reset-NativeHTMLKitForm.
#
# Run:  pwsh -File ./03-form-validation.ps1     (or powershell.exe -NoProfile -File .\03-form-validation.ps1)
# -SelfTest submits the empty, the mismatched and the valid form through the public API and quits.
param([switch]$SelfTest)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module NativeHTMLKit

$app = Start-NativeHTMLKitScript -Name 'Sign-up form'
try {
    $window = New-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Application $app -Title 'Sign up' -Width 600 -Height 820
    $doc = Open-NativeHTMLKitHtml -Window $window -Html @'
<!doctype html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>
  body { margin:0; background:#eef1f6; color:#1f2633; font:14px/1.45 sans-serif; }
  main { max-width:520px; margin:28px auto; padding:24px; background:#fff; border-radius:10px; }
  h1 { margin:0 0 4px; font-size:24px; }
  .hint { color:#68708a; margin:0 0 18px; }
  label { display:block; margin:12px 0 4px; font-weight:bold; }
  input[type=text], input[type=email], input[type=password], input[type=number], select {
    width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; padding:8px; border:1px solid #c7cddb; border-radius:6px; }
  .check { font-weight:normal; display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; }
  fieldset { border:1px solid #d8dce6; border-radius:6px; margin-top:12px; }
  button { margin-top:18px; padding:10px 18px; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:#2f6fec; color:#fff; }
  #errors { color:#b3261e; }
  #errors:empty, #result:empty { display:none; }
  #result { background:#e9f6ec; border-radius:6px; padding:10px 14px; margin-top:16px; }
</style></head>
<body><main>
  <h1>Create an account</h1>
  <p class="hint">All fields except the newsletter are required.</p>
  <ul id="errors" role="alert"></ul>
  <form id="signup">
    <label for="name">Name</label>
    <input id="name" name="name" type="text" required minlength="2" maxlength="80">
    <label for="email">Email</label>
    <input id="email" name="email" type="email" required>
    <label for="password">Password (8+ characters)</label>
    <input id="password" name="password" type="password" required minlength="8">
    <label for="confirm">Repeat password</label>
    <input id="confirm" name="confirm" type="password" required>
    <label for="age">Age</label>
    <input id="age" name="age" type="number" required min="13" max="120">
    <label for="country">Country</label>
    <select id="country" name="country" required>
      <option value="">Choose…</option><option value="de">Germany</option>
      <option value="fr">France</option><option value="jp">Japan</option><option value="us">United States</option>
    </select>
    <fieldset><legend>Interests</legend>
      <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" name="topic" value="news"> News</label>
      <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" name="topic" value="releases"> Releases</label>
      <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" name="topic" value="events"> Events</label>
    </fieldset>
    <label class="check"><input id="terms" name="terms" type="checkbox" required> I accept the terms</label>
    <button id="submit" type="submit">Sign up</button>
  </form>
  <div id="result"></div>
</main></body></html>
'@

    $script:labels = @{ name = 'Name'; email = 'Email'; password = 'Password'; confirm = 'Repeat password'
        age = 'Age'; country = 'Country'; terms = 'Terms' }
    $script:errors = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $script:accounts = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    $mismatch = 'The passwords do not match.'

    function ConvertTo-Html([string]$Text) { return [Net.WebUtility]::HtmlEncode($Text) }

    function Show-Errors {
        $items = @($script:errors | ForEach-Object { '<li>' + (ConvertTo-Html $_) + '</li>' })
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentHtml -Document $doc -Element errors -Html ($items -join '')
    }

    function Update-PasswordMatch {
        # A custom validity message makes the control invalid until it is cleared again.
        $same = (Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element password) -ceq (Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element confirm)
        $message = ''
        if (-not $same) { $message = $mismatch }
        $null = Invoke-NativeHTMLKitDocumentCommand -Document $doc -Operation set_custom_validity -Parameters @{ element = 'confirm'; message = $message }
    }

    function Invoke-SignupSubmit {
        # Runs the same path as clicking "Sign up" (also used by the self-test).
        Update-PasswordMatch
        $script:errors.Clear()
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentHtml -Document $doc -Element errors -Html ''
        return (Submit-NativeHTMLKitForm -Document $doc -Form signup -Submitter submit)
    }

    # 'invalid' does not bubble: its path holds only the control itself, so subscribe
    # document-wide (no -Element) and keep the controls of this form.
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type invalid -Callback {
        param($evt)
        # One event per invalid control, in document order, before (instead of) 'submit'.
        $element = [string]$evt.element
        if (-not $script:labels.ContainsKey($element)) { return }
        $message = 'Invalid value'
        if ($null -ne $evt.validity -and $evt.validity.message) { $message = [string]$evt.validity.message }
        $script:errors.Add($script:labels[$element] + ': ' + $message)
        Show-Errors
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element result -Text ''
    }

    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type submit -Element signup -Callback {
        # Callbacks run after native dispatch, so a fast typist can submit before the last
        # 'input' event updated the custom validity. Validate again here.
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element password) -cne (Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element confirm)) {
            Update-PasswordMatch
            $script:errors.Clear()
            $script:errors.Add("Repeat password: $mismatch")
            Show-Errors
            return
        }
        $values = @{}
        foreach ($entry in @((Get-NativeHTMLKitFormData -Document $doc -Form signup).entries)) {
            # Ordered; checkboxes may repeat a name.
            if (-not $values.ContainsKey($entry.name)) { $values[$entry.name] = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string] }
            $values[$entry.name].Add([string]$entry.value)
        }
        $topics = @()
        if ($values.ContainsKey('topic')) { $topics = $values['topic'].ToArray() }
        $account = [pscustomobject]@{ name = $values['name'][0]; email = $values['email'][0]
            country = $values['country'][0]; topics = $topics }
        $script:accounts.Add($account)
        $script:errors.Clear()
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentHtml -Document $doc -Element errors -Html ''
        $interests = $topics -join ', '
        if (-not $interests) { $interests = 'none' }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentHtml -Document $doc -Element result -Html (
            '<strong>Welcome, ' + (ConvertTo-Html $account.name) + '!</strong><br>' +
            'We will write to ' + (ConvertTo-Html $account.email) + '. Interests: ' + (ConvertTo-Html $interests) + '.')
        $null = Reset-NativeHTMLKitForm -Document $doc -Form signup
    }

    # Re-check the cross-field rule whenever either password changes.
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type input -Element password -Callback { Update-PasswordMatch }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type input -Element confirm -Callback { Update-PasswordMatch }

    Set-NativeHTMLKitReady -Application $app

    if ($SelfTest) {
        function Wait-Until([scriptblock]$Condition) {
            for ($i = 0; $i -lt 100; $i++) {
                if (& $Condition) { return $true }
                $null = Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -TimeoutMilliseconds 20
            }
            return [bool](& $Condition)
        }
        function Get-Count([string]$Selector) { return (Find-NativeHTMLKitElement -Document $doc -Selector $Selector).matched_nodes }
        # 1. Empty form: native constraints block 'submit' and list one error per control. Core 1.0.3
        #    in headless test mode may not report the required checkbox ('terms'); a desktop host does.
        $result = Invoke-SignupSubmit
        if ($result.submitted) { throw 'an empty form must not submit' }
        if (-not (Wait-Until { $script:errors.Count -eq 6 -or $script:errors.Count -eq 7 })) { throw "unexpected errors: $($script:errors -join ' | ')" }
        if (-not (Wait-Until { (Get-Count '#errors li') -eq $script:errors.Count })) { throw 'error summary not rendered' }
        # 2. Natively valid, but the passwords differ: the custom validity blocks the submit.
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element name -Value 'Ada <Lovelace>'
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element email -Value 'ada@example.org'
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element password -Value 'correct horse'
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element confirm -Value 'wrong horse'
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element age -Value '36'
        Set-NativeHTMLKitSelectedValues -Document $doc -Element country -Values @('fr')
        Set-NativeHTMLKitChecked -Document $doc -Element terms -Checked $true
        $result = Invoke-SignupSubmit
        if ($result.submitted -or -not (Wait-Until { $script:errors.Count -eq 1 -and $script:errors[0] -eq "Repeat password: $mismatch" })) {
            throw "a password mismatch must block: $($script:errors -join ' | ')"
        }
        # 3. Valid, with two of the repeated 'topic' checkboxes checked.
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element confirm -Value 'correct horse'
        foreach ($topic in @((Get-NativeHTMLKitNodes -Document $doc -Selector 'input[name=topic]').nodes)[0..1]) {
            Invoke-NativeHTMLKitNodeBatch -Document $doc -Operations @(@{ op = 'set_attribute'; node = $topic.node; name = 'checked'; value = '' })
        }
        $result = Invoke-SignupSubmit
        if (-not $result.submitted) { throw 'a valid form must submit' }
        if (-not (Wait-Until { $script:accounts.Count -eq 1 -and (Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element name) -eq '' })) { throw 'account not recorded' }
        $account = $script:accounts[0]
        if ($account.name -ne 'Ada <Lovelace>' -or $account.country -ne 'fr' -or (@($account.topics) -join ',') -ne 'news,releases') {
            throw "unexpected form data: $($account | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)"
        }
        if (-not (Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element result).StartsWith('Welcome, Ada <Lovelace>!') -or (Get-Count '#result Lovelace') -ne 0) {
            throw 'the result must show the name as encoded text'
        }
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element name) -ne '') { throw 'the form should be reset after success' }
        [Console]::Out.WriteLine('SELFTEST PASS 03-form-validation')
        $null = Request-NativeHTMLKitQuit -Application $app
    }

    Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -UntilShutdown
} finally {
    Close-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app
}

items.title: Todo list
items.text:
Add, edit, complete, filter and delete tasks, saved to a JSON file.

Same example in Python: Todo list

Real capture on KDE Plasma 6.6 Wayland with the released packages.

What it teaches: form submit; delegated list events; escaping user text; keyboard editing; atomic JSON persistence.

items.title: Run it
items.text:
pwsh -File 04-todo-list.ps1

Related guide: events and callbacks

items.title: Source: 04-todo-list.ps1
items.text:
View on GitHub

# 04-todo-list.ps1 - a todo list: add, edit, complete and delete tasks, saved to a JSON file.
#
# Teaches: form `submit` events (the Add button, or Enter in the text field, submits the form),
# one delegated handler for a whole list (-Element todos matches every descendant), HTML-encoding
# user text ([Net.WebUtility]::HtmlEncode) before Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentHtml, keyboard handling
# (Escape cancels an edit) and in-place editing, and persistence: an atomic JSON write into the
# per-application data folder reported by the host (desktop.paths).
# This is the finished app of the tutorial in docs/tutorials/todo-app.md.
#
# Run:  pwsh -File ./04-todo-list.ps1 [-DataPath todos.json]
#       powershell.exe -NoProfile -File .\04-todo-list.ps1
# Data: <per-user data folder>/todos.json (printed at start-up).
# -SelfTest drives the app through the public API with a temporary data file and quits.
param([string]$DataPath, [switch]$SelfTest)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module NativeHTMLKit

$app = Start-NativeHTMLKitScript -Name 'Todo' -AppId 'org.nativehtmlkit.examples.powershell.todo'
try {
    if ($SelfTest -and -not $DataPath) { $DataPath = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('nhk-todo-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N') + '.json') }
    if (-not $DataPath) {
        # desktop.paths is a public Core v1 method: per-application config/data/cache folders.
        $DataPath = Join-Path (Invoke-NativeHTMLKitRpc -Application $app -Method 'desktop.paths').data 'todos.json'
        [Console]::Out.WriteLine("Saving todos to $DataPath")
    }
    $window = New-NativeHTMLKitWindow -Application $app -Title 'Todo' -Width 640 -Height 620 -MinWidth 420 -MinHeight 360
    $doc = Open-NativeHTMLKitHtml -Window $window -Html @'
<!doctype html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>
  :root { --bg:#f6f7fb; --card:#fff; --text:#1d2433; --muted:#6b7385; --accent:#3a6ff7; --line:#e3e6ee; }
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    :root { --bg:#141923; --card:#1d2433; --text:#e8ecf5; --muted:#9aa3b5; --accent:#7aa2ff; --line:#2d3546; }
  }
  body { margin:0; background:var(--bg); color:var(--text); font:15px/1.4 sans-serif; }
  main { max-width:560px; margin:32px auto; padding:0 20px; }
  h1 { font-size:28px; margin:0 0 16px; }
  form { display:flex; gap:8px; }
  input[type=text] { flex:1; padding:9px 10px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:6px;
                     background:var(--card); color:var(--text); }
  button { padding:8px 12px; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:var(--accent); color:#fff; cursor:pointer; }
  button.plain { background:transparent; color:var(--muted); padding:4px 8px; }
  ul { list-style:none; padding:0; margin:16px 0; background:var(--card); border-radius:8px; }
  li { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:10px 12px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); }
  li:last-child { border-bottom:0; }
  li .text { flex:1; }
  li.done .text { text-decoration:line-through; color:var(--muted); }
  li form { flex:1; }
  .empty { color:var(--muted); padding:16px 12px; }
  footer { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; color:var(--muted); }
  nav button { background:transparent; color:var(--muted); }
  nav button.active { color:var(--accent); font-weight:bold; }
</style></head>
<body><main>
  <h1>Todo</h1>
  <form id="new-form">
    <input id="new-title" type="text" placeholder="What needs doing?" required maxlength="200">
    <button id="add" type="submit">Add</button>
  </form>
  <ul id="todos"></ul>
  <footer>
    <span id="count">0 items left</span>
    <nav id="filters">
      <button id="filter-all" class="active">All</button>
      <button id="filter-active">Active</button>
      <button id="filter-done">Completed</button>
    </nav>
    <button id="clear-done" class="plain">Clear completed</button>
  </footer>
</main></body></html>
'@

    # Read saved todos; a missing or unreadable file starts an empty list.
    function Read-Todos([string]$Path) {
        $list = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
        try { $data = @([IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path) | ConvertFrom-Json) } catch { return , $list }
        foreach ($x in $data) {
            if ($null -ne $x.id -and $null -ne $x.title -and $null -ne $x.done) {
                [void]$list.Add(@{ Id = [int]$x.id; Title = [string]$x.title; Done = [bool]$x.done })
            }
        }
        return , $list
    }

    # Write atomically: a crash mid-write never leaves a truncated file.
    function Save-Todos([string]$Path, $Todos) {
        $folder = Split-Path -Parent $Path
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $folder)) { $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $folder }
        $json = ConvertTo-Json -InputObject @($Todos | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ id = $_.Id; title = $_.Title; done = $_.Done } })
        $temporary = $Path + '.tmp'
        [IO.File]::WriteAllText($temporary, $json, (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path) { [IO.File]::Replace($temporary, $Path, [NullString]::Value) } else { [IO.File]::Move($temporary, $Path) }
    }

    $state = @{ Todos = (Read-Todos $DataPath); NextId = 1; Filter = 'all'; Editing = $null }
    if ($state.Todos.Count -gt 0) { $state.NextId = ($state.Todos | ForEach-Object { $_.Id } | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum + 1 }

    function Test-Visible($Todo) {
        switch ($state.Filter) { 'active' { return -not $Todo.Done } 'done' { return $Todo.Done } default { return $true } }
    }

    function Get-TodoRow($Todo) {
        $n = $Todo.Id
        $title = [Net.WebUtility]::HtmlEncode($Todo.Title)    # user text is never trusted markup
        if ($n -eq $state.Editing) {
            return ('<li id="todo-{0}"><form id="edit-form-{0}"><input id="edit-title" type="text" value="{1}" maxlength="200"></form>' -f $n, $title) +
                ('<button id="todo-{0}-cancel" class="plain">Cancel</button></li>' -f $n)
        }
        $class = ''; $checked = ''
        if ($Todo.Done) { $class = 'done'; $checked = ' checked' }
        return ('<li id="todo-{0}" class="{1}"><input id="todo-{0}-done" type="checkbox"{2}>' -f $n, $class, $checked) +
            ('<span id="todo-{0}-text" class="text">{1}</span>' -f $n, $title) +
            ('<button id="todo-{0}-edit" class="plain">Edit</button><button id="todo-{0}-delete" class="plain">Delete</button></li>' -f $n)
    }

    function Update-Todos {
        $rows = @($state.Todos | Where-Object { Test-Visible $_ } | ForEach-Object { Get-TodoRow $_ })
        if ($rows.Count -eq 0) { $rows = @('<li class="empty">Nothing here.</li>') }
        $left = @($state.Todos | Where-Object { -not $_.Done }).Count
        $noun = 'items'
        if ($left -eq 1) { $noun = 'item' }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentHtml -Document $doc -Element todos -Html ($rows -join '')
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element count -Text "$left $noun left"
    }

    function Complete-Change { Save-Todos $DataPath $state.Todos; Update-Todos }
    function Find-Todo([int]$Id) { return @($state.Todos | Where-Object { $_.Id -eq $Id })[0] }

    # ----- actions (the event handlers only translate events into these calls) -----
    function Add-Todo([string]$Title) {
        $Title = $Title.Trim()
        if (-not $Title) { return }
        [void]$state.Todos.Add(@{ Id = $state.NextId; Title = $Title; Done = $false })
        $state.NextId++
        Complete-Change
    }
    function Set-TodoDone([int]$Id, [bool]$Done) { (Find-Todo $Id).Done = $Done; Complete-Change }
    function Rename-Todo([int]$Id, [string]$Title) {
        $state.Editing = $null
        if ($Title.Trim()) { (Find-Todo $Id).Title = $Title.Trim() }
        Complete-Change
    }
    function Remove-Todo([int]$Id) { $state.Todos.Remove((Find-Todo $Id)); Complete-Change }
    function Clear-DoneTodos {
        foreach ($todo in @($state.Todos | Where-Object { $_.Done })) { $state.Todos.Remove($todo) }
        Complete-Change
    }
    function Set-TodoFilter([string]$Name) {
        $state.Filter = $Name
        foreach ($key in 'all', 'active', 'done') { Set-NativeHTMLKitClass -Document $doc -Element "filter-$key" -Name active -Remove:($key -ne $Name) }
        Update-Todos
    }
    function Start-TodoEdit([int]$Id) {
        $state.Editing = $Id
        Update-Todos
        Set-NativeHTMLKitFocus -Document $doc -Element edit-title
    }
    function Stop-TodoEdit { $state.Editing = $null; Update-Todos }

    # ----- event handlers -----
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type submit -Callback {    # new-form and the inline edit form
        param($evt)
        if ($evt.element -eq 'new-form') {
            Add-Todo (Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element new-title)
            Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element new-title -Value ''
        } elseif ($evt.element -match '^edit-form-(\d+)$') {
            Rename-Todo ([int]$Matches[1]) (Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element edit-title)
        }
    }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type change -Element todos -Callback {   # checkboxes inside the list
        param($evt)
        if ($evt.element -match '^todo-(\d+)-done$') { Set-TodoDone ([int]$Matches[1]) ([bool]$evt.checked) }
    }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element todos -Callback {
        param($evt)
        if ($evt.element -notmatch '^todo-(\d+)-(edit|delete|cancel)$') { return }
        switch ($Matches[2]) {
            'edit' { Start-TodoEdit ([int]$Matches[1]) }
            'delete' { Remove-Todo ([int]$Matches[1]) }
            'cancel' { Stop-TodoEdit }
        }
    }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type keydown -Element todos -Callback {
        param($evt)
        if ($evt.key -eq 'Escape' -and $null -ne $state.Editing) { Stop-TodoEdit }
    }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element filters -Callback {
        param($evt)
        if ($evt.element -match '^filter-(all|active|done)$') { Set-TodoFilter $Matches[1] }
    }
    $null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type click -Element clear-done -Callback { Clear-DoneTodos }

    Update-Todos
    Set-NativeHTMLKitReady -Application $app

    if ($SelfTest) {
        function Wait-Events { for ($i = 0; $i -lt 10; $i++) { $null = Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -TimeoutMilliseconds 30 } }
        function Get-Count([string]$Selector) { return (Find-NativeHTMLKitElement -Document $doc -Selector $Selector).matched_nodes }
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element todos) -ne 'Nothing here.') { throw 'empty state missing' }
        foreach ($title in 'Patch the file server', 'Rotate <backup> keys & certs', 'Review firewall rules') {
            Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element new-title -Value $title
            $null = Submit-NativeHTMLKitForm -Document $doc -Form new-form
            Wait-Events
        }
        if ((Get-Count '#todos li[id]') -ne 3) { throw 'expected 3 rows' }
        $text = Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element todo-2-text
        if ($text -ne 'Rotate <backup> keys & certs') { throw "item text was not escaped as text: $text" }
        Set-TodoDone 2 $true
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element count) -ne '2 items left') { throw 'wrong count' }
        Start-TodoEdit 1
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitFocusedElement -Document $doc).element -ne 'edit-title') { throw 'the edit field is not focused' }
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element edit-title -Value 'Patch "all" servers'
        $null = Submit-NativeHTMLKitForm -Document $doc -Form edit-form-1
        Wait-Events
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element todo-1-text) -ne 'Patch "all" servers') { throw 'rename failed' }
        Set-TodoFilter 'done'
        if ((Get-Count '#todos li[id]') -ne 1 -or (Get-Count '#filter-done.active') -ne 1) { throw 'done filter failed' }
        Set-TodoFilter 'all'
        Clear-DoneTodos
        Remove-Todo 3
        if ((Get-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element count) -ne '1 item left') { throw 'wrong count after delete' }
        $saved = Read-Todos $DataPath
        if ($saved.Count -ne 1 -or $saved[0].Title -ne 'Patch "all" servers') { throw 'the JSON file does not match' }
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $DataPath
        [Console]::Out.WriteLine('SELFTEST PASS 04-todo-list')
        $null = Request-NativeHTMLKitQuit -Application $app
    }

    Wait-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app -UntilShutdown
} finally {
    Close-NativeHTMLKit -Application $app
}

Real capture on KDE Plasma 6.6 Wayland with the released packages.

Callbacks run on the UI runspace: while one runs, the window cannot react to anything else. Move anything that takes more than a fraction of a second into Start-NativeHTMLKitTask.
path: How to run slow work in the background

items.title: The pattern
items.text:
$null = Start-NativeHTMLKitTask -Application $app -ArgumentList @($folder) -ScriptBlock {
    param([string]$Path)                                   # isolated runspace: plain data only
    Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Path -File -Recurse | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum |
        ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ Files = $_.Count; Bytes = $_.Sum } }
} -OnCompleted {
    param($result)                                         # runs on the UI runspace
    $summary = $result[0]
    Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element status -Text ("{0:N0} files, {1:N1} MB" -f $summary.Files, ($summary.Bytes / 1MB))
} -OnFailed {
    param($failure)
    Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element status -Text ('Scan failed: ' + $failure.Message)
}

What crosses the boundary:

  • In: -ArgumentList values, as positional arguments. Strings, numbers, hashtables, arrays and PSCustomObjects are fine; NativeHTMLKit objects are refused. To pass one array as one argument write -ArgumentList @(, $files).
  • Out: everything the scriptblock outputs, as an array ($result[0], or foreach ($item in $result)).
  • Not available inside: your script's variables and functions, $doc, $app, imported modules. Define helper functions and Import-Module inside the scriptblock if needed.
path: How to run slow work in the background

items.title: Progress
items.text: A task reports only when it finishes. For progress, split the work into batches and start the next batch from -OnCompleted, updating a progress bar each time (11-background-checksums.ps1 hashes files for about 0.2 s per batch, so the window is updated a few times per second). Batches also make cancellation responsive.
path: How to run slow work in the background

items.title: Cancel and time out
items.text:
$script:job = Start-NativeHTMLKitTask -Application $app -ScriptBlock $work -TimeoutMilliseconds 60000 -OnFailed {
    param($failure)
    if ($failure -is [OperationCanceledException]) { $text = 'Cancelled.' }
    elseif ($failure -is [TimeoutException]) { $text = 'Took too long.' }
    else { $text = 'Failed: ' + $failure.Message }
    Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentText -Document $doc -Element status -Text $text
}
# Cancel button:
Stop-NativeHTMLKitTask -Task $script:job

Cancellation is a request: PowerShell stops the pipeline at the next opportunity (Start-Sleep, between commands), but a call blocked inside .NET or native code finishes first. The result of a stopped task is discarded and its slot stays occupied until the worker really ends (at most 8 unfinished tasks per application). Receive-NativeHTMLKitTask reports CancellationPending meanwhile.
path: How to run slow work in the background

items.title: Timers and polling
items.text:
There is no timer cmdlet. A task that sleeps is a timer, and rescheduling from -OnCompleted gives a periodic tick that stops when the application closes:

function Start-Poll {
    $null = Start-NativeHTMLKitTask -Application $app -ScriptBlock { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 } -OnCompleted {
        Update-Status
        Start-Poll
    }
}

Each task creates a runspace (tens of milliseconds, more in Windows PowerShell 5.1), so keep periods at a few hundred milliseconds or more, and do the I/O inside the task, as 06-log-tail.ps1 does.
path: How to run slow work in the background

items.title: Several jobs at once
items.text:
Each job is a chain of short tasks, so it can report progress after every step. A function that starts a step creates its callbacks with .GetNewClosure(), so each callback keeps its job:

function Start-JobStep($Job) {
    $Job.Task = Start-NativeHTMLKitTask -Application $app -ScriptBlock $work -ArgumentList @($delay) -OnCompleted {
        $Job.Step++
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentAttribute -Document $doc -Element "job-$($Job.Id)-fill" -Name style -Value ('width:{0}%' -f ($Job.Step * 5))
        if ($Job.Step -lt 20) { Start-JobStep $Job } else { Complete-Job $Job 'done' }
    }.GetNewClosure() -OnFailed {
        param($failure)
        if ($failure -is [OperationCanceledException]) { Complete-Job $Job 'cancelled' }
    }.GetNewClosure()
}

Stop-NativeHTMLKitTask -Task $job.Task cancels the current step, and -OnFailed marks the job cancelled. An application can have at most 8 unfinished tasks; a ninth Start-NativeHTMLKitTask throws. 18-background-jobs.ps1 therefore keeps further jobs in a queue and starts them when a running job finishes or is cancelled.
path: How to run slow work in the background

items.title: Waiting for a task from script code
items.text: Receive-NativeHTMLKitTask -Task $t -Wait -TimeoutMilliseconds 10000 pumps events until the task completes and returns Completed, Result, Failure and Errors (non-terminating errors from Write-Error). It is useful in startup code and tests; inside the event loop prefer callbacks.
path: How to run slow work in the background

items.title: Do not
items.text:
• Do not call SDK cmdlets inside the task scriptblock: there is no application there.
  • Do not use Start-Job, Start-ThreadJob, ForEach-Object -Parallel or your own runspaces to touch SDK objects. You may use them for pure computation, but deliver results through a task or your own polling on the UI runspace.

Source: nativehtmlkit-powershell/docs/guides/background-work.md · edit the page there.
path: How to run slow work in the background

items.title: How to use the clipboard and desktop services
path: How to use the clipboard and desktop services

items.title: How to use the clipboard and desktop services
items.text:
Reference: desktop (clipboard, external open, preferences, capabilities). Example: 10-clipboard-tool.ps1.

Real capture on KDE Plasma 6.6 Wayland with the released packages.

This guide covers the clipboard, opening links and files with the desktop's default handler, and reading desktop preferences.
path: How to use the clipboard and desktop services

items.title: Copy and paste text
items.text:
The SDK reads and writes plain text on the system clipboard through the host. Text controls in your documents handle the usual editing shortcuts themselves; you need these cmdlets for actions such as a "Copy" or "Paste" button.

function Invoke-Copy {
    try {
        Set-NativeHTMLKitClipboard -Application $app -Text (Get-NativeHTMLKitValue -Document $doc -Element text)
        Set-Status 'Copied to the clipboard.'
    } catch [NativeHTMLKit.RpcException] {
        Set-Status (Get-UnsupportedMessage 'Clipboard' $_.Exception)
    }
}

function Invoke-Paste {
    try {
        Set-NativeHTMLKitDocumentValue -Document $doc -Element text -Value (Get-NativeHTMLKitClipboard -Application $app)
        Set-Status 'Pasted from the clipboard.'
    } catch [NativeHTMLKit.RpcException] {
        Set-Status (Get-UnsupportedMessage 'Clipboard' $_.Exception)
    }
    Update-Stats
}
path: How to use the clipboard and desktop services

items.title: Availability
items.text:
Get-NativeHTMLKitCapabilities reports features.clipboard_text.available: $true or $false once observed, $null while not known yet (availability is established by the native request). In headless test mode the clipboard is unavailable and both cmdlets throw NativeHTMLKit.RpcException (code -32001, Clipboard requires a native event loop); always handle that exception, because desktop clipboard owners can also refuse a request. The example turns -32001 into a short message:

function Get-UnsupportedMessage([string]$What, [NativeHTMLKit.RpcException]$RpcError) {
    if ($RpcError.Code -eq -32001 -or $script:clipboardKnownUnavailable) { return "$What is not available in this session." }
    return "$What failed (code $($RpcError.Code))."
}
path: How to use the clipboard and desktop services

items.title: Editing commands
items.text:
To copy the selection of a text control, or paste into it at the caret, use the native editor:

Invoke-NativeHTMLKitEditCommand -Document $doc -Element editor -Command copy
Invoke-NativeHTMLKitEditCommand -Document $doc -Element editor -Command paste

These complete asynchronously; the cmdlet accepting the command does not mean the transfer succeeded. Observe input events (paste) or the control's value.
path: How to use the clipboard and desktop services

items.title: Open links and files
items.text:
Links in the page never navigate. Activating an <a href> gives the backend a link_activated document event with the href and the resolved url (as described in the Core guide); your handler decides what happens, typically opening it in the user's browser:

function Open-Link([string]$Url) {
    if (-not $Url.StartsWith('https://', [StringComparison]::Ordinal)) { Set-Status 'Only https links are opened.'; return }
    try {
        $result = Open-NativeHTMLKitExternal -Application $app -Target $Url -Window $window
        if ($result.accepted) { Set-Status 'Opened the documentation.' } else { Set-Status 'Opening was cancelled.' }
    } catch [NativeHTMLKit.RpcException] {
        Set-Status (Get-UnsupportedMessage 'Opening links' $_.Exception)
    }
}
$null = Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent -Document $doc -Type link_activated -Callback {
    param($evt)
    $url = [string]$evt.url
    if (-not $url) { $url = $docsUrl }
    Open-Link $url
}

The host reports the link's target; your code decides which schemes it opens (here only https).

Open-NativeHTMLKitExternal accepts http, https, mailto and file URIs and absolute local paths, and refuses programs, scripts and shortcuts (code -32003). -Reveal shows a file in the file manager instead of opening it. In headless mode both throw NativeHTMLKit.RpcException -32001 (External open requires a desktop session). Headless runs have no pointer input, so the link_activated path itself is checked on a desktop.
path: How to use the clipboard and desktop services

items.title: Desktop preferences and capabilities
items.text:
$prefs = Get-NativeHTMLKitPreferences -Application $app     # color_scheme, reduced_motion, high_contrast, available, source
$caps  = Get-NativeHTMLKitCapabilities -Application $app    # clipboard_text, external_open, file_dialogs, headless, ...
# The notification carries a preferences snapshot (the same fields as Get-NativeHTMLKitPreferences).
Register-NativeHTMLKitNotification -Application $app -Method 'desktop.preferences_changed' -Callback { param($params) Show-Preferences $params }

Each preference is $null when the host has not observed it; in headless mode available is $false and source is headless. Pages follow the observed colour scheme through CSS media queries without any code (styling and layout). Use the capabilities to hide buttons for services that the current session does not offer. 14-diagnostics.ps1 shows both in an About window.

Real capture on KDE Plasma 6.6 Wayland with the released packages.
path: How to use the clipboard and desktop services

items.title: Privacy
items.text:
Clipboard content can be sensitive. The SDK's diagnostics never record it. Avoid writing it to logs yourself, and read the clipboard only in response to a user action.

Source: nativehtmlkit-powershell/docs/guides/clipboard-and-desktop.md · edit the page there.
path: How to use the clipboard and desktop services

items.title: How to troubleshoot: diagnostics levels, counters and support bundles
path: How to troubleshoot: diagnostics levels, counters and support bundles

items.title: How to troubleshoot: diagnostics levels, counters and support bundles
items.text:
Reference: diagnostics. Example: 14-diagnostics.ps1 (an About/Support window).

Real capture on KDE Plasma 6.6 Wayland with the released packages.
path: How to troubleshoot: diagnostics levels, counters and support bundles

items.title: First steps when "nothing happens"
items.text:
1. Look at the console you started the app from. Backend output and errors are relayed there. A failing callback prints NativeHTMLKit: document_event callback failed: <type>: <message> (<file>:<line>) and the app keeps running. An error that escapes the script prints the PowerShell error and nativehtmlkit-host error: application failed (...); the launcher exits with code 1.
  2. Check that the handler is registered on the current document. Loading a new document retires the old handlers. Register-NativeHTMLKitDocumentEvent must be called with the $doc returned by the latest Open-NativeHTMLKit*.
